izzyondroid:idv.markkuo.cscblebridge.name: CSC BLE Bridge
izzyondroid:idv.markkuo.cscblebridge.summary: bridge ANT+ Cycling Speed/Cadence/HR sensors as Bluetooth LE sensors
izzyondroid:idv.markkuo.cscblebridge.description:
This is an Ant+ to BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) Bridging app for ANT+ Cycling Speed and Cadence (CSC) sensors and ANT+ heart rate sensors. The app will act as a Cycling speed/cadence and/or HR BLE sensor so other BLE device (phone, PC, Mac, tablet) can reads data from ANT+ sensors.
 This is an Android app which reads ANT+ cycling speed/cadence (CSC) and/or heart rate sensors in the background (actually in an Android foreground service), and advertises itself as a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) device which implements Cycling Speed and Cadence Profile (CSCP) and Heart Rate Profile (HRP) so that other devices can see this Android device as a Cycling Speed and Cadence Bluetooth and/or Heart Rate BLE sensor.
 This is useful when you only have ANT+ CSC/HR sensors but you want to connect to them as BLE sensors (provided that you don't have an USB ANT+ stick around but happen to have an ANT+ enabled Android device like a Samsung phone).
 Long hold on the sensors name on top of the screen to rescan for Ant+ devices after the "Start BLE bridging" button has been pressed. All sensors will automatically scan for Ant+ sources when the "Start BLE bridging" button is pressed.

izzyondroid:io.github.swiftstagrime.term.name: Script Runner for Termux
izzyondroid:io.github.swiftstagrime.term.summary: A secure Android bridge for managing, writing and executing scripts via Termux
izzyondroid:io.github.swiftstagrime.term.description:
Requires Termux to be installed to execute scripts.
 A secure Android bridge for managing and executing scripts via Termux. This app allows you to automate tasks, manage environment variables, and create home screen shortcuts for your favorite scripts with a focus on security and ease of use.
 Features:
 Integrated Script Editor: Write and modify scripts directly within the app.
 Flexible Execution: Support for background execution or interactive Termux sessions.
 Highly Configurable: Support for any file extension.
 Custom prefix commands and arguments.
 Environment variable management.
 Addition of runtime parameters, either with text, or you own presets
 Can be riced with custom themes
 Customization: Personalize your script shortcuts with custom icons.
 Data Portability: Full support for importing and exporting your script library(now with sripts themself and not just my json DTOs parsing)
 ADB and Remote Execution
 You can now trigger scripts remotely via ADB or Webhook service. To use this feature, ensure you have set an "ADB Code" in the script settings (this is empty by default). Run command: adb shell am start \ -n io.github.swiftstagrime.termuxrunner/io.github.swiftstagrime.termuxrunner.ui.features.adbtrigger.AdbTriggerActivity \ --es io.github.swiftstagrime.termuxrunner.adb_code "YOUR_CODE_HERE"
 YOUR_CODE_HERE is supposed to be the code name of the script, like "test2" for example. Webhook example in settings.
 Security First
 I know that scripts often handle sensitive information—whether it's API keys in environment variables or private logic. * Encrypted Storage: All script data and configurations are stored in an encrypted database using SQLCipher.
 Compatibility
 Minimum SDK: 24 (Android 7.0)
 Target SDK: 36 (Android 16)
 OnePlus doesn't like apps installed from unofficial vendors so it blocks ability of the app to cold start Termux, you may want to try and spoof it using adb: 'adb shell pm install -i "com.android.vending" -r name.apk'.
 Other OEMs: If shortcuts do not appear, please manually check your "Background Start" or "Shortcut" permissions in your system settings, NOTE that some flavour might reject the permission later and not send exception to the app, sadly can't do much here.
 Current Status
 This project is currently in early development.
 Testing: Tested various extensions, and all works as expected
 Documentation: Detailed code description is currently under construction.
 Translation: En and Ru are made by me, everything else is AI. You can always switch in settings or during onboarding
 Stability: While functional, you may encounter edge cases. I recommend keeping backups of vital scripts using the built-in export feature. Also, BasicTextField starts lagging while typing at around 177K characters on Snapdragon 7s gen2, Snapdragon 8 gen3 does not have the same expirence. I have tested and linenumbergutter has no effect on perfomance, so it might be the internal implementation. I don't want to move to other ways of displaying stuff, because I will loose stylo support on my tablet

fdroid:at.j0s.meyercard.app.name: Fechtkarte
fdroid:at.j0s.meyercard.app.summary: Warm-up drill card generator using notation credited to Joachim Meyer
fdroid:at.j0s.meyercard.app.description:
Fechtkarte generates warm-up and routine drill cards for Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) practice, using notation credited to the 16th-century fencing master Joachim Meyer.
Each card shows a numbered sequence of cuts to work through, with a dot marking a thrust instead of a cut. Card background colour indicates which hand leads, so a drill can alternate sides. Edge choice, guard, footwork and tempo are left to the practitioner — the card only fixes the sequence of openings.
Features:
* A library of more than 100 classic drill cards, browsable by hand and filterable by action count, thrust count, and technique
* Random drill generation with configurable action count, thrust count, and five opt-in shaping rules
* Six palettes to choose from per hand, designed and verified for colour-vision-deficiency accessibility
* Export a generated card as a high-resolution PNG or a true-vector, print-ready PDF, or share it directly to another app
* Works fully offline, with no accounts, no analytics, and no network access required
Fechtkarte is free and open-source software (Apache License 2.0), with no proprietary dependencies. See PRIVACY_POLICY.md in the source repository for the full data-handling disclosure.

fdroid:com.desarrollodroide.pagekeeper.name: Shiori
fdroid:com.desarrollodroide.pagekeeper.summary: Client for your self-hosted Shiori bookmarks. Save from any app, read offline.
fdroid:com.desarrollodroide.pagekeeper.description:
An Android client for Shiori , the self-hosted bookmark manager. It talks to a server you run yourself: there is no account to sign up for and no service behind the app, only your own.
Your whole library is kept on the device, so the list, the tags and every article you have saved are there with no connection at all. What you change while offline (adding, editing, deleting, asking for a fresh copy of a page) is queued and sent when your server can be reached again.
 Features 
• Save from any app : share a page from your browser and it lands in your library, without opening the app.
• Read offline : articles are stored as clean, readable text, without the site around them.
• Works offline, syncs later : changes made without a connection are sent once the server answers again.
• Search titles, excerpts and URLs on the device, so it also works offline.
• Tags : filter the list by tag, rename or delete tags, or hide one tag from the list.
• Batch actions : select several bookmarks to tag, re-cache or delete them in one go.
• EPUB : download the ebook your server made of a page and open it in your reader app.
• Phones, tablets and foldables : the list takes as many columns as the screen can hold, and on a large screen the article can open beside it.
• Material 3 , light and dark.
 Requirements 
• A Shiori server you can reach, version 1.7 or newer.
• Android 8.0 or newer.
This is an independent app, not made by the Shiori project. It is open source under the Apache 2.0 license: https://github.com/DesarrolloAntonio/Shiori-Android-Client

fdroid:com.wasimaster.wmkeyboard.name: WM Keyboard
fdroid:com.wasimaster.wmkeyboard.summary: A private, offline keyboard: 955 languages, smart typing, themes, and tools.
fdroid:com.wasimaster.wmkeyboard.description:
WM Keyboard is an Android keyboard that keeps its intelligence on your phone. Prediction, autocorrect, glide typing, transliteration, emoji search and learning are all local computation over files in the app's own storage. There is no analytics SDK, no advertising, no account and no server of ours for the app to phone home to. This edition is built with no Google library on its compile classpath at all.
1,556 LANGUAGES, 3,388 LAYOUTS
Native scripts, InScript variants, romanized entries, CJK and constructed languages, all from one data-driven registry. A fresh install starts in the languages your phone is already set to and suggests more from your system language list.
BENGALI THE WAY YOU ACTUALLY TYPE IT
Avro-compatible phonetic typing, so "ami valo achi" becomes আমি ভালো আছি. The phonetic index is lenient: "asi", "achi" and "achhi" all reach the right word. Probhat is there too, with aspirates on shift, plus conjunct-aware backspace.
TYPING THAT LEARNS, LOCALLY
A trie-lattice beam decoder shared by tapping and glide, n-gram context ranking, autocorrect gated by a likelihood ratio rather than a blunt threshold, and on-device learning of your words, bigrams and trigrams. One tap clears all of it.
A REAL TOOLBOX
Clipboard with history, pinning and search. Snippets and text expansion. Calculator, unit and currency conversion, calendars, translate, dictionary lookup, web search, camera, media controls, an app launcher and more, most of them fully offline.
EMOJI, GIFS AND STICKERS
The Emoji 17.0 catalog with semantic search in 125 languages, per-person skin tones, kaomoji, custom sticker packs, and long-press to send animated emoji.
MAKE IT YOURS
A full theme editor: palettes, fonts, key shapes, textures, decals, particles and photo backgrounds, plus Material You and AMOLED. Resize the keyboard, split it, float it, or run it one-handed. Themes and layouts export and import as files, and an addon repository can serve you more.
VOICE AND AI
Speech recognition with a continuous mode, through Android's own recognizer or entirely on the phone: Whisper on whisper.cpp, and Asr4All, Parakeet and Moonshine on ExecuTorch, each model a download you ask for. Harper checks grammar offline. AI writing tools are optional, with your own API key or your own server. Nothing is enabled behind your back.
PRIVACY
Every network feature is a tool you choose to open, and each one is documented. This edition downloads nothing unasked: automatic language data is off by default, so a language's n-gram pack and emoji dictionary arrive only when you accept the prompt or press the button. One connection is not a tool, and it is worth naming: a script with no font of its own is drawn in Noto, fetched through Android's downloadable-fonts provider — Google Play Services where that is installed, and nothing where it is not. Typing on its own never reaches the network: a weather or currency chip waits for your tap before it fetches anything, and exchange rates come from currency-api and Frankfurter, both free software with open data, unless you pick another source. Every service the keyboard uses can also be pointed at another server, including one you run yourself. The update check asks F-Droid only when you press the button for it. Password and secure fields turn off learning, suggestions and clipboard capture on their own, and incognito mode does the same on demand. Backups are written where you point them, and a passphrase encrypts them.
This is the F-Droid build. It leaves out handwriting, text and QR scanning, the Whistle dictation engine and the on-device AI chat models, because they are built on Google libraries or code without published source, and it carries neither. Offline voice libraries come from outside F-Droid, once you allow it. Its privacy policy is its own: https://wmkeyboard.pages.dev/privacy/policy-fdroid/
The full documentation, including exactly what touches the network and when, is at https://wmkeyboard.pages.dev

fdroid:dev.argus.name: Argus
fdroid:dev.argus.summary: Natural-language automation compiled by an LLM, run by a deterministic engine.
fdroid:dev.argus.description:
Argus is a Tasker-class automation app where a large language model is the compiler, not the executor.
You describe a rule in plain language — "every day at 9 send me the BTC price", "when I leave home turn off Wi-Fi", "if an OTP arrives, copy it to the clipboard". The model compiles your request into a structured, typed rule (trigger, conditions, actions). You review it rendered from the types — never from the model's paraphrase — and approve a byte-stable SHA-256 fingerprint of the executable data. From then on a deterministic engine runs the rule: OS alarms, system receivers, geofences, the notification listener. The model is never in the execution loop, except for actions you explicitly mark as generative.
Why this matters:
* Predictable — the rule that fires at 3 a.m. is exactly the one you approved, byte for byte.
* Auditable — every run is logged locally, without personal content.
* Private by design — no Argus-operated backend or account, no telemetry and no analytics. Rules, logs and encrypted API keys stay on your phone; only the provider or self-hosted bridge you explicitly configure receives compile/generative requests.
The language-model transport is pluggable: run a self-hosted bridge, or connect directly to a provider you choose. A base tier works with no elevated privileges; for system-level actions Argus can use Shizuku.
Note: connecting a proprietary provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) is optional — Argus can instead use a self-hosted bridge together with its on-device deterministic actions.
Argus is free software (GPL-3.0). The interface, rule rendering and the agent all follow your system language (English or Italian).

Victoria Launcher is a minimal, list-based Android home screen, and an open source alternative to Niagara Launcher.
The home screen holds a short list of favorites and nothing you did not put there. Everything else lives in an alphabetical app list you reach by swiping in from the edge of the screen, with an A-Z strip for jumping straight to a letter.
A clock and date widget is included and any other widget can be added. Favorites can be folders, or the apps you open most, kept for you.
Layout, alignment, icon pack, icon and text size, spacing, font and colors are all adjustable, and the settings screen has a search box over the whole of it. There is an optional search box in the app list, optional notification counts on icons, optional Now Playing controls, and per-app renaming, icons and hiding.
Work profiles are picked up automatically, and Android 15's private space is supported.
No ads, no tracking, and no network access — the app holds no internet permission at all.

fdroid:it.danieleverducci.ojo.name: Ojo RTSP IP Camera viewer
fdroid:it.danieleverducci.ojo.summary: Ojo is a basic IP Camera surveillance wall.
fdroid:it.danieleverducci.ojo.description:
Ojo is a basic IP Camera surveillance wall.
IP camera's RTSP streams are added via its url and shown in the classic tile configuration. The number of tiles is automatically chosen based on the number of configured cameras: a single camera goes full screen, adding more cameras the app switches to a grid view: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 and so on.
The maximum number of cameras is determined by the device's capabilities.
The stream decoding and rendering is demanded to VLC's library: without their effort this app wouldn't be possible.
This app was specifically developed for F-Droid, as I couldn't find any open source RTSP viewers in the main repository.
The app can be opened deeplinking to url ojo://view
To open the app with focus on a specific camera, you can use an intent (it.danieleverducci.ojo.OPEN_CAMERA) to specify which camera you want to view.
The extra argument it.danieleverducci.ojo.CAMERA_NAME will open the app with the camera with the name you specified while adding the camera.
The extra argument it.danieleverducci.ojo.CAMERA_NUMBER starting at 1 could be used as well, if you have multiple cameras with the same name.
See below an example how to use the intent. The flag (-f 268468224) could be useful if you want to switch to another camera while the app is running:
 adb -s shell am start -a it.danieleverducci.ojo.OPEN_CAMERA -f 268468224 --es it.danieleverducci.ojo.CAMERA_NAME

fdroid:wtf.chihuahua.huallet.description:
Huallet is the self-custodial wallet of Chihuahua Chain. Hold, send, stake, swap and vote on HUAHUA and the whole Cosmos ecosystem, with your keys encrypted on your phone.
 Your keys, your phone 
 Create a wallet (12 or 24 words, with verification) or import a recovery phrase or private key
 Secrets encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key derived from your password (PBKDF2-SHA256, 600,000 iterations)
 Optional fingerprint or face unlock: the password is kept by the phone's secure hardware (Android Keystore) and released only after a biometric check
 Screenshots blocked, no cloud backup of wallet data, auto-lock
 The recovery phrase is shown only after your password or biometrics
 Ledger hardware wallets over Bluetooth (Nano X, Stax, Flex) or a USB (OTG) cable, with the Cosmos app: keys never leave the device
 Everything Cosmos 
 Portfolio across chains: available, staked, rewards, unbonding
 Staking: stake, unstake, redelegate, claim rewards
 Swap on HuahuaSwap, Chihuahua's native DEX, and on Osmosis with the best route from the Osmosis router
 IBC transfers, channels verified on-chain before sending
 Governance: proposals, live tally, vote
 Chihuahua, Cosmos Hub, Osmosis, Juno and Celestia built in; add any chain from the Cosmos chain registry
 Pay and get paid 
 Scan an address or payment request QR code (in-app scanner, no Google services)
 Tap to pay over NFC: the receiver's phone shares a payment request, the payer's phone reads it. Only the request goes over NFC, never keys or signatures
 Tap a QR code to show it full screen at full brightness
Every transaction is shown in full before you sign. No analytics, no ads, no trackers.
Network connections:
 Public Cosmos RPC/REST endpoints of your chains
 CoinGecko for fiat prices: on by default, can be turned off in Settings. Only token IDs are sent, never your address
 raw.githubusercontent.com for Cosmos chain registry data (asset lists, the chains you add, IBC channels) and token icons; chains.cosmos.directory for the list of chains you can add
 sqs.osmosis.zone for Osmosis swap quotes and raw.githubusercontent.com for the Osmosis asset list, only on the Osmosis swap tab
The icons of the built-in tokens are bundled in the app.

apple-macos:1130254674.description:
CloudMounter for Mac: Your Ultimate Multi-Cloud Storage Manager.
CloudMounter offers a seamless way to integrate and manage all your cloud storages right from your Mac. It mounts cloud drive accounts like Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Amazon S3 and others as regular drives on your Mac, letting you work with online-stored files just as you would with local ones. Effortlessly access, create, edit, download and upload files using this revolutionary cloud management tool.
Key features & benefits:
- Multiple Cloud Support: Connect to popular cloud services such as Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Amazon S3 bucket and many others. Access all your cloud storage accounts in one convenient place to easily edit and save files online.
- Server & Protocol Integration: Full support for FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, S3 and more. Seamlessly manage your remote servers and map network drive on a Mac to download and upload data/files with ease. 
- Extend Your Disk Space: With CloudMounter, a versatile cloud storage client, your Mac's storage capacity becomes virtually unlimited. It's a game-changer for those running out of local storage, especially when they can connect to cloud storage directly.
Safety and Privacy First:
CloudMounter isn’t just about convenience; it's about security.
- Solid Encryption: Only users with the master password can decrypt files and view data. Elsewhere, it appears as gibberish.
- Trusted Connections: All connections use the native APIs of cloud services. Your login credentials are only used for logging in and are never shared with third parties.
- Secure SFTP Access: Use FIDO/FIDO2 compatible hardware authentication keys (YubiKey, OnlyKey, Titan Security Key, FEITIAN ePass, etc.) and Two-factor authentication (2FA) for enhanced protection on SFTP servers.
- macOS Keychain Integration: Credentials for connected online services are stored securely in the macOS Keychain, ensuring an added layer of security.
- Control access to AWS resources securely: Use the AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) service to govern user access to AWS resources through permission management.
Expanded Service Options with Subscription:
- Multiple active connections of each service (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive)

- pCloud
- FTP/FTPS/FTPES
- SFTP
- WebDAV
- OpenStack Swift
- Mega

- Google Shared Drives (formerly known as "Team Drives")
Available Plan Tiers:
- Free: Use three major Personal Cloud Services with Encryption (one active connection each). Dropbox Business, Google Drive Shared drives, and other services are accessible in read-only mode. To fully manage all supported services with Data Encryption, upgrade your plan.
- Annual Subscription: Access all services for 1 year with unlimited connections (7-day free trial).
- Lifetime: One-time purchase for unlimited access to all services with unlimited connections.
Subscription Details:
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless they are canceled.
- Current active subscriptions cannot be canceled.
- To prevent auto-renewal, it should be disabled at least 24 hours before the current subscription ends.
- Upon renewal, the subscription fee you've selected will be automatically charged from your account within 24 hours before the next period begins, as detailed in the pricing tiers mentioned above.

flathub:io.github.mimoguz.TriPeaks-GDX.name: TriPeaks
flathub:io.github.mimoguz.TriPeaks-GDX.description:
A simple, open-source Tri Peaks solitaire game with multiple layout options.
 This release is crafted for Linux mobile devices and will run in full-screen mode.
 How to Play:
 Standard game starts with 28 cards arranged in three peaks, 23 cards in the stock, and one card in the discard pile.
 Aim is to clear the peaks by selecting a card that is one rank higher or lower than the top card on the discard pile.
 Sequences loop, so you can go from ace to two or king, in either direction at any time.
 When needed, you can move a card from the stock to the discard pile.
 Other Features:
 Three Layout Options: Beyond the standard TriPeaks layout, the game offers two more layout options.
 Customizable Start: Begin with an empty discard pile, allowing you to start with any open card or by drawing from the stock.
 Exposed Face-Down Cards: An option to view the face-down cards for added strategic planning.

fedora-packages:aqbanking/aqbanking.description: The intention of AqBanking is to provide a middle layer between the program and the various Online Banking libraries (e.g. AqHBCI). fedora-packages:aribb25/aribb25.name: aribb25
fedora-packages:aribb25/aribb25.summary: Basic implementation of the ARIB STD-B25 public standard
fedora-packages:aribb25/aribb25.description: This implementation currently only allows playback of ARIB scrambled streams. With the end of analog TV in Japan in July 2011 a wish for cheap Digital TV receivers emerged. Although, the voluntary introduced complexity in the ARIB standard makes it really hard to understand, induces higher development costs for device manufacturers and then nullifies the chances of having low cost receivers on the market. For that reason, this library gathers most of the necessary specification into a comprehensible code that can be used as a starting point. The Conditional Access system (CA) accordingly to the associated B-CAS Card will decrypt TS streams using the ECM table 0x82 and EMM table 0x84. EMM table 0x85 messages processing are to be done. Conditional Access Cards can be read through any ISO-7816 compliant IC card reader.

firefox-addons:2712706.name: Web Component DevTools
firefox-addons:2712706.summary: Developer tooling for Web Components and Web Component Libraries
firefox-addons:2712706.description:
Developer tooling for Web Components and Web Component Libraries
Web Component DevTools is aimed at all developers working with Web Components. The tooling provided creates a new Chrome Devtools panel, which allows a quick look at the custom elements on the current page, and enables modification of attributes and properties of said components.
Web Component DevTools utilizes the Custom Elements Manifest ( https://github.com/webcomponents/custom-elements-manifest ) to analyze the Web Components.
Features:
Web Component DevTools provides advanced features to the developer, straight from the browser's UI to, for example:
- Listing custom elements on the page, and accessible iframes inside the page
- Filtering custom elements on the list
- Inspecting and modifying the attributes of custom elements
- Inspecting and modifying the properties (even objects and arrays) of custom elements
- Observing dispatched events
- Calling functions of the custom element, and logging the return values
Why?
In the process of developing Web Components, wether it be with a library like Lit, or without any kind of library, there comes situtations in which you might want to have a bit more control over your components than what the regular browser devtools gives you.
You might for example want to:
Toggle the Attributes of the element
Toggle the Properties of the element
Monitor when events get dispatched from the element
Call functions
And when you're working with Web Components, Shadow DOM usually is present, making it fairly difficult to find the path to the element. And even if you got the path, having to write document.querySelector("my-selector-string > element-name").setAttribute("my-attr", "foo") every time you want to modify a value is quite cumbersome.
For this use case the Web Components DevTools were created: To enable the developer to easily modify the attributes, properties and therefore state of their element straight from the devtools window with the click of a button.
Issues:
Any issues you run into while using the DevTools should be submitted to the GitHub Repository ( https://github.com/Matsuuu/web-component-devtools/issues ).

firefox-addons:3019859.name: TruHue - Color Season Shopping Companion
firefox-addons:3019859.summary: See which makeup shades are YAY, OKAY, or NAY for your color season while you shop online.
firefox-addons:3019859.description:
COMMON QUESTIONS
Q: I don't know my color season yet — does this work for me?
A: Yes. Take the free 3-minute quiz at truhue.app/app/quiz and set your result in the popup. The widget then scores every shade against your season.
Q: Which retailers does this work on?
A: Sephora, Ulta, Amazon, Target, Walmart, Macy's, Nordstrom, CVS, Walgreens, and the direct-to-consumer stores from MAC, Fenty, Rare Beauty, Glossier, Charlotte Tilbury, NARS, Tarte, ColourPop, e.l.f., and NYX.
Q: Does this work for foundations?
A: Foundation matching uses a separate skin-tone match flow inside the TruHue mobile app. The widget tells you when a product is a foundation and points you there.
Q: Is my browsing data sent anywhere?
A: No. The extension runs entirely in your browser. Only the shade name and product URL of the page you're actively viewing are sent to TruHue's scoring API. No analytics, no tracking, no browsing history is ever shared.
Q: Why are some shades OKAY at 4/10 and others OKAY at 6/10?
A: Higher grade = closer to your palette. A 6/10 OKAY works on most outfits. A 4/10 OKAY is a stretch — wearable as a statement but not a daily go-to.

firefox-addons:1483457.name: GraphQL DevTools
firefox-addons:1483457.summary: Inspect, replay and mock the GraphQL requests of any website. Playground with schema autocomplete, schema explorer, insights, dark theme. Works on desktop and Android.
firefox-addons:1483457.description:
GraphQL DevTools 2.0 — rewritten from scratch.
Every GraphQL request on the page, readable at a glance: operation name, type, duration, result.
What it does
• Request list with operation name, query/mutation/subscription, timing and highlighted errors. Search and filters.
• Formatted query, variables and headers, with a browsable response tree.
• GraphQL errors shown clearly, even when the server answers 200.
• Handles batched requests, persisted queries (APQ) and subscriptions.
• Playground: replay or edit a request, with autocomplete from the schema.
• Schema explorer with types, fields, arguments and deprecations.
• Insights: slowest, most frequent and most failing operations.
• Mock responses: replace an operation's response to test your frontend without touching the server.
• Saved queries, copy as cURL and HAR export.
• Light and dark theme, English and Italian.
On Android too
Firefox for Android has no DevTools: GraphQL DevTools opens from the extension button with a phone-friendly interface.
Privacy
No data leaves your browser: no usage statistics, no external servers.

bluejetty:00096242:ios.name: Idle Fame: Sylor Dream Vlog
bluejetty:00096242:ios.summary: Have you ever dreamed of living the glamorous life of a vlogger and rising to worldwide stardom? With Idle Fame: Sylor Dream Vlog, your dream finally comes true! This idle life simulation game lets you experience the exciting journey of sta
bluejetty:00096242:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of living the glamorous life of a vlogger and rising to worldwide stardom? With Idle Fame: Sylor Dream Vlog, your dream finally comes true! This idle life simulation game lets you experience the exciting journey of starting from nothing and becoming a legendary online influencer. Create your vlog, grow your fanbase, upgrade your studio, and watch your fame explode across the globe. Whether you want to be a lifestyle creator, gaming streamer, or a viral entertainer, the spotlight is waiting for you.
In this unique idle simulator, your story begins with simple tools and a few curious followers. As you record, edit, and share your content, fans will start pouring in. The more you create, the faster you climb the ladder of fame. But it doesn’t stop there—thanks to idle mechanics, your vlog empire continues to grow even when you’re offline. Come back to see more fans, more views, and more opportunities to shine.
The road to becoming a top creator is all about choices. Will you invest in high-end cameras, stylish lighting, or next-level editing equipment? Will you focus on personal vlogs, fun challenges, or epic collabs with virtual creators? Every decision shapes your journey and brings you closer to internet fame. With each upgrade, your influence expands, unlocking new chances to connect with fans and grow your empire.
Customization is at the heart of your vlogger life. Dress up your character in cool outfits, design your perfect studio, and showcase your unique style to the world. Fame isn’t just about numbers—it’s about identity, creativity, and the story you tell through your content. In Idle Fame: Sylor Dream Vlog, you get to control it all while enjoying a fun, relaxing idle experience that rewards both your strategy and your imagination.
Travel across virtual worlds, unlock new cities, and take your content global. Your fame will spread from local followers to international fans who can’t wait for your next post. The more you grow, the more features you unlock, turning your simple vlog into a worldwide brand. Whether you’re chasing viral moments, building a loyal community, or just having fun with idle simulation, the game keeps rewarding you every step of the way.

bluejetty:00097694:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00097694:ios.description:
FOR LEARNERS WHO ARE DONE WITH BEGINNER STUFF
From Reggaeton to Cervantes: the whole world of Spanish, unlocked
You don't need another lesson on ordering coffee or asking how to go to the train station. You need a Spanish app that opens up your world: get the slang, dive deep into the cultures, plan your travels, and feel like you belong. Unedo gets you there, and it's actually fun.
Unedo is the daily language app for intermediate learners and up. No drills. No cringe AI dialogues. Just word puzzles, cultural stories, and real progress.
"Reinvigorated my excitement for learning Spanish!"
- Katie, real user
UNEDO ISN'T ANOTHER LANGUAGE APP. IT'S THE ONE YOU'VE BEEN LOOKING FOR.
Here's how it works:
Every day, you play short word puzzles in Spanish. 
Each one unlocks a cultural Spark: a story about the real stuff people talk about. 
Music everyone knows.
TV shows people reference all the time.
Food and places they love.
Slang, habits, traditions.
You're not memorizing lists. You're absorbing the language the way people actually use it.
The pace is intentional. One session a day, no pressure to catch up.
You're building the kind of knowledge that makes Spanish feel familiar.
As one user put it:
"IT'S CONTENT FOR NATIVE SPEAKERS, BUT WITH TRAINING WHEELS"
WHAT'S IN THE APP
- Fun word puzzles that train pattern recognition and contextual vocabulary
- Daily cultural stories from writers across Spain and Latin America
- Audio on every story, recorded by writers: read first, then listen in the original accent
- Flashcards created automatically from everything you discover
- A personal dictionary that grows with you
"My level of fluency has improved as a result of using Unedo"
- Sherry, Unedo user
YOU'LL LOVE UNEDO IF YOU:
- already know the basics and want to go deeper
- are bored with repetitive apps and generic lessons
- care about culture as much as vocabulary
- want to understand Spanish as it's actually spoken
- are preparing for travel, work, or life in a Spanish-speaking country
"THE MOST IMPACTFUL SPANISH LEARNING APP I'VE EVER USED."
START A NEW ROUTINE
One that will quietly make a big difference in your Spanish.
Our reviews are full of people who didn’t think Spanish could feel like this again, and now look forward to a few minutes with it every day.
Unedo is ad-free. No noise, no gimmicks, just the good stuff. Built by a small, independent team and a network of writers around the world who are creating the language app they wish existed when they were learning themselves.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Terms of Use can be found at
unedo.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00089357:ios.description:
Gather is a family location-sharing and vehicle-care app that helps you stay connected, coordinate
trips, and know when loved ones arrive safely. Share your location with the people you choose, receive
arrival and departure alerts, and manage your family vehicles in one place.
Stay connected with family and friends:
Share live location updates while on the move, send ETAs, choose who can see your location, and chat
in real time. Gather helps families coordinate school carpools, meet-ups, road trips, and everyday
journeys.
Know when loved ones arrive safely:
Get arrival and departure notifications, immediate safety alerts, emergency notifications, and reliable
trip updates. Add family members and their vehicles to your community so you can stay in sync without
guessing where everyone is.
Track trips and share updates:
Review logged trips, follow real-time location updates, and let friends and family know when you have
arrived. Use GPS location sharing, background tracking, safe zones, and live updates to stay informed
on the road.
Take the guesswork out of vehicle care: 
- Receive maintenance recommendations
- Get vehicle health updates and alerts
- Book servicing and repairs with trusted local providers
- Compare service options and pricing estimates
- Track service history and vehicle records in one place
Gather can detect vehicle issues and provide real-time alerts to help you respond early. For compatible
Wi-Fi-enabled vehicles, view in-app snapshots of vehicle data and stay informed about potential issues such as low tire pressure or upcoming service needs.
Manage your vehicles and family:
Add your partner’s, children’s, or other household vehicles to your community. Keep vehicle

Day Counter helps you count days since or until any special moment — past or future. From birthdays and holidays to sobriety milestones and habit streaks, it’s all here in one simple, elegant app.
* Count Up & Countdown Modes – track days since or days until any event
* Unlimited Counters – track everything from work deadlines to personal goals

Day Counter is a free, customizable counting app with two powerful modes: count up and countdown. Track the days since or until any important event in your life. This user-friendly day tracker helps you stay on top of your schedule — from personal goals and habits to special events, meetings, and deadlines.
Use it at work to stay organized and meet your deadlines, or in everyday life to remember school events, club meetings, vacations, birthdays, Halloween, Easter, or Christmas. Let this simple date calculator keep track of the time for you — so you never miss a moment that matters.
WHY CHOOSE THIS DAY-COUNT APP?
- Enjoy precise countdown and count up timers for any event
- Create and manage an unlimited number of events with ease
- Set personalized notifications and never miss an important moment
- Review past events by week, month, or year
- Stay focused on long-term goals and personal milestones
- Build better habits and track your daily progress
POSSIBLE COUNTDOWN TIMERS:
- Christmas & New Year Countdown
- Birthday reminders
- Wedding event countdown
- Time till Halloween
- Days until your exam
- Time till holidays or vacation
POSSIBLE COUNT UP TIMERS:
- Sober day counter
- Days together tracker
- Stop smoking count up
- Habit and streak tracker
PRODUCTIVITY APP
Your personal productivity assistant helps you take control of time. Whether you’re preparing for an exam at school or meeting a deadline at work, this date calculator keeps you on track. Simply plan your week or month and set countdowns in the app. You’ll stay organized, hit your goals, and even free up time for yourself.
EVENT COUNTDOWN
Day Counter offers two flexible counting modes: countdown and count up. The countdown timer is perfect for anyone who wants to know exactly how much time is left until a big event. Count down days, hours, minutes, and even seconds to the most important moments in your life. From work deadlines to personal milestones, everything is easier to track with this intuitive date calculator.
BIRTHDAY COUNTDOWN
What’s more joyful than a birthday — and what’s worse than forgetting one? Never miss a birthday again. With Day Counter, you can create a countdown for each friend or family member and get reminders right on time. Name the counter, set the date, and you’re always ready to celebrate.
DAILY HABIT TRACKER
Healthy habits are the foundation of a happy life. Whether you’ve started yoga in the mornings, run every evening, quit smoking, read every day, or limited social media use — you should celebrate your progress! Just create a counter in Day Counter and track the time since your habit began.
SOBER DAY COUNTER
Whether you’re seriously committed to quitting drinking or just trying it out for fun, Day Counter helps you stay on track. Create a count-up timer and name it however you like to track the days since your last drink. It’s a minimalist, no-pressure way to celebrate every day of progress.
STREAK DAY COUNTER
Running streak? Reading streak? Gaming detox? Social media off challenge? It all counts! With this simple date calculator, tracking your streaks is easy — just two steps: create a counter and save it. The app tracks the days for you, so you can focus on staying consistent whenever it works best for you.

bluejetty:00022230:ios.description:
Sometimes during the repair of the car, the battery is disconnected. After battery reconnected the radio is protected by a four digit code.
If you don't remember radio code or lost it, you can recover it quickly and easily with this app using precode.
Note: precode is located on the rear side of your radio.
ATTENTION: The number of generated codes is limited. When you purchase app you get 5 TOKENS, which gives you the opportunity to generate 5 codes. After the limit is exhausted, you can buy the required number of tokens by In-App purchases.
To find the precode:
- Turn the radio on and hold at the same time the button 1 and 6 (In some cases, it is necessary to remove the radio)
- See the unit precode. The precode consists of 1 letter and 3 digits. For example: V248, D833, H635
- Input precode to this app
How to input radio code ?
1. With Preset Buttons
･ Press 1 Button repeatedly for 1st digit to be displayed
･ Press 2 Button repeatedly for 2nd digit to be displayed
･ Press 3 Button repeatedly for 3rd digit to be displayed
･ Press 4 Button repeatedly for 4th digit to be displayed
･ Press and HOLD preset button 6 (or 5) to store your code (10 seconds)
2. With Stalk Control
･ Press switch on the CD radio. When CD will display 0 0 0 0.
･ Rotate the thumb wheel for the 1st digit. Next press the bottom button to move on.
･ Rotate the thumb wheel for the 2nd digit. Next press the bottom button to move on.
･ Rotate the thumb wheel for the 3rd digit. Next press the bottom button to move on.
･ Rotate the thumb wheel for the 4th digit.
･ Press and hold the bottom button button to finish.
3. With Remote Control
･ Press the [ ¬] button then rotate the thumb wheel for 1st digit
･ Press the [ ¬] button then rotate the thumb wheel for 2nd digit
･ Press the [ ¬] button then rotate the thumb wheel for 3rd digit
･ Press the [ ¬] button then rotate the thumb wheel for 3rd digit
･ Press and hold the [ ¬] button to store the code (10 seconds)
Please support us with your reviews in AppStore, it's very important for new users! Thank you!
If you experience difficulties with the app, please contact us.
support@kcandr.ru

bluejetty:00157830:ios.summary:
Hammer & Steel – Forge Your Legendary Blacksmith Empire!
Step into the shoes of a master blacksmith in Hammer & Steel, where you’ll transform a modest workshop into a thriving medieval enterprise! In this immersive idle and crafting game,
bluejetty:00157830:ios.description:
Hammer & Steel – Forge Your Legendary Blacksmith Empire!
Step into the shoes of a master blacksmith in Hammer & Steel, where you’ll transform a modest workshop into a thriving medieval enterprise! In this immersive idle and crafting game, you are the visionary craftsman who breathes life into every piece of metal. From crafting exquisite swords and unique artifacts to managing an expanding team of skilled workers, your journey to greatness starts here. Embrace the challenges of medieval life, deal with rival factions, and build your reputation one strike at a time!
Build, Expand, and Conquer the World of Crafting and Building
• Forge Your Destiny: Start with a humble smithy and gradually expand your domain by constructing new rooms, workshops, and even hidden underground facilities. Upgrade your tools and equipment to perfect every detail of your creations.
• Crafting and Building Mastery: Design your workshop with customizable décor and specialized workstations that boost productivity. Every improvement not only enhances your crafting capabilities but also attracts high-profile orders and wealthy clientele.
• Idle Business Excellence: Your blacksmith empire continues to grow even when you’re away. Harness the power of idle gameplay mechanics similar to popular idle mine and idle miner tycoon experiences, ensuring your business thrives around the clock.
Experience a World Full of Intrigue and Adventure
• Idle RPG Elements: Navigate through a rich narrative filled with unpredictable encounters. From local bandits to influential merchants and noble knights, every decision you make weaves into a tapestry of excitement and consequence.
• Dynamic Relationships: Form alliances or rivalries with various factions and characters. Your choices determine the protection, bonuses, and unique challenges you face, ensuring that no two playthroughs are ever the same.
• Unique Orders and Legendary Artifacts: Whether it’s forging a one-of-a-kind sword for a heroic knight or crafting an intricately designed ring for a noble patron, your skills as a craftsman will be put to the ultimate test. Every order completed raises your prestige and cements your legacy.
Manage a Talented Team of Professionals
• Hire and Train Your Workforce: Recruit blacksmiths, apprentices, and other skilled laborers, each with their own unique abilities and personalities. Create an efficient, harmonious environment where every team member contributes to your growing enterprise.
• Idle Factory & Mining Games Inspiration: Optimize your workshop’s workflow by assigning specialized roles, investing in advanced equipment, and even dabbling in resource management reminiscent of idle factory and mining games. Your strategic choices will lead to exponential growth and success.
Why Choose Hammer & Steel?
• Deep and Engaging Gameplay: Perfectly blending idle mechanics with crafting, management, and RPG elements, this game offers endless strategic depth.
• Immersive Medieval Atmosphere: Experience a world where every clank of the hammer and spark of the forge brings history to life.
• Limitless Customization: Personalize your smithy, enhance your tools, and experiment with different strategies to become the most renowned craftsman in the realm.
Hammer & Steel isn’t just another store game—it’s an epic adventure where your crafting prowess and strategic acumen forge the path to glory. Download now and step into a world where every strike of the hammer shapes your destiny. Whether you dream of creating legendary swords, leading a successful idle business, or building the ultimate craft city, your journey to greatness awaits!

• Search airport, city, address or hotel and voila you will see all rental cars.
• See all rental cars nearby on the map. Check if the branches are open or not. 
• Instant confirmation: Get your voucher email right after booking.
• Under 25 fee waived: We're waiving under 25 fee at participating companies.
• One way: Drop off at a different location.
• Get free upgrades.
• Last minute deals: Daily deals starting from $9/day.
• 24/7 customer service: Don't wait on the line for hours. We're here to help in seconds.

- Hassle-free car reservation in seconds. Don't get lost in a never ending list of cars.

Control and program your premium SICCE pumps with the intuitive user interface anytime from anywhere in the world!

* Simple and optimized specifically for smartphones

SICCE is a pioneer of technical solutions for the aquarium and pond industry, made in Italy since 1973. SICCE is globally recognized for setting the standard in quality and service.
Our vast experience allows us to produce versatile, high-quality products with incomparable performance. We develop complete lines of filtration systems, pumps, aquarium accessories, decorative fountain pumps for indoors and outdoors, ponds, pond filters, pool filters, drainage pumps and pumps for various industrial uses.
SICCE leads the pump manufacturer global market.

bluejetty:00083199:ios.description:
This app is powered by advanced AI technologies, including GPT-6, Grok 4.6, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Claude Opus 5.
A powerful AI chatbot and AI assistant designed for everyday tasks, creativity, productivity, and learning.
Switch between models to get the best results for any request.
Features
AI Chatbot
Ask any question and get clear, intelligent answers. Your data is handled securely.
Writing Assistant & Text Generator
Create emails, captions, summaries, essays, rewrites, and professional content in seconds.
AI Image Generator
Turn text prompts into original illustrations, backgrounds, and graphics. All generations pass through content safety filters. The app does not support editing, swapping, or generating images of real people.
Translator
Translate text between multiple languages with speed and accuracy.
Recipes & Meal Ideas
Generate meal plans based on ingredients you already have.
Activity Planner
Get balanced workout and daily activity plans tailored to your goals.
Travel Planner
Build smart itineraries and discover new destinations effortlessly.
Lifestyle Assistant
Productivity tips, creative ideas, book recommendations, and everyday advice.
Content Safety
All AI responses and generated images are filtered for inappropriate content.
Why users choose this AI app
• Multiple leading AI models in one app
• Fast responses and intuitive interface
• Designed for work, study, and creativity
• Continuous updates and feature improvements
How to use the AI assistant
• Open the app and start chatting
• Type your question or describe your task
• Get instant AI-generated results
• Refine your request to improve the outcome
Real-Life Use Cases
• No time to research? Ask the AI chatbot and get a clear summary in seconds.
• Writing an email before a meeting? Generate a professional draft instantly.
• Preparing for a special occasion? Create a custom greeting card illustration.
• Planning a trip? Let the AI travel planner build your itinerary.
• Building healthier habits? Get a balanced meal and activity plan.
FAQ
What makes this AI chatbot different?
It combines GPT, Grok, Gemini PRO, and Claude in one interface, allowing you to switch models depending on your needs.
Is there a free version?
Yes. Users receive up to 10 free messages per day.
Do I need an account?
You can review the app experience before upgrading. Account and data handling details are described in our Privacy Policy.
How do I cancel Premium?
You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple account settings.
Premium Subscription
• Communication with AI models is limited by quotas; users are provided up to 10 free messages per day
• Unlimited communication with AI is available only for Premium users. Users are offered various subscription options to become Premium users
• We offer free trial periods that can be used for a first introduction to the app
• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly or annually at the rate you choose, depending on your subscription plan

bluejetty:00179111:ios.description:
NFC Tools & RFID Scanner - writer & reader & tag
Operate at 13.56 MHz with NFC Tools & RFID Scanner for seamless data exchange. This professional writer & reader & tag solution reads and writes all NFC Forum tag types (NTAG, Ultralight, DESFire, ICODE, ST25, FeliCa) and decodes RFID/HID tags—perfect for high-precision decode operations across multiple formats.
Precision NFC Tag Management
NFC Tools & RFID Scanner reveals deep tag data: manufacturer details, tag type (NTAG213, MIFARE Ultralight C, etc.), memory capacity, NDEF compatibility, serial numbers, protocol specs, and read/write permissions analysis. With NFC Tools & RFID Scanner, your reader & writer & tag toolkit unlocks professional-grade insights.
Advanced Writing Capabilities
As the ultimate writer & reader & tag app, NFC Tools & RFID Scanner writes standardized data compatible with every NFC device: contact sharing (vCard), Wi-Fi/Bluetooth configurations, geolocation coordinates, custom URLs and text, plus Amiibo/TagMiibo cloning and full MFC operations. Whether you’re a developer or hobbyist, NFC Tools & RFID Scanner has you covered.
Expert NFC/RFID Features
Inside NFC Tools & RFID Scanner you’ll find hex editing of full memory, NDEF formatting, tag locking, password protection, capacity alerts, and webhook integration for server data transfer. This reader & writer & tag powerhouse is built for pros.
Broad Compatibility & Finder Function
NFC Tools & RFID Scanner supports over 50 tag types (NTAG 213–216, 424 DNA, DESFire EV1–EV3, ICODE SLIX/SLIX2, FeliCa, ST25 series) on iPhone 7 and newer. Plus, NFC Tools & RFID Scanner solves “how to find airpods” scenarios with its Bluetooth-based finder—distance-alert technology helps you track down lost AirPods or any compatible device.
QR & Document Suite
Beyond NFC, NFC Tools & RFID Scanner generates and scans more than 20 QR and barcode formats (Aztec, PDF417, and others). From custom QR creation to instant scanning, this is the one-stop reader & writer & tag app.
Why choose NFC Tools & RFID Scanner?
Deep Amiibo/TagMiibo decode capabilities (“tagmiibo” support built in)
MFC, RFID and HID tag compatibility for every format
AirPod finder feature solves “find my airtag” and “find air” use cases
Military-grade encryption and enterprise webhook integration
Download NFC Tools & RFID Scanner today and unlock the full power of NFC and RFID.

bluejetty:00166779:ios.description:
Hi Paint is a professional and versatile drawing apps for pad and phone. You can use it to draw, sketch, illustrate, art design, and create digital art anywhere, and it can also be used for image editing.
「Highlights」
· Minimal and intuitive interface to allows you to focus on the digital drawing itself. 
· A powerful tool set for drawing and image editing complete your own artworkout.
· Quick operations and gesture controls make your creation process more convenient.
· Import and export custom brushes and brush sets
· Supports multiple color modes including RGB, HSV, and CMYK.
· Custom Themes & DIY canvas: Drag-and-drop tool icons for a customizable canvas interface.
「Brushes Features」
· Over 100 kinds of brushes including pencils, markers, airbrushes, smudges, fill brushes, oil brushes, charcoal brushes, crayons, etc.
· Brush Studio - with over 90 customizable settings, design your own custom brushesx
· Import and export custom brushes
· Brush supports full pressure and tilt support controls.
「Layer Features」
·Rasterize, Duplicate and Merge layers 
·28 layer blend modes for industry-grade compositing
· Supports creating layer groups and renaming layers to facilitate creation and management.
「 Professional painting tools/image editing tools」
· Vector tool
· Liquify tool
· Clipping mask features
· Selection tool: Precisely select the editing area
· Shape Tools: Insert Shapes and Shape Transformation Functions
· Gradient tool with Linear and Radial options
· Symmetry tool: Create symmetrical effects such as mirrors or kaleidoscopes.
· Gaussian and Motion Blur filters for depth and movement.
· Add text and import fonts to the artwork
· More tools you need!
「Accessibility features」
· Advanced stroke stabilization
· Painting process playback function
· Add reference images and copy for practice
· Perspective, Isometric, 2D, and Symmetry visual guides
· Line art coloring assistance function
· Powerful image adjustments including Color Balance, Curves, HSB, and Gradient Map
「Animation Assist」
· Easy frame-by-frame animation with customizable onion skinning
· Create storyboards, GIFs, animatics, and simple animations
· Export your animations in the full resolution of your canvas
「 Save, export, and share」
· Share/export drawings as JPG, PNG, PSD, HSD
.Play back your paintings and reproduce your creative process in MP4 format, support export and sharing.
Use HiPaint just paint it! draw! Hope you'll like this digital painting and sketching app. Now let's try HiPaint to start your digital painting journey~

Welcome to Kido Coloring Book - The #1 Game For Kids!
The ultimate digital coloring book for creative kids.
*** Our games are very safe - No Ads, No purchases. At Kido, our goal is to create the perfect experience for your kids (and ours) to enjoy! ***
Kido Coloring Book is a part of Kido+, a subscription service that gives your family access to endless hours of playtime and educational activities.
Let your child dive into a world of colors, creativity, and endless imagination. Whether they love filling in bold, simple drawings or prefer exploring more detailed artwork, Kido Paint offers a perfect creative outlet for every young artist.
From toddlers discovering colors for the first time to older kids honing their artistic skills, this game adapts to every stage of creative growth. With an intuitive interface, a variety of fun drawing tools, and plenty of artwork to choose from, it’s never been easier—or more fun—for kids to express themselves freely.
What’s Inside the World of Kido Paint?
A Growing Collection of Fun Drawings
From playful shapes and characters to intricate designs, there’s something here for every creative mood. Kids can paint a little or a lot—there’s no pressure, just fun!
Made for All Ages
Kido Paint is built to grow with your child. Younger kids can enjoy simpler coloring pages with bold lines, while older kids will find more detailed artwork to challenge and inspire them.
No Ads, Ever
We don’t believe in interrupting play with ads. Your child’s creativity should flow freely without distractions.
Private & Safe
Kido Paint is fully COPPA and GDPR-K compliant, offering a secure digital environment for children.
Free to Play:
Great news, parents! No purchases are needed to start the fun—just download and play right away.
More than Just Fun
Kido Paint encourages fine motor skill development, color recognition, and self-expression—all while keeping things playful and engaging.
Whether your child is painting their favorite scene, experimenting with new colors, or simply scribbling for fun, Kido Coloring Book provides the perfect space to create, explore, and grow.
Download now and let your child’s creativity take the lead!
At Kido Games, we are committed to creating safe, engaging, and educational experiences for kids. Our games are always ad-free and do not require in-app purchases to progress. As a COPPA and GDPR-K compliant platform, we uphold the highest industry standards to protect your child’s online experience.
Visit our website: https://www.kidoverse.net/

bluejetty:00116255:ios.description:
Conquer the LSAT Without Setting Your Hair on Fire.
Studying for the LSAT? Of course you are. You’ve decided law school sounds like a fun way to accumulate debt while stress-eating. Logical reasoning, reading passages that go on forever, and games that sound like puzzles from a 2004 escape room? Fun!
But don’t worry. We built an app that won’t bore you to death, overload your brain, or make you cry in the shower. EZ Prep’s LSAT Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least soul-sucking way to prep for the LSAT and start your slow descent into legal glory.
Whether you're commuting, procrastinating, or lying awake at 3 am questioning your life choices, you can study on the go with intelligent questions, BS-free explanations, and an app that actually works offline.
Written by real lawyers and LSAT experts (not bots or bored interns), the content is based on the latest LSAC test format, so you're not wasting time learning stuff that’ll never show up on test day.
Here’s What You Get (Besides Existential Dread):
• Logical Reasoning – Learn how to spot flaws in arguments without yelling at cable news
• Analytical Reasoning (Logic Games) – Break down rules, make deductions, and solve puzzles like you're Sherlock Holmes
• Reading Comprehension – Train your brain to stay awake through dense, joyless academic prose (law school preview!)
• Experimental section – Just kidding. We have morals.

The Space Shuttle has been revived through Augmented Reality(AR) since its last flight in 2011. AR is a technology that displays virtual objects in the real world. You are the launch director of the Space Shuttle. Your mission is to launch the Space Shuttle and dock with the International Space Station safely. The Space Shuttle will be launched with smoke and fire from the launch pad. The shuttle will separate booster engines and an external fuel tank. It will dock with the Space Station above the Earth. This app is a simple experiment in AR. The app is not only for Space Shuttle fans but also for anyone interested in AR. Try launching the 3D virtual Space Shuttle now.

bluejetty:00118765:ios.description:
The AusPost app lets you safely and easily track and manage your parcels on your smart device.
Download the app to access these great features:
• Trusted notifications – Receive instant, legitimate and trusted notifications. 
• Automatic parcel tracking – Eligible parcels will automatically show in your track list if matched to your account - no need to add tracking numbers. 
• Track and manage parcels – Easily track and manage all your parcels in one place without checking emails. 
• Set delivery preferences – Request parcels be left in a safe place or redirect while in transit (if eligible). 
• Proof of delivery – View photos of where your parcel is left (if eligible). 
• 2-hour delivery notification – Set your preferences to receive a 2-hour delivery window where available once the parcel is on board for delivery. 
• Sharing collection authority – Authorise someone else to collect a parcel for you from the Post Office. 
• Collection QR code – Use the app’s collection QR code to collect missed deliveries from the Post Office (instead of a physical card).
• Contactless collection – Collect parcels from a free 24/7 Parcel Locker for an entirely contactless experience - only with the app. 
Terms and conditions apply. For more information, visit https://auspost.com.au/about-us/about-our-site/australia-post-app 
Plus, the AusPost app provides many services to help you send and receive your parcels, including: 
• Manage your notification preferences 
• Easy access to your MyPost and MyPost Business account 
• Pay eligible bills with PostBill Pay 
• Pay for and print postage labels online
• Find Post Office locations, opening times and postcodes 
Watch app
Discover an enriched experience with AusPost's watch app on Watch OS! Synchronise it with the AusPost app on your phone for smooth tracking notifications, effortlessly check parcel nicknames, stay informed about expected delivery times, and conveniently unlock your Parcel Locker with a simple QR code – all directly from your wrist!

bluejetty:00173545:ios.name: Screen Time Control
bluejetty:00173545:ios.summary: Unlock your full potential with Screen Time Control, an app designed to help you manage your focus at work, at home, or on vacation. With a user-friendly interface and powerful options for restricting access to distracting apps, Screen Time
bluejetty:00173545:ios.description:
Unlock your full potential with Screen Time Control, an app designed to help you manage your focus at work, at home, or on vacation. With a user-friendly interface and powerful options for restricting access to distracting apps, Screen Time Control ensures you stay on track and make the most of your time.
Key Features:
- One-Click App Blocking: Easily block and unblock apps permanently with just a single tap. Select the applications you want to restrict access to and regain control over your productivity.
- Time-Based Blocking: Set daily time limits for specific apps in minutes or hours. Once the limit is reached, the app will be blocked until the next day, helping you manage your time on social networks or other time-consuming applications.
- Scheduled Blocking: Customize your app access based on the days of the week and time intervals. Configure your desired restrictions for each app to create the perfect balance between work and relaxation.
- Site Blocking (Safari Extension): Block distracting websites directly in Safari. Activate the Sites feature whenever you need it, and easily turn it off when it's no longer required. Choose from pre-defined website categories such as Games, Politics, and Social, or create your personalized list of websites to block.
- Geo-Based App Control (Zones): Manage app access based on your location:
— Restrict Zone: Select an area on the map (radius from 200 to 800 meters) and choose apps to restrict within this zone. Selected apps will automatically become blocked or hidden when you enter the defined area.
— Safe Zone: Define an area on the map and select apps that will only be accessible within this safe zone. Outside the safe zone, these selected apps will remain unavailable.
Benefits of Screen Time Control:
- Improve your efficiency and prevent distractions with powerful app-blocking features.
- Customize your app restrictions to your unique needs and schedule.
- Maintain a healthy balance between work, relaxation, and family time.
- Protect work apps when handing your phone to a child or limit their access to games or specific apps.
Remember, with Screen Time Control, you can hide distractions, open possibilities, and close inefficiencies. Try Screen Time Control today, and take control of your focus, productivity, and time!

bluejetty:00133181:ios.description:
Passkeys is the app that revolutionizes sign-ins for ultimate security and simplicity. Say goodbye to passwords forever! With Passkeys App, creating and using a passkey is as quick and easy as a breeze. Use Face ID or Touch ID for one-step account creation and effortless sign-ins.
Features:
- Strong, Secure & Private
Each Passkey is inherently strong, never guessable, reused, or weak, guaranteeing top-notch protection for your accounts. All data stored in Passkeys App is encrypted, even when stored in iCloud, ensuring that only you can access your data.
- Encrypted Backup
In Passkeys App, you can create secure encrypted backups, providing peace of mind in case you lose your device or switch to a new one.
- Synchronization Across all Devices
Passkeys App automatically synchronize your accounts across all Apple devices for seamless access.
- Next-Generation Security
Built on FIDO Alliance and W3C standards, Passkeys replace traditional passwords with cryptographic key pairs, offering unmatched security.
- Phishing-Proof
Passkeys are uniquely tied to the app or website they were created for, protecting users from falling victim to fraudulent apps or websites.
- And many, many other features!
We constantly improve our app, don't hesitate to contact us at support@2stable.com to request a missing feature or an improvement.
A subscription is required to add more than 2 accounts and unlock unlimited usage.
Links
Terms of Service: https://passkeys.2stable.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://passkeys.2stable.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00148203:ios.name: QR Me - Contact
bluejetty:00148203:ios.summary: QR Me - Contact allows you to create your own personalized QR Codes to share your contact information quickly and easily with anyone. Simply have the other person scan your QR Code with their phone's camera and your contact will appear in t
bluejetty:00148203:ios.description:
QR Me - Contact allows you to create your own personalized QR Codes to share your contact information quickly and easily with anyone. Simply have the other person scan your QR Code with their phone's camera and your contact will appear in their contact book.
CONTACT FIELDS
You can add the following information to your contact:
 • First and Last Name
 • Job Title, Department, Company
 • Phone Number(s)
 • Email(s)
 • Birthday
 • Website(s)
 • Social Media Profiles
 • Postal Address(es)
 • Nickname, Middle Name, Maiden Name
 • Prefix, Suffix
 • Phonetic First, Middle, and Last Names
 • Notes
LABELED FIELDS
For phone numbers, emails, websites, and postal addresses, you can add labels to specify which ones are for work, home, etc.
Choose between some default suggested labels or create your own custom labels.
SOCIAL MEDIA FIELDS
Sharing your social media accounts has never been easier. Just select (or write in) a platform and add your username. If you chose one of the social media platforms listed in the app, people who save your contact to their phone can click on the field and get redirected straight to your profile. 
SHARING YOUR CONTACT
When you want to share your contact with someone, all they have to do is open their camera (iOS 11.2 or later) and hold their phone over your QR Code. They don't even need to have this app installed. It just works! 
FOCUSED ON PRIVACY
All of your contact information is stored locally on your own device. No internet connection is required to share your contact.
PROFESSIONAL BRANDING UPGRADE
With this in-app-purchase, you'll unlock the following features:
 • MULTIPLE QR CODES - Generate as many QR Codes as you need for various purposes – business, personal, school, and more.
 • CUSTOMIZE COLORS - Set the colors of the QR Code to match your branding.
 • LOGO OVERLAY - Add your logo atop the QR Code for a personalized touch that boosts brand recognition (note: the logo is *not* transferred with the contact as a profile picture). 
Privacy Policy: www.qrme.contact/privacy
Terms of Use: www.qrme.contact/tos

bluejetty:00155147:ios.summary:
Unleash Your Imagination with an AI-Powered Dungeon Master!

bluejetty:00155147:ios.description:
Unleash Your Imagination with an AI-Powered Dungeon Master!
Step into a world of limitless adventure! Whether you’re a seasoned Game Master or new to tabletop roleplaying games, Keeper of the Realms empowers you to create and run immersive RPG campaigns with ease. Use AI-driven tools to craft custom campaigns, generate characters, and guide players through dynamic storytelling—all from your iPhone or iPad.
Key Features
 AI-Powered Dungeon Master
 • Let AI narrate your game, control NPCs, and adapt to player choices dynamically.
 • Supports solo adventures or full party gameplay, allowing you to shape the journey.
 Campaign & Character Creation
 • Create custom campaigns from scratch or use AI-assisted generation for inspiration.
 • Quickly generate NPCs, player characters, and intricate storylines with the tap of a button.
 • Store all your game notes, world details, and character sheets in one place.
 Immersive Roleplaying & Dynamic Gameplay
 • AI-driven descriptive storytelling makes each session feel unique.
 • Built-in dice roller and encounter tracking keep your adventure flowing.
 • AI remembers past actions, allowing deeper worldbuilding and continuity.
 Seamless Cross-Device Play
 • Play solo or invite friends to join your campaign from their own devices.
 • Easily share join codes to bring players into your adventure.
 Stunning Visuals & AI-Generated Maps
 • AI-generated campaign images bring your world to life.
 • Customize the look and feel of your world with ease.
How It Works
 1. Start a Game – Pick a campaign or create your own.
 2. Build Your Party – Add players or play solo.
 3. Let AI Guide You – Explore the world, interact with NPCs, and make decisions.
 4. Shape the Story – AI adapts to your choices, keeping the adventure fresh.
 5. Continue Anytime – Save your game and return whenever you like.
 Why Keeper of the Realms?
 • Ideal for solo players or groups—no need for a live Dungeon Master!
 • Great for both beginners & veterans—jump in with AI assistance or take full control.
 • Fast, immersive, and endlessly replayable—no two adventures are the same!
Start Your Journey Today!
Download Keeper of the Realms now and embark on your next great adventure!

bluejetty:00145328:ios.name: ParkPassport
bluejetty:00145328:ios.summary: Created by the National Park Trust, the ParkPassport App is your guide to creating memorable park experiences in local, state, and national public lands and waters! Utilize our robust database and park finder tool to access and learn about
bluejetty:00145328:ios.description:
Created by the National Park Trust, the ParkPassport App is your guide to creating memorable park experiences in local, state, and national public lands and waters! Utilize our robust database and park finder tool to access and learn about over one-thousand park sites across the country. Filter for parks based on specific activities, cultural significance, or historical periods you’re interested in, and collect park-specific badges in your virtual park passport to record your visits.
Since launching in 2019, the ParkPassport App has become the most comprehensive collection of activities, information, and resources on local, state, and national public lands and waters on a free platform. New partnerships with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Missouri State Parks, and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association (NOAA), make the ParkPassport App a must-have for outdoor enthusiasts!

bluejetty:00142174:ios.description:
Caliverse: Calisthenics for Everyone
Calisthenics for the whole universe - this is our mission, and this is Caliverse. We believe in giving everyone a chance to explore bodyweight training and learn to perform exercises correctly using natural movements - no gym required!
Why Caliverse?
• Train Anywhere, Anytime
Skip the gym and equipment. Harness the power of your bodyweight to work out wherever you choose.
• Progress Faster with Professional Routines
Choose from 40+ training plans and hundreds of pre-built workouts, designed to help you build strength, mobility, and endurance.
• Lower Injury Risk
Focus on functional, bodyweight movements to build strength naturally and reduce strain on joints and ligaments.
• Full Workout Freedom
500+ exercises let you customize every aspect of your training. Build your own routines or modify existing ones to fit your schedule and goals.
• Monthly Challenges
Join regular challenges to test your limits and stay motivated. Earn bragging rights or prizes by making it to the finish line.
• Thrive in a Supportive Community
Share progress, swap tips, and connect with like-minded athletes. Whether you’re a beginner or advanced, find encouragement at every stage.
Free vs. Premium
Free Version Includes
• Over 200 bodyweight workouts and 500+ (and growing!) exercises with detailed videos and descriptions.
• Access to all the base training plans, monthly challenges with prizes, and our passionate community.
(We believe those who can’t afford a subscription should still have everything needed to progress.)
Caliverse Premium
• Advanced and progressive workout plans targeting specific skills or movements, plus new premium plans added every month.
• Follow-along video workouts for anytime, anywhere training.
• Comprehensive tutorials on calisthenics, exercises, and technique.
• Access all challenges without limitations—compete, stay consistent, and win valuable prizes.
• Apple Health integration: Sync your workouts to close your rings and track overall activity.
Terms
By using Caliverse you accept our Terms of Use (https://www.caliverse.app/terms-of-use) and Privacy Policy (https://www.caliverse.app/privacy-policy). Find License Agreement here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.
Get Started
Download Caliverse now and join a growing community of fitness enthusiasts. Reach your goals, stay motivated, and redefine what’s possible with bodyweight training!
Contact us at info@caliverse.app or follow @caliverseapp on social media for the latest news, inspiration, and workouts. Let’s achieve your goals together!

bluejetty:00122389:ios.description:
It is World War II, the story takes place in 1942 and you take on the role of "Super Ace", a brave fighter pilot. There are 20 levels to go through and the goal is to reach Tokyo and destroy the entire Japanese air fleet. And before you reach the main city, you will travel through Midway, Marshall, Attu, Rabaul, Leyte, Saipan, Iwo Jima, and Okinawa. At each level, you start and end on an aircraft carrier. Then on your plane, you fly to struggle against enemies over sea and land and shoot them all down. You get some different power-ups to increase your firepower and chances of survival after destroying certain plane formations. There are such power-ups as two machine guns, two side planes, extra loops, and so on.
HOW TO PLAY
* Screen slide: moves the airship - combat plane.
* Choose the plane for your liking and become the flying ace!
* Touch the "lighting" button to make special lightning attacks.
* Select boosters to start easier.
* Defeat enemies and become the War Hero!
FEATURES
* Discover 20 challenging levels of aerial combat with huge End Level Bosses and 3 modes to play: Normal, Hard, Crazy
* Many different Enemy types
* Numerous Upgrades and special gameplay
* 5 different aircraft and more.
* Arcade retro style feeling.
* Easy control.
Enjoy awesome air battles anytime, anywhere with Air Strike: Pacific Warfare WW II
Completely free to play on mobile!

bluejetty:00044303:ios.description:
Never lose your phone again with the Clap Find Phone By Clapping app!
Tired of constantly looking for your misplaced phone? Annoyed by the precious time wasted on searching for your device? Find My Phone By Clapping is exactly the innovative tool you have been looking for. This user-friendly application allows you to find your lost phone effortlessly just by clapping your hands.
Key Features: 
-Effortless Clap Detection: You can locate your missing phone quickly and effortlessly with just a simple clap sound.
-Multiple Search Modes: The app supports diverse search options, including clapping, whistling and screen tapping to help you find your phone.
-Customizable Sensitivity: You are able to adjust the clap detection sensitivity freely to adapt to different usage environments.
-Loud and Clear Alerts: The app will activate loud ringtones, strong device vibrations or turn on the flashlight, helping you spot your phone with ease.
-Intuitive Interface: Adopts a simple and clean user design, making it super easy for everyone to use the phone finding function.
Key Improvements:
-Conciseness: Cut down repetitive expressions and polished the wording for a more concise presentation.
-Clarity: Optimized sentence structures and content logic to greatly boost readability.
-Focus on Key Features: Centered on core app functions and displayed key highlights in a succinct and striking way.
-Stronger Call to Action: Added more appealing guidance to motivate users to download and try out the app.
-Enhanced Readability: Overall sentence flow and text fluency have been fully upgraded.
Get rid of the anxiety and stress caused by losing your phone. Download Find My Phone By Clapping right now and get back your peace of mind.
We sincerely welcome all users to put forward your valuable opinions and improvement suggestions for this practical hands clap phone finder app. Your positive feedback and kind comments are the greatest motivation for our continuous optimization and improvement. Thank you very much!
