bluejetty:00166093:ios.name: Pondlife — Fish, Frogs & More!
bluejetty:00166093:ios.summary: Discover an enchanted fish pond and nurture it into a sparkling sanctuary, brimming with eye-catching fish, quirky frogs, and curious creatures. Pondlife is overflowing with beautiful freshwater species to collect, including fish, turtles,
bluejetty:00166093:ios.description:
Discover an enchanted fish pond and nurture it into a sparkling sanctuary, brimming with eye-catching fish, quirky frogs, and curious creatures. Pondlife is overflowing with beautiful freshwater species to collect, including fish, turtles, frogs, and other fascinating underwater friends. Enjoy relaxing gameplay and hours of cozy fun!
Collect and nurture your favorite freshwater fish and other adorable creatures, from frogs to turtles, axolotls and more! As the caretaker of your pond, nurture these species from eggs to adults and prepare them for their forever homes in the wild. Lilly, your friendly otter guide, will help you feed and grow fish, unlock new pond environments, complete exciting events, and release adult fish, frogs, and other creatures into the Great River.
FEATURES
• Relaxing gameplay: Immerse yourself in a serene underwater world, teeming with real species of fish, frogs, and other creatures!
• Unlock hundreds of creatures: Discover wild species (including some of your favorite aquarium fish) like Tetras, alongside other freshwater friends like frogs, Cleaner fish, Cichlids, and many more!
• Collect beautiful underwater plants and decorations: Decorate your pond and marvel as it transforms into a breathtaking freshwater aquarium, bustling with captivating creatures.
• Document your discoveries: Use the Aquapedia to learn about the fish, frogs, and other creatures you collect!
• Participate in events: Take part in events to collect limited-time creatures and underwater decorations.
If you enjoy fish games, relaxing games, or aquarium simulators, prepare to be captivated by the wonders of Pondlife!
*****
Pondlife is developed and published by Runaway.
This game is free to play but does contain in-app purchases. If you run into any issues while playing or you have any suggestions, please reach out to us at support@runaway.zendesk.com

bluejetty:00128836:ios.description:
Standing upon the battlefield with your Hero at your side and troops ready for deployment, the question remains — will you fall in battle or rise to claim victory? Through sharp tactics, fast reflexes, and strategic deck building, triumph awaits in the free-to-play mobile strategy game War Alliance.
Face opponents in intense real-time PvP combat while commanding one of many unique Heroes and deploying cards from your customized battle deck. Every victory earns valuable rewards used to unlock new cards, upgrade troops, and enhance your Hero’s gear — pushing your strategy to ever greater heights.
Whether you prefer to fight alone or alongside allies, the choice is yours. Create or join a Clan to unlock exclusive rewards, participate in events, challenge friends to duels, and coordinate devastating 2v2 battles.
With missions to complete, leagues to conquer, and leaderboards to climb, War Alliance delivers a fast-paced competitive strategy experience designed for players seeking both skill and depth.
FEATURES
• Battle players worldwide in real-time PvP matches
• Control your Hero directly on the battlefield for tactical advantage
• Discover unique Heroes with distinct abilities and playstyles
• Build and customize powerful battle decks
• Unlock, upgrade, and master a wide variety of cards
• Equip gear and skins to personalize your favorite Hero
• Join a Clan for rewards, events, friendly duels, and 2v2 battles
• Compete in leagues and climb global leaderboards
• Adapt your strategy across multiple arenas with evolving challenges
• Complete missions and participate in weekly events for additional rewards
Share feedback and connect with the community via our Facebook page (facebook.com/WarAllianceGame) and Discord server (discord.gg/MadJRGd).
War Alliance is free to download and offers optional in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00160775:ios.description:
◆ Cat Jam 3D – Are you up to a block match 3 puzzle game? ◆
Looking for a relaxing brain puzzle that’s a perfect combo of 3D block puzzle and match 3 games?
Welcome to Cat Jam: Block Match 3 Game, one of the most colorful block puzzle match 3 games, you've ever seen! Make those cute cat blocks run to the stack and match them there!
Cat Jam 3D – A MATCHING PUZZLE GAME, TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED!
Immerse yourself in a relaxing yet challenging block matching logic puzzle game as you match kitten blocks to progress through brainteaser levels. Solve the match 3 color block puzzle levels & become the royal Cat Jam master.
Don't let your tray run out of space.
Tap the cute cat shaped blocks that aren't trapped in cats traffic to unblock them. Match 3 color cubes to clear them all.
If you are a match 3 logic puzzle enthusiast, with easy-to-learn mechanics & addictive gameplay, Cat Jam is a perfect satisfyer match for you. 
How to play Cat Jam 3D: Block match 3 game:
• Your goal is to free blocked cats and clean the board.
• Tap to place the unblocked cats into matching stacks.
• Open the path out for blocked cats.
• Match 3 same color cats.
• You will win when the board is clear! 
Cat Jam 3D: Block Match 3 Game, is the ultimate logic brain teaser and stress reliever. Solve the kitten block matching puzzle and sharpen your mind's logic while you kick back and relax in a vibrant world of triple match fun.
3D kitten block match jam puzzle features:
• Well-designed brain logic training levels.
• Stunning cute graphics and animation.
• Fun powerful boosters.
• Play anytime, anywhere.
Download Cat Jam 3D: Block Match 3 Game now and start tapping for endless fun.

bluejetty:00042230:ios.name: Link On Demand
bluejetty:00042230:ios.summary: Free, easy and convenient on-demand travel in and around the the City of Lone Tree, Meridian, Highlands Ranch, Stonegate, and Parker. Travel in comfort by yourself or with friends in one of our ADA-accessible, family-friendly, vehicles driv
bluejetty:00042230:ios.description:
Free, easy and convenient on-demand travel in and around the the City of Lone Tree, Meridian, Highlands Ranch, Stonegate, and Parker. Travel in comfort by yourself or with friends in one of our ADA-accessible, family-friendly, vehicles driven by professional drivers.
Just download the free Link On Demand app today, book your seat and go where you want, when you want. It is as easy as click and go.
Our intelligent service allows passengers to share their journey with others going their way. Book a journey and our powerful algorithm matches you with one of the City’s shuttles that will pick you up at a convenient spot. Link On Demand is a new model of on-demand transport - a technology-enabled vehicle that comes to a street corner near you, when and where you need it.
Areas we serve:
Locations in and around the City of Lone Tree, Meridian, Highlands Ranch, Stonegate and Parker.
How does Link On Demand work?
- Link On Demand is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the Link On Demand app, input your address within the areas we serve, and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up at your location, or nearby, and drop you off at your destination. Our smart algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel.
How long will I wait?
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking. You can also track your Link On Demand shuttle in real time in the app.
How many passengers will I share a vehicle with?
- The number of passengers you will share a journey with varies based on capacity and your chosen destination!
Love our app? Please rate us! Questions? Email us at support-linkondemand@ridewithvia.com

bluejetty:00200111:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00200111:ios.description:
Great for demos, first takes, and fresh ideas: voice and guitar at the kitchen table, or a band passing one phone around the room.
The sound of the machine is built in. Each track has its own set of knobs and there is no undo.
 - Records from the built-in mic, a headset mic, or a USB audio interface.
 - Loops any section of a song so you can record a part over it.
 - Sends any track through a space echo with spring reverb.
 - Bends pitch and tempo together with a varispeed knob in the master panel.
 - Has track merging/clearing, punch-in recording, and a metronome with pre-roll.
 - Your recordings are WAV files saved on your phone. Share the mix, every track as its own WAV, or the whole session.
 - Works entirely offline and collects nothing.
 - Pay once. No subscription, no ads, no account.
 - Works on iPhone and iPad.
 TIPS
 - Overdub with wired headphones, so the mic doesn't pick up the other tracks.
 - Don't use Bluetooth headphones while recording: they add delay, and only play in mono.
 - Tap record while playing to punch in over a part you want to redo.
 - Hold the |‹ button to loop a section.
 - Tap the ? at the top left for a guide to the controls.
Blueprint is made by one person. If something feels confusing or missing, email max@blueprintdaw.com and I will answer. Follow along on instagram at @blueprintdaw.

bluejetty:00166298:ios.summary: Dungeon Clawler is a Roguelike Claw Machine Deckbuilder. Build your unique deck, fight enemies by grabbing weapons and items from a claw machine and find special artefacts that help you on your quest to reclaim something you lost... Aim car
bluejetty:00166298:ios.description:
Dungeon Clawler is a Roguelike Claw Machine Deckbuilder. Build your unique deck, fight enemies by grabbing weapons and items from a claw machine and find special artefacts that help you on your quest to reclaim something you lost... Aim carefully to claw your way through this dungeon!
FEATURES:
- Unique Claw Machine Mechanic: Control a real-time claw machine to snatch weapons, shields, and items from the claw machine. Every grab counts, so plan your strategy and defeat enemies with precision.
- Roguelike Dungeon Exploration: Traverse procedurally generated dungeons that change with every run, offering new challenges, enemies, and treasures every time you play.
- Innovative Deckbuilding Strategy: Collect and upgrade your item pool with powerful weapons, items, and trinkets. With countless combinations, create your ultimate strategy to conquer the dungeons.
- Epic Boss Battles: Engage in intense boss battles and unlock special perks aka paws with every victory.
- Endless mode: Even after beating the dungeon boss, the run doesn’t end, but can go on forever. How deep into the dungeon can you venture?
- 4 Difficulty Modes: Beat the dungeon in normal, hard, harder and nightmare mode.
- Unique Characters: Choose from multiple heroes, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Discover the best combinations to suit your dungeon-crawling strategy.
- Engaging Storyline: The evil dungeon lord has stolen your rabbit paw and you replaced it with a rusty claw. Fight your way through the dungeon to reclaim your lost limb and fortune!
- Stunning Art & Sound: Immerse yourself in the colorful, hand-drawn world of Dungeon Clawler with its dynamic soundtrack and beautifully crafted visuals.
WHY PLAY DUNGEON CLAWLER?
Dungeon Clawler brings together the strategic depth of deckbuilders with the thrilling unpredictability of roguelike dungeon crawlers and the fun of a claw machine mechanic. Each run offers something new, with endless strategies to discover and enemies to defeat. If you're seeking a fresh deck-builder with infinite replayability, this is the game for you.
EARLY ACCESS: HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE!
Dungeon Clawler is currently in Early Access, and we're committed to making it even better with your feedback! Expect frequent updates, new content, and improvements as we continue to enhance the game. By joining now, you can help shape the future of Dungeon Clawler and be part of our growing community.
JOIN THE ADVENTURE TODAY!
Download Dungeon Clawler now and begin your journey through ever-changing dungeons. Can you master the claw and reclaim your paw? The dungeon awaits!
ABOUT STRAY FAWN
We are an indie game development studio from Zurich, Switzerland. Dungeon Clawler is our fourth game and highly appreciate your support!

bluejetty:00032296:ios.description:
2nd.MD provides medical certainty and helps guide people through challenging healthcare journeys.
This concierge service connects you with board-certified, leading doctors across the country for an expert consultation on your iPhone within 3 to 5 days. Our latest version of the 2nd.MD app allows a 3rd person to join video consultations and permits account activation with a code.
When to Use 2nd.MD:
You have a new or serious diagnosis
You’ve been recommended to have surgery
You have a chronic health problem you can’t resolve
You’ve been advised to start a new prescription or medication
How it Works:
Contact 2nd.MD’s Care Team nurses via:
 - App
 - Email
 - Website
 - Phone
Your Care Team nurse will:
 - Recommend specialists
 - Retrieve and consolidate all your medical records
 - Schedule an appointment with the doctor you choose
Within 3 days you will speak directly with a top specialist who has all your medical records. Your doctor will provide you with expert advice and send you a summary in 24 hours. You also can request a list of local, in-network physicians. 
From our Members
“My family and I are extremely grateful to my employer for offering 2nd.MD as a benefit and to 2nd.MD for providing a life-saving consult.” - Oscar
“2nd.MD is the way to go! I've already been telling my coworkers about it. This is the future of where medicine has to go.” - Adric
“I would most definitely recommend this service to anyone who is in the same situation as us and is looking for some answers.” - Debbie
“I am fully convinced that 2nd.MD DOES have the world’s best doctors, and the confidence and advice we gained from using this service is invaluable.” - Andy
How to Access 2nd.MD
To access 2nd.MD, you can use the app, visit our website (www.2nd.MD), call us at 1.866.841.2575
or email us at CareTeam@2nd.MD. 
About 2nd.MD
2nd.MD is a complementary health benefit offered by the world’s leading employers. It allows their employees and their employees’ dependents to get second opinions about difficult medical challenges from medical experts from elite medical institutions. Not sure if you’re covered? Contact your human resources department. 
If your employer doesn’t offer 2nd.MD, contact your human resources representatives and ask them to add 2nd.MD as a benefit. You may also pay out-of-pocket ($3,000) for the 2nd.MD service.

bluejetty:00148157:ios.name: StitchTally: Row Counter
bluejetty:00148157:ios.summary: StitchTally is a simple and intuitive app designed to help you keep track of the number of rows you've crocheted or knitted. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced crocheter, StitchTally makes it easy to monitor your progress and stay
bluejetty:00148157:ios.description:
StitchTally is a simple and intuitive app designed to help you keep track of the number of rows you've crocheted or knitted. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced crocheter, StitchTally makes it easy to monitor your progress and stay organized.
Features
- EASY TO USE: StitchTally features a user-friendly interface that allows you to focus solely on crocheting without distractions.
- PROJECT PHOTOS: Add photos to your projects from your camera or photo library to easily visualize your works in progress.
- SEARCH, SORT & FILTER: Find any counter instantly and organize by recently updated, creation date, name, or progress.
- PROJECT NOTES: Keep track of pattern details, hook sizes, yarn notes, and row instructions right beside your counter.
- GOAL SETTING: Easily set and track goals for each project, with StitchTally counting down to help you stay motivated.
- UNLIMITED COUNTERS: Manage as many projects as you like, making it especially beneficial for amigurumi crochet enthusiasts.
- FOCUS MODE: Enjoy a full-screen focus mode that helps you concentrate on counting your rows, while preventing your phone from sleeping (without draining your battery).
- IPAD SUPPORT: StitchTally supports iPad, with a better user experience.
- ICLOUD SYNC: Now your counters are automatically synced across all your devices, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Never lose your counters again!
- APPLE WATCH: Use the Counters app on your watch with synced counters for on-the-go counting.
- TUTORIAL VIDEOS: Forget how to do a certain stitch? No problem! We've got you covered with a series of tutorial videos to help you learn how to crochet.
- SYMBOL & ABBREVIATION LOOKUP: Look up symbols and abbreviations for crochet patterns.
- FUN DESIGN: This app uses a lot of emojis to make it fun, cute and memorable.
Why I built StitchTally?
I fell in love with Amigurumi crochet! They are very cute and fun to make. However, I found it difficult to keep track of my progress for each part of the amigurumi. I wanted an app that is very simple and easy to use, so I can focus on crocheting.
That's when I decided to build StitchTally. I'm still using it for my own amigurumi projects every day, and added some features that I found useful.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00084198:ios.description:
Dive into the criminal world of hidden object games and unravel a gripping tale of betrayal, greed, and corruption. Free-to-play version of "Unsolved Case: Ash and Secrets" puts you at the heart of a high-stakes crime investigation, where every clue you uncover brings you closer to the truth. Follow a trail of intrigue through the Great Green Reserve, exposing hidden motives and unraveling a deadly conspiracy. As a master detective, your skills to find hidden objects will be tested as you navigate through treacherous alliances and dangerous revelations!
Your reputation sends shivers down the spines of criminals, but new foes are emerging — calculating and ruthless. Investigate the murder of truck driver Harry Wright in the dangerous Great Green Reserve. A mysterious amulet at the crime scene reveals a web of corruption, leading you to a village furious over a highway project threatening their burial grounds. Confront Chad Simmons, the businessman behind the highway, and Wabano Folsom, the desperate village elder. Navigate betrayals, uncover a missing diary, and solve the mystery of who benefits from Harry's death. With your trusty partner Paul by your side, chase down leads and confront the true killer behind these chilling crimes. 
Crime Scene Investigation!
Dive into the world of Unsolved Case, where every detail counts. Examine crime scenes, seek and find hidden objects, and use your sharp detective skills to piece together complex clues and uncover the truth behind each criminal case!
High-Stakes Choices!
Your decisions impact the fate of the innocent and guilty alike. In this crime investigation, every action you take shapes the story, balancing justice and mercy as you face dilemmas that only detective games can deliver!
Hidden Object Gameplay!
Embark on a series of intricate finding object games where every detail matters. As you scour crime scenes and secret locations, you’ll need to find hidden objects that are key to unlocking new clues and progressing in your crime investigation!
Test Your Skills!
Each crime scene is packed with challenging sequences that combine traditional seek and find hidden objects gameplay with exciting unsolved mysteries games and story-driven tasks. Use your sharp eye to uncover the secrets behind every shadow!
Download the free trial of "Unsolved Case: Ash and Secrets", sharpen your skills to find hidden objects, and solve the mysteries that will keep you hooked from start to finish!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00073900:ios.description:
Remote control your camera: Sony (alpha and Cyber-shot), Canon (EOS and PowerShot), or Fujifilm (X and GFX series). Capture flawless self-portraits, breathtaking travel shots, professional real-estate photos, stunning time-lapses, and more. (See a list of supported camera models at the end of this description.)
WHY YOU’LL LOVE SHUTTER+
• Connect wirelessly or use a USB cable.
• Easily browse, filter and download photos from the camera.
• Add GPS location to your photos.
• Compose perfect shots with aspect ratios and grid overlays.
• Nail down exposure with tools like RGB, histogram, zebras and false color.
• Exposure bracketing & BULB support.
• Focus bracketing (see compatibility below!)
• Include yourself in the photo - configurable delay and interval for repeated capture (intervalometer).
• Audio cues for countdown and shutter.
• Optimized for low battery usage.
PERFECT FOR EVERY PHOTOGRAPHER
Self-portraits & group shots
Set the timer, join the scene, and let Shutter+ take multiple frames so everyone looks their best.
Travel photography
Capture sunrises, sunsets, and landmark shots — no strangers, no cut-off limbs.
Real-estate & interiors
Use composition tools to line up the shot, and exposure bracketing to preserve detail in bright and dark areas.
Astrophotography
Stack multiple exposures for sharp, noise-free images of the Milky Way and Northern Lights.
Social media & lifestyle
Compose, pose, and shoot as many takes as you want — without relying on anyone else.

bluejetty:00024828:ios.description:
Calling all units, we have a Code 6!
In a crime-filled city, there’s only one officer who can help keep the law. It’s time to respond to the call and follow your duty, in Let’s Be Cops 3D. A dangerous driver is on the loose, and it’s your job to catch them! 
Watch the roads for oncoming drivers, keeping your eyes open for anyone not following the law. Think a car is speeding? Use your police scanner to get a closer look! Catch the criminals, and assess if they should be fined, let go, or arrested. 
Can’t handle the heat? Stay in your lane.
Let's Be Cops 3D features:
-Be a cop!
-Chase down criminals
-Customise your car!
-Multiple environments
-Protect the city!
SUBSCRIBE TO LET’S BE COPS 3D
Subscribe to Let's Be Cops 3D for all of the following benefits:
No Ads
x2 Earnings
VIP Outfit
Exclusive “Police Chase” Mini Game
SUBSCRIPTIONS INFORMATION:
Let’s Be Cops 3D VIP Membership access offers two membership options:
1) A weekly subscription costing $5.49 per week after a 3 day FREE trial period.
2) A monthly subscription costing $14.49 per month.
After buying this subscription, you will unlock; no ads, which removes non-optional ads from the game, x2 earnings for your in-game currency, obtain an exclusive outfit to use in the game, and and an exclusive police chase mini game to play. 
 This is an auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will also be charged for renewal
The price notes are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may change and actual charges may be converted to local currency.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
- The payment is charged to your iTunes account after a confirmation of purchase
- The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period at the standard cost of the weekly subscription
- The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal by accessing the user's account settings after purchase in the store
- No cancellation of the current subscription is permitted during the active subscription period
- Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when the subscription is purchased
Cancelling a trial or subscription:
- In order to cancel a subscription during the free trial period you need to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.
http://privacy.servers.kwalee.com/privacy/LetsBeCopsEULA.html

bluejetty:00098366:ios.description:
Welcome to Brainrot Merge – a uniquely chaotic italian merge puzzle game where strategy meets satisfaction.
In Brainrot Merge, your goal is to combine viral brainrot characters to fulfill customer orders and progress through endlessly fun levels.
Whether you're playing for a quick break or a longer session, the fast-paced gameplay and unexpected character drops will keep you engaged.
Merge the Brainrot Universe
Collect and merge your favorite characters from the viral brainrot world:
Tung Tung Sahur
Boneca Ambalabu
Ballerina Cappucina
Tralalero Tralala
Frigo Camelo
Girafa Celeste
Trippi Troppi
Lirili Lalila
Brr Brr Patapim
…and many more
Each character brings its own unique personality and chaos. Can you unlock them all?
Game Modes
Merge Royale 30
Compete against 30 players in real time. Merge quickly, score higher, and climb the leaderboard.
Merge Masters Mode
Play on a global leaderboard. Merge strategically, score big, and prove your skills among players worldwide.
Features
Fast-paced merge gameplay that rewards smart decisions
Order-based levels that introduce unique merge challenges
Strategic depth with every move you make
A growing cast of chaotic brainrot characters
Clean and minimal visuals that focus on gameplay
How to Play
Drag characters into the box
Merge matching characters to upgrade them
Complete the order shown above the box
Level up and unlock new surprises
Why You'll Enjoy Brainrot Merge
Quick and rewarding puzzle mechanics
Relaxing and satisfying merge experience
A mix of strategy and humor from the brainrot universe
Frequent updates and new characters
Download Brainrot Merge now and join the growing community of players enjoying this one-of-a-kind puzzle experience.
How far can you go?

bluejetty:00149859:ios.summary: Have you ever had a moment where you weren’t sure what to say, or who to call, when approached by law enforcement? Police encounters can happen to anyone, anytime, anywhere. With Attorney Shield, real legal backup is already in your pocket,
bluejetty:00149859:ios.description:
Have you ever had a moment where you weren’t sure what to say, or who to call, when approached by law enforcement? Police encounters can happen to anyone, anytime, anywhere. With Attorney Shield, real legal backup is already in your pocket, available the moment you need it. 
HERE'S HOW ATTORNEY SHIELD WORKS:
1. Open the app - Anytime you’re stopped, questioned, or approached by police.
2. Request legal support - One tap connects you to a licensed attorney—no searching, no waiting.
3. Get immediate guidance - Your attorney helps you know what to say (and what not to), so you stay calm and protected.
FEATURES THAT SAFEGUARD YOU
~24/7 Video Calls: Instantly connect with a licensed attorney, anytime you need support.
~ Fast Attorney Connection: Feel confident with real-time support during critical moments.
~ Secure Video Sessions: Your calls are automatically recorded and safely stored for your peace of mind.
~ Emergency Alerts: Your live location and details are shared with trusted contacts the moment you request support.
~ Document Storage: Never search for your ID or documents—they’re always at your fingertips.
~ PIN to End: End your session on your terms for added security.
~ Individual & Family Plans: Support that fits your needs, whether it’s just you or those who matter most.
~ Covered Encounters: Support for everyday situations; traffic stops, pedestrian stops, accidents, and more.
OUR WORRY-FREE GUARANTEE 
Every Attorney Shield member gets extra peace of mind with our Member Protection Warranty. If you face out-of-pocket costs like traffic fines, towing, court fees, or even vehicle damage after a covered police-initiated encounter, we’ll reimburse you for qualified claims.
Our help doesn’t end when the encounter does. 
EXPERIENCED ATTORNEYS, NATIONWIDE
Wherever you are, you’re backed by a nationwide network of licensed attorneys with an average of 16 years’ experience and expertise across multiple areas of law.
Our attorneys are trained to advocate on your behalf, protect your rights, de-escalate tense situations, and guide you through any police encounter to achieve the best possible outcome. 
THE ATTORNEY APP FOR EVERYONE
Police encounters can happen when you least expect them. With Attorney Shield, you’ll always have fast access to licensed attorneys; no waiting, no runaround, no retainers, and no extra fees. Just clear guidance when it matters most. Whether it’s for you or someone you care about, help is always one tap away. Download the attorney app and move through life with confidence.
TERMS OF SERVICE: https://attorney-shield.com/policies/terms-of-service
PRIVACY POLICY: https://attorney-shield.com/policies/privacy-policy
WARRANTY INFORMATION: https://attorney-shield.com/pages/warranty-info

bluejetty:00073480:ios.name: Muslim Pro: Quran & Athan
bluejetty:00073480:ios.summary: Muslim Pro is a prayer and Quran app built for Muslims who want to build a consistent daily prayer habit, read and listen to the Quran, and find their Qibla direction anywhere in the world. It's especially useful for people managing prayer
bluejetty:00073480:ios.description:
Muslim Pro is a prayer and Quran app built for Muslims who want to build a consistent daily prayer habit, read and listen to the Quran, and find their Qibla direction anywhere in the world. It's especially useful for people managing prayer times while traveling, students memorizing Quran, and anyone building consistency with daily prayers and fasting.
Core features
Accurate Prayer Times & Alerts: Get real-time Athan notifications calculated from your exact location, so you never miss a prayer window whether you're at home or traveling.
Al Quran: Read, Listen & Memorize: Access the complete Holy Quran with audio recitations from multiple reciters and translations in your language, plus dedicated tools for memorization and daily reflection.
Qibla Finder & Islamic Calendar: Instantly find your prayer direction using your phone's compass, and track important Islamic dates with accurate Hijri date calculation.
Prayer & Fasting Tracker: Log your five daily prayers and fasting days to build lasting consistency. Visible streaks and gently timed reminders turn a daily intention into an actual habit.
Duas & Dhikr: A curated collection of daily supplications and remembrance for specific moments (waking up, traveling, eating, difficulty), plus a built-in tasbih counter to track your dhikr, so you always have the right dua on hand.
How does Muslim Pro help me build a consistent prayer habit?
The Prayer & Fasting Tracker logs every prayer and fast automatically, builds a visible streak, and sends reminders timed to your location, so consistency becomes something you can see and reinforce every day, not just something you're aiming for. Gamified Quests add small daily rewards (Stars & Crescents) that reinforce the habit further.
Can Muslim Pro help me during Ramadan?
Yes. The app calculates accurate suhoor and iftar times based on your location, and the Prayer & Fasting Tracker lets you log each fasting day and build a streak throughout the month.
Does Muslim Pro work when I'm traveling?
Yes. Prayer times, Qibla direction, and Athan notifications update automatically based on your current location, and the Halal Restaurant & Prayer Space Finder helps you find nearby options wherever you are.
Is the Quran available offline?
Premium subscribers get offline access to Quran text and audio recitations, so you can read and listen without an internet connection.
More in the app
Halal Restaurants & Prayer Spaces Nearby: find halal eateries and prayer spots wherever you are.
Journaling: track your habit-building progress with mood tracking, picture journaling, and personal notes.
Ummah Pro: a moderated space to share duas and connect with other users.
Gamified Quests: earn Stars & Crescents for completing daily acts of practice, reinforcing your habit over time.
Muslim Pro Premium
Ad-free experience.
Offline Quran reading and audio recitation.
Customizable prayer widgets and interactive lessons.
Pricing (US): $12.99/month or $34.99/year. Pricing varies by country and is charged in local currency. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends; manage this in your Apple account settings.
Available in: English, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Français, العربية, اردو, and more.
Connect: muslimpro.com, Instagram @MuslimProOfficial, TikTok @MuslimProOfficial, YouTube MuslimProApp, Facebook MuslimPro, X @MuslimPro
Privacy Policy: https://support.muslimpro.com/hc/en-us/articles/203485970-Privacy-Policy
Terms of Use: https://support.muslimpro.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001016508-Terms-Of-Use

bluejetty:00131089:ios.description:
Elevate your goal-setting game with Gola! Our app lets you create and track seven goal types, with customizable widgets and reminders to keep you on track. Plus, our AI provides expert advice to help you reach your goals faster. Download Gola now and take control of your success!
■ Pick one of 7 different goal types
Whether you want to save up for a dream vacation, hit a fitness milestone, or learn a new skill, Gola has got you covered.
SINGLE GOAL → This is the generic single-task goal (e.g., Learn a new skill)
TASKS → You need to finish multiple goals to complete this.
PROGRESS GOAL → A goal on which you will make progress as the year passes (e.g., Run 43KM)
VALUE GOAL → Same as progress, but you need to give each input a title and date (e.g., Read 12 books)
OPEN PROGRESS → This progress goal completes when the year is finished (e.g., Swim as much as possible)
COUNTDOWN → Set a start and end date and let this goal count down till it’s completed (e.g., Don't drink alcohol for one month)
STREAK → Track a streak of consecutive completions (e.g. Daily meditation)
■ Get help achieving your goals with the power of AI
One of the best things about Gola is that it harnesses the power of AI to help you achieve your goals. With personalized recommendations and targeted support, the app can help you stay on track and make meaningful progress towards your goals. Whether you need a little extra motivation or some practical advice on getting started, Gola is the app for you.
AI will also help you generate small, actionable tasks that you can do right now to make progress on any of your goals.
■ Interactive Widgets
Widgets in Gola are now configurable and interactive! Before, you could only show a random goal. Now you can set it to a random goal OR configure it to a fixed goal, so you’ll never lose track of it.
In summary, if you're looking for a powerful, flexible, and easy-to-use goal-setting app, look no further than Gola. With a range of features and tools designed to help you achieve your goals, it's the perfect app for anyone looking to make meaningful progress and positive changes in their lives. So why wait? Download Gola today and start making your goals a reality!
■ More Features
- Many available templates to help you challenge yourself
- Interactive charts: See your progress in a clear manner with new charts
- Create different types of goals
- Get reminded via notifications whenever you want
- Add icons or emojis to your goals for more joy
- Use shortcuts or ask Siri to check in on your goals
- See how far the year progresses as we go
- Add widgets to your Home Screen & Lock Screen to see the year's progress, to open Gola quickly or to show a random goal
- Select one of the many available themes to use the app in a color that you like.
- Sort your goals by Creation Date or Last Updated
- Hear fun little sounds as you make progress and create goals
- Confetti when you complete a goal!
- Accessible to everyone
- Control if you like haptics or not
- Have goals that you only want visible to your own eyes? Now you can set them up as private.
And this is just the beginning... There are a lot of fun new features planned to be added really soon!
The free version of Gola is free forever and ad-free. If you’re looking for the best way to track a few of your bigger goals, downloading this app is a great place to start.
With an in-app subscription to Gola Pro or a one-time purchase, you’ll get the following things: unlimited goals, more types of goals, advanced settings, and access to all future features.

bluejetty:00126809:ios.description:
Welcome to Factverse, the ultimate dopamine-powered app for people who love to learn something new every day! 
Discover over 10,000+ fun, random, and mind-blowing facts that will make you say, “No way, that’s real?!”
Every scroll in Factverse gives you a quick hit of curiosity, wonder, and knowledge — all packed into one beautiful daily experience.
 EXPLORE THE UNIVERSE OF FACTS
Factverse isn’t just another trivia app — it’s a journey through the most fascinating parts of the world around you.
Dive deep into dozens of categories, including:
- Psychology Facts – Understand how the human mind works.
- Love & Relationships – Discover surprising truths about attraction and emotions.
- Science & Space – From atoms to galaxies, find facts that change the way you see the universe.
- Health & Body – Learn something new about your body every day.
- Technology & Innovation – Explore inventions and breakthroughs that shape our future.
- Life & Society – Find the weird, funny, and inspiring things that make life amazing.
 DAILY DOPAMINE HITS
Get fresh, inspiring content every single day.
Whether you’re waiting in line, relaxing before bed, or scrolling for fun — Factverse turns every minute into a learning moment.
Enable notifications and receive your “Fact of the Day” right on your lock screen.
 WHY MILLIONS LOVE FACTVERSE
• Over 10,000+ verified facts curated by experts.
• New facts added weekly — never run out of curiosity.
• Minimalist design built for dopamine-driven micro learning.
• Save and share your favorite facts with friends and family.
• Offline mode available — learn anywhere, anytime.
• Daily streaks and achievement badges to keep you motivated.
 GO PREMIUM – FACTVERSE+
Unlock everything the universe of facts has to offer:
• Access all premium categories (Psychology, Love, Science & more)
• Remove all ads
• Get early access to new content packs
• Support our mission to make learning fun and free for everyone
Subscribers to Factverse+ enjoy exclusive “Mind Expansion Packs” every week, filled with hundreds of fresh and surprising facts.
 WHY FACTVERSE STANDS OUT
Unlike boring trivia apps or quiz games, Factverse is built for instant learning and emotional impact.
Every fact is designed to make you feel something — surprise, joy, or awe — and give your brain a quick dopamine boost.
It’s the perfect balance between fun and education, combining science-backed micro-learning with viral social energy.
 JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Join thousands of curious minds who have already made Factverse part of their daily routine.
Challenge your friends, share your favorite discoveries, and spread curiosity across the world.
Factverse isn’t just an app — it’s a lifestyle for curious thinkers.
 Download Factverse today and start your dopamine learning journey.
Learn something new. Feel inspired. Expand your mind — one fact at a time.

bluejetty:00064579:ios.summary:

A few things to remember 
•
bluejetty:00064579:ios.description:
Our app provides a secure and easy way to bank on the go. 
Existing customer? Follow the prompts to login.
New to Bank Australia? Download the app to register as a customer and open selected accounts directly.
A few things to remember 
• Don’t keep your customer number and PIN with your mobile device. 
• Make sure to log out when you’re done. 
• The app will auto log out after five minutes of no activity. 
• Contact Bank Australia immediately if you’ve lost your device or feel that someone may know your login details. 
• Please check the BSB and account number or PayID details carefully. Bank Australia does not verify or confirm that the details you provided are correct, or that the account name and number or PayID match. If the details are incorrect you could be paying the wrong account and you may not be able to get your money back.
Everyday banking 
• ‘Secure Mail’ to safely manage digital communications with us. 
• Share your account details easily. 
• Set up and manage Round UPs. Have card purchases round up to the nearest pre-set amount, then transferred to a chosen account. 
• Nickname accounts. 
• Provide your Tax File Number or Foreign Tax Residency information. 
• View how much money you have / owe and net position of accounts. 
• Download up to 12 months of your transaction history. 
• Add a quick balance widget to your phone or Apple Watch. 
• Track spending via categories in the Spend Tracker. 
• Customise the length of time before you’re logged out of the app. 
• View your session history. 
• View information about your app / device via ‘Settings’. 
• Notify us of your travel plans. 
• View and manage eStatements. 
• Set up alerts based on your credit/debit card and account activity.
• Receive alerts when your loan is due / overdue or an account is overdrawn. 
• View product pages and click to apply via ‘Open account’. 
• Access calculators to help manage finances. 
• Manage Open Banking permissions.
• Locate and get directions to a branch. 
• Product and service information via pop ups and a ‘Latest news’ widget. 
• Personalise your logged in ‘smart dashboard’.
•*New* Search for a range of features from the home or menu screen.
Card management 
• Visa debit/credit card information securely available in Cards including *new* ‘Linked accounts’ section. Cancel and reorder cards, then get an instant digital version of it. Add details to a ‘Pay’ app and spend immediately. 
• Card Controls: manage credit/debit card features.
• Report a lost or stolen card, activate or change your card’s PIN.
Payments 
• Quick transfers. 
• Look Who’s Charging: see who’s charged your card. 
• Check balance/s and get a quick balance. 
• Transfer funds using Osko for fast payments. 
• Manage, save and edit payees. 
• Create and maintain PayIDs. 
• Transfer funds. 
• Pay bills. 
• Make international transfers. 
• Manage transaction limits.
NOTE: mobile data usage charges may apply, check with your mobile service provider for details. We collect anonymous information on how you use the application to perform statistical analysis of aggregate user behaviour. By installing this app, you are giving your consent. We do not collect personal information about you.

bluejetty:00061340:ios.description:
JobsGO - Việc tìm đến bạn mọi lúc, mọi nơi
Cách tìm việc & nộp hồ sơ hoàn toàn mới, cực kỳ đơn giản, hoàn toàn trên điện thoại di động
* Hệ thống chủ động tìm & gợi ý việc làm
• Bạn không còn phải duyệt qua hàng trang việc làm để tìm việc mình thích. Bạn chỉ cần tạo hồ sơ, và hệ thống sẽ chủ động tìm việc tốt nhất, phù hợp nhất cho bạn.
• Mỗi khi nhà tuyển dụng có việc làm mới phù hợp, bạn sẽ nhận được thông báo ngay lập tức.
* Nộp hồ sơ cực nhanh
• Chỉ một cái vuốt tay là hồ sơ của bạn đến được với nhà tuyển dụng.
• Nộp hồ sơ ngay cả khi bạn đang đi café, du lịch, chỉ cần một chiếc điện thoại nối mạng.
* Nhận phản hồi ngay lập tức
• Bạn không còn phải chờ đợi, dự đoán kết quả nộp đơn hay phỏng vấn. Bạn sẽ được thông báo mỗi khi nhà tuyển dụng xem hồ sơ của mình, lựa chọn hồ sơ hay yêu cầu phỏng vấn.
• Thông báo sẽ được gửi trực tiếp qua di động.
* Chat trực tiếp với nhà tuyển dụng
• Bạn có thể chat trực tiếp với nhà tuyển dụng trước khi có phỏng vấn để biết thêm thông tin, giải tỏa sự căng thẳng, lo lắng trước khi đi phỏng vấn.
* Tạo mẫu CV ấn tượng
• Gây ấn tượng và chinh phục nhà tuyển dụng ngay từ ban đầu với mẫu CV khác biệt, đẳng cấp. Thư viện mẫu CV trực quan, chi tiết sẽ đem lại hiệu quả thật bất ngờ.
* Kiếm tiền với Mạng Săn Nhân Sự đầu tiên tại Việt Nam
• Nền tảng giúp kết nối các bạn giới thiệu ứng viên (hunter) với các công ty có chính sách trả thưởng hấp dẫn
• Giới thiệu bạn bè công việc tốt. Nhận tiền thưởng khi bạn mình được tuyển.
Tải JobsGO về di động của bạn và sẵn sàng nhận việc làm ngay hôm nay!
**********
JobsGo - Let relevant jobs find you anytime anywhere
A new way to search & apply for jobs. Super simple. Only on mobile phones. 
* Smart job recommendation 
• Instead of searching & browsing through hundreds of pages to find jobs, our system will proactively searches & suggests the most relevant jobs for you
• Whenever employers post interesting jobs, you will be notified right away
* Apply for jobs instantly 
• Via just a swipe, your application will reach potential employers
• You can apply for jobs through a connected phone anytime anywhere
* Receive feedback immediately
• You will no longer wait for long to hear back about your applications. You will be notified immediately whenever an employer see your application, request for interview or ask for more information
• Notifications will come to your phone 
* Chat directly with potential employers
• You can even chat directly with employers before interviews to answer their concern, ask for more information, which eventually increases your chances of success. 
Download JobsGO to your phone now to get great jobs right away!

Luana Savings Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Luana Savings Bank:
• Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
• Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
• Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
• Transfer money between your accounts
• Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
• Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
• View and save your monthly statements
• Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Luana Savings Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Luana Savings Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Luana Savings Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.



Here’s what else you can do with Luana Savings Bank:


• Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
• Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
• Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
• Transfer money between your accounts
• Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
• Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
• View and save your monthly statements
• Find branches and ATMs near you



Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 



To use the Luana Savings Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Luana Savings Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00184619:ios.name: Train Merger: Idle Rail Tycoon
bluejetty:00184619:ios.summary: Dive into the world of Train Merger and build your ultimate railway empire. Merge trains to unlock new models, expand your rail network, and amass a fortune. Whether you’re a casual player or a train enthusiast, you’ll love this idle game t
bluejetty:00184619:ios.description:
Dive into the world of Train Merger and build your ultimate railway empire. Merge trains to unlock new models, expand your rail network, and amass a fortune. Whether you’re a casual player or a train enthusiast, you’ll love this idle game that combines relaxing gameplay with exciting tycoon-style management challenges.
Simple & Addictive Gameplay: Buy locomotives, merge trains to upgrade them, and manage your fleet to generate gold automatically. It’s easy to learn but offers strategic depth – fun for players of all ages. Watch your trains chug along and earn money even while you’re away!
60+ Authentic Trains: Unlock more than 60 train models inspired by real-life historic locomotives – from classic steam engines to modern high-speed trains. Train lovers will appreciate the attention to detail in this huge collection of engines!
Build a Railway Empire: Expand your train empire with stations and special structures. Upgrade your buildings to boost your profits and become a successful railroad tycoon. Smart investments will increase your idle earnings, even when you’re offline, so your business keeps growing.
Ultimate Challenge – The Golden Express: Work towards constructing the legendary Golden Express, a one-of-a-kind golden train to crown your empire and showcase your success. Can you conquer this final challenge and prove your status as the ultimate rail magnate?
Combos & Bonus Gold: Merge trains in quick succession to perform combo chains and earn huge bonus piles of gold. Use these rewards to unlock more train slots, invest in upgrades, and accelerate the growth of your empire.
Explore Diverse Landscapes: Send your trains across a variety of landscapes – deserts, forests, mountains, tropical islands, and even fun fantasy locations like Candy Land or Antarctica. Each region offers a new scenic backdrop for your expanding rail network.
Seasonal Events & Themes: Celebrate holidays in-game! Participate in special events for Halloween, Christmas, Easter, and more. Each event brings unique themed trains, festive decorations, and special rewards – collect exclusive train models available for a limited time.
Play Offline, Stress-Free: Keep earning idle rewards even when you’re offline. Your trains continue to haul in gold while you’re away, so your empire never stops growing. No internet connection needed – play anytime, anywhere, at your own pace.
Meet The Conductor: Get guidance from The Conductor, your personal mentor in Train Merger. He’s ready with tips, tricks, and encouragement to help you become a successful railroad entrepreneur and master every aspect of the game.
All aboard! Start your adventure today and become a railroad tycoon. Merge, build, and create your own rail legend in Train Merger: Idle Rail Tycoon. If you enjoy idle merge games or management simulators, this captivating train adventure is perfect for you. Hop on the train now and enjoy hours of fun while growing your empire!

bluejetty:00093591:ios.name: Labyrinth of Aetheria
bluejetty:00093591:ios.summary: Featuring an auto-mapping function to enhance playability on smartphones, it offers adventures filled with the discovery of rare items and battles with dangerous monsters, capturing the charm of classic games. Experience this retro adventur
bluejetty:00093591:ios.description:
Featuring an auto-mapping function to enhance playability on smartphones, it offers adventures filled with the discovery of rare items and battles with dangerous monsters, capturing the charm of classic games. Experience this retro adventure for yourself.
The setting is the frontier town of Aetheria, rumored to be the resting place of the legendary Holy Grail. Many adventurers, driven by the promise of immense rewards, converge here to take on the dangers of the dungeons. 
[Diverse Classes and Skills]
Adventurers can choose from a wide range of classes, from basic ones like fighters, thieves, priests, and mages, to advanced classes like paladins, samurais, ninjas, and sages. Each class comes with unique skills that influence party composition, strategy, and dungeon conquests. By changing classes, adventurers can combine different skills, creating unique characters.
[Town Facilities]
The town offers many facilities useful for adventures, such as item trading at shops, spell learning at the magic guild, and secret tool transactions at the thief guild. Quests can be undertaken at the adventurer's guild, and various clues for dungeon exploration can be found at the tavern. The grand mansion of Sylvan, the noble who sparked the adventurers' interest in the town, is also located here.
[Puzzles and Quests]
Numerous mysteries and mechanisms are found inside the dungeons. The use and location of key items are revealed through tavern rumors and dungeon discoveries, sometimes unlocking new paths after defeating powerful bosses.
[Collection Element]
Items found in the dungeons can be appraised, either by the adventurers' abilities or the town's appraiser, and registered in an item encyclopedia. This allows players to enjoy the collection aspect while progressing through the dungeon conquest.
[Story]
Sylvan, a major noble of the Astaros Kingdom, was one of its most influential figures. He was always in pursuit of gems and valuables. Among them, the most prized was the magical Holy Grail, rumored to be in the dungeon of the frontier town of Aetheria. Sylvan recruited adventurers to challenge the dungeon and obtain the Grail. Huge rewards were promised to those who could bring back the Holy Grail. Hearing these rumors, adventurers from all over gathered in Aetheria. However, none fully understood the danger of the dungeons. The reckless adventurers began exploring the dungeons in search of riches and fame.

Sylvan, a major noble of the Astaros Kingdom, was one of its most influential figures. He was always in pursuit of gems and valuables. Among them, the most prized was the magical Holy Grail, rumored to be in the dungeon of the frontier town of Aetheria. Sylvan recruited adventurers to challenge the dungeon and obtain the Grail. Huge rewards were promised to those who could bring back the Holy Grail. Hearing these rumors, adventurers from all over gathered in Aetheria. However, none fully understood the danger of the dungeons. The reckless adventurers began exploring the dungeons in search of riches and fame.

bluejetty:00164576:ios.summary:
Studying for your nurse aide certification and not sure where to start? CNA Practice Test is built around one thing: the exam you are actually going to sit.
Tell the app where you will test and it sets itself up for that state. Your mock
bluejetty:00164576:ios.description:
Studying for your nurse aide certification and not sure where to start? CNA Practice Test is built around one thing: the exam you are actually going to sit.
Tell the app where you will test and it sets itself up for that state. Your mock exam length, time limit and the weighting of every topic follow the format used in your state. A student in Texas and a student in California are not preparing for the same paper, and this app knows the difference.
PRACTICE THAT TEACHES
Over 1,000 original questions across 12 domains. Every one explains why the right answer is right, and why the answer you picked was wrong. No bare answer keys.
A REAL EXAM SIMULATION
Full-length mock exams with a briefing screen, a running clock, no feedback until you submit, and a question grid so you can skip and come back. Unanswered questions count as incorrect, exactly like the real thing. Leave the app and the clock pauses, so you can pick the exam back up where you left it.
A READINESS SCORE YOU CAN TRUST
Your score is weighted the way your state's exam is weighted, so it reflects the paper you will sit rather than a flat average. Topics you have not touched count as gaps, because on exam day they are.
STUDY MATERIAL, NOT JUST QUESTIONS
Study notes with must-know lists for every domain. Spaced-repetition flashcards built from the glossary and the question bank. A searchable glossary of terms and abbreviations. Hands-on skill checklists with the critical steps that most often fail candidates.
YOUR STATE, EXPLAINED
Who runs the exam where you live, how many questions, how long you get, whether an oral version is offered, and a checklist for exam day.
ORAL EXAM MODE
Turn on read-aloud and the app speaks each question and its options, useful if your state offers an oral version or if you simply learn better by ear.
BUILT FOR DAILY STUDY
Set a daily goal and an exam date, and the app tells you whether you are on track. Streaks, a seven-day chart, per-topic accuracy, missed-question review and bookmarks for a final pass.
WORKS ANYWHERE
Everything is on your device. No account, no sign-up, no internet needed. Your progress stays private and can be exported or deleted whenever you want.
FREE AND PRO
The free version lets you study every day, take a full mock exam and use the glossary, state guide, missed-question review and bookmarks. Pro removes the daily practice limit and unlocks the remaining mock exams, flashcard decks, study notes, skill checklists, longer sessions and topic analytics. Decide after you have tried it.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Some features require a paid subscription. Subscriptions are offered in different durations, and a one-time purchase may also be available. Prices are shown in the app before you buy and are charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price and duration unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings after purchase.
If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription. A trial converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial ends.
IMPORTANT
This app is independent study material. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any state nurse aide registry or testing company, and it does not contain real exam questions. It is not medical, nursing or legal advice. Exam formats, vendors and passing standards vary by state and change over time, so always confirm the current details in your state's candidate handbook.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/chintankavathiya/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/chintankavathiya/term-and-conditions

bluejetty:00028435:ios.description:

- Đổi ngày âm dương, xem các ngày lễ trong năm
- Suy niệm Lời Chúa mỗi ngày
- Thông báo ngày lễ trọng, lễ kính và nhắc nhở ghi chú
- Xem bài đọc và Lời Chúa mỗi ngày
- Xem chi tiết bài đọc và ngày lễ
- Chia sẻ câu Lời Chúa
- Xem danh sách các nhà thờ giáo xứ theo giáo phận, giáo hạt trong nước Việt Nam
* Tiện ích
- Bài đọc Kinh được cập nhật theo tháng, tổng hợp theo từng chủ để.

- Chức nănng đếm xuôi ngược tới những ngày lễ lớn, nhắc nhở người dùng những sự kiện quan trọng.
- Xem ngày tháng âm, dương, lịch chầu của từng tổng giáo phận theo địa điểm hiện tại.* Thông tin:
- Hệ thống lời Chúa được cập nhật liên tục, cùng các bài đọc, đáp ca, phúc âm theo ngày.
- Thông tin về bài đọc Lời Chúa trong ngày được cập nhật theo Lịch Phụng Vụ của Hội Đồng Giám Mục.
* Chú ý:
Những thông tin trong ứng dụng chỉ mang tính chất tham khảo, nên cân nhắc sử dụng ứng dụng trong lúc đang tham dự thánh lễ và các giờ cầu nguyện chung.

bluejetty:00041111:ios.description:
Your notes are yours. Notesnook encrypts every one of them on your device before it ever reaches the cloud — so no one can read them. Not advertisers, not us.
UNLIMITED NOTES. EVERY DEVICE. FREE.
Most note apps cap the free plan until it hurts. Others stop after a few dozen notes. Notesnook never limits how much you write or how many devices you sync.
A REAL EDITOR
Headings, tables, code blocks, maths, outlines, Markdown and full-quality images. Notes that hold up whether you are writing a shopping list or a thesis chapter.
ORGANISED AT ANY SIZE
Nested notebooks, tags, colours, pinned and favourite notes, and search that stays instant at 10,000 notes. Link notes to each other and build your own private wiki.
PRIVACY YOU CAN CHECK YOURSELF
• End-to-end encryption is always on — you cannot switch it off, so you cannot forget
• Encrypted on your device, in transit and at rest, using XChaCha20-Poly1305 and Argon2
• Even your notebook and tag names are encrypted
• 100% open source under AGPLv3 — read every line, or run your own sync server
• Recommended by Privacy Guides
IMPORT YOUR OLD NOTES
Bring your notes, notebooks and tags with you. Import from your previous notes app, plus plain Markdown and HTML files.
EVERYWHERE YOU WRITE
iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web. Sync is instant, and encrypted the whole way.
ALSO INSIDE
• Web clipper — save any article, ad-free and offline
• Reminders across all your devices
• Note version history, so nothing is ever really lost
• Publish a note to a shareable link
• Dark mode and custom themes
FREE FOREVER
Unlimited notes, unlimited devices, 50 notebooks, 50 tags and full end-to-end encryption. No ads. No trial countdown.
PAID PLANS
Add task lists, callouts, recurring reminders, more storage, and — on Pro — app lock, an encrypted vault and full-quality images. From $19.99 a year.
Questions or feedback: support@streetwriters.co
Privacy policy: https://notesnook.com/privacy
Terms: https://notesnook.com/terms

bluejetty:00041860:ios.description:
Say goodbye to boredom and embrace a brand-new challenge! Screw Escape 3D is here!
This isn’t just your average removal game—it’s a fun and brain-teasing screw-battle extravaganza! Are you ready to become the ultimate dismantle master?
Tap the boxes, remove the screws, and dismantle everything!
Observe the colored boxes in front of you carefully and unleash your creativity. These boxes will follow your commands, moving along the arrows' directions on top until they reach their target zones. Here’s the key: Once a box reaches the designated area, it automatically attracts screws of the same color on the model’s surface. When all the screws on the model fall, the entire model is dismantled!
Can’t-miss features:
-Relaxing and Brain-Teasing Gameplay: Easy to pick up, hard to put down! The controls are simple and intuitive, while the levels are filled with clever challenges to flex your brain anytime, anywhere!

-Wacky and Diverse Models to Dismantle: From delicious dishes to potted plants, musical instruments to toys, you’ll find a wide array of models to take apart, letting you experience the joy of hands-on disassembly!
-Collection Book for Achievement Bliss: Every time you successfully dismantle a new model, its beautiful image is added to your personal collection book, giving you a satisfying sense of accomplishment!
What are you waiting for? Download Screw Escape 3D now and join the ultimate screw-removing frenzy! Prove you’ve got what it takes to become a dismantling legend!

bluejetty:00014259:ios.name: GW Mailbox
bluejetty:00014259:ios.summary: GW Mailbox is a GroupWise email and calendar app for the iPhone and iPad. With this app you get a much better interface than Novell delivers by default through GroupWise WebAccess. This app gives you some of the enterprise features that you
bluejetty:00014259:ios.description:
GW Mailbox is a GroupWise email and calendar app for the iPhone and iPad. With this app you get a much better interface than Novell delivers by default through GroupWise WebAccess. This app gives you some of the enterprise features that you wouldn't get with simple POP/IMAP - like access to your Frequent Contacts and GroupWise address book.
This app is designed to work with a Novell GroupWise email server. Novell GroupWise is an email server like Lotus Notes or Microsoft Exchange. If you do not have access to a Novell GroupWise email account, this app will not work for you. Your IT department should be able to provide you with the URL to your company's GroupWise WebAccess server.
Key Features:
• Combined email, calendar and contacts access all in one app
• Uses iOS background processing to provide faster, more secure notifications
View emails
• View items in your GroupWise mailbox and other folders, including shared folders
• View, delete, reply and forward messages
• Move items between folders
• Attached documents are viewable through the GroupWise document converter, or they can be downloaded to view with other apps on your device
Compose
• Compose new email, appointments, tasks and notes
• Add attachments to new emails
• Search your GroupWise address books to select contacts when composing an email
View calendar events
• View your GroupWise calendar with one tap in either day, week or month view
• View an item's properties to see if an appointment has been accepted, an email has been viewed, etc.
• Accept or decline appointments, tasks and notes
View contacts
• Easily search all of your GroupWise address books including Frequent Contacts and your GroupWise System Address Book
• View a contact's details including phone number, email address and physical address
• One tap to use your iPhone to call a contact
• Email a contact using GW Mailbox or the iOS Mail app
• Create an appointment for a contact
New, advanced email notifications
• Better security
• Control how often mailbox is checked
• Banner notifications
Search in your folders
• Search in any of your GroupWise folders
Notice: GW Mailbox uses GroupWise WebAccess to get your email data. If your GroupWise administrator has not made GroupWise WebAccess available to you, GW Mailbox will not work for you. We support Novell Access Manager. But if your company uses a different proxy server, then GW Mailbox will not work. GW Mailbox requires an active internet connection.
Support:
iOS: This app requires iOS 9 or later.
Devices: GW Mailbox works with your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad, and requires an internet connection to work.
GroupWise: GW Mailbox has been tested to work with GroupWise 18, GroupWise 2014 R2, GroupWise 2014, GroupWise 2012, GroupWise 8, GroupWise 7 and GroupWise 6.5.
Note: GW Mailbox requires a subscription
Terms and Conditions: http://ghostpattern.com/Ghost_Pattern/Terms_And_Conditions.html
Please feel free to send us an email with any questions or comments that you may have. If you think you see a bug in the app, please send us an email! support@ghostpattern.com

bluejetty:00073289:ios.description:
Read, explore, search, and listen to the Holy Qur'an on the go with the most user-friendly Holy Qur'an app available - free and without ads.
Features:
QURAN:
The complete English translation with the option of having the original Arabic text or transliteration shown.
Listen to 10 different recitations, including English and Arabic (stream or download for offline mode)
Tafseer/Commentary by scholars across the world.
Add unlimited bookmarks with a note function and cloud backup to sync across devices.
Search any word within the Quran, and easily share verses (Ayat) or bookmarks with your friends
Customize the Quran app to your liking with dark mode and four beautiful Arabic and English fonts and font sizes.
DISCOVER
Discover the Holy Quran and Islam with numerous topics for the Muslim and non-Muslim readers.
QIBLAH COMPASS
Check Qiblah direction using a map view or compass
SALAH TIMES & PRAYER ALARMS
View prayer times based on your current location
Get notifications when it's time to pray
Use widgets to have prayer times on hand
PROGRESS TRACKING
Check how well you're doing on the Quran study progress with weekly and monthly achievments
Please Note: we NEVER share your personal data with third parties or the US government. We respect your right to privacy! Learn more about our Privacy Policy: https://quranapp.org/privacy While no translation of the Quran can be perfect, the translation we chose for this app was done by scholars in the United States and is part of no particular sect or school of thought. We compared many different translations, and this one is easy to understand and comes with a powerful English recitation by Imam Benjamin Bilal, so the user can follow along with the English audio. For a side-by-side comparison of this and other Holy Quran renderings in English, please visit our online Quran comparison project at EnglishQuran.com.
We strove hard to avoid any errors. However, should you find any mistakes or any bugs, please email us, and we will try to fix them as soon as possible with the next update. We sincerely thank you for all the great feedback and positive emails from so many of you.

bluejetty:00129094:ios.description:
The pedometer is an ideal app for tracking your running and walking workouts. It accurately records your routes, calculates the calories you burn, and measures the distance you cover. You can view your routes on maps for better visualization.
The pedometer keeps track of your step counts for 7 days, 1 month, and on a weekly basis. It also allows you to set daily walking goals, enabling you to stay motivated and achieve your targets. Additionally, you can start your exercise sessions based on a specific time.
Key Features:
- Precise activity tracking and step counting
- Detailed daily log history, including step counts, distance, calories burned, and walking time
- Customizable personal settings, such as sensitivity, metric/imperial units, step distance, body weight, and daily goal
- Synchronization with the Apple Watch app for seamless integration
- Support for Today widget, enabling easy monitoring of steps and burned calories without opening the app
- Step recording functionality
- Calorie estimation
- Speed measurement
- Daily Running Goal: Set a running goal and stay on track with our free running apps. Let us be your running distance tracker, helping you reach your fitness goals.
- Recording of step activity for an entire month
- Set and accomplish your running goals efficiently.
Overall, the improved text highlights the benefits of the GPS pedometer for tracking running and walking workouts while emphasizing its features and capabilities in a clearer and more concise manner.

bluejetty:00025594:ios.name: Meditation Timer - Zenitizer
bluejetty:00025594:ios.summary:
Take the next step on your meditation journey!
Do you find guided meditations distracting? Does the narration get in the way of reaching a deeper meditative state? It’s time to upgrade your practice with Zenitizer:
• Create routines that
bluejetty:00025594:ios.description:
Take the next step on your meditation journey!
Do you find guided meditations distracting? Does the narration get in the way of reaching a deeper meditative state? It’s time to upgrade your practice with Zenitizer:
• Create routines that work for you
• Stay in the moment with interval bells
• Immerse yourself in calming soundscapes
Zenitizer makes it easy to turn meditation into a daily habit minus the overthinking so you can embrace the serenity of now.
Download Zenitizer now to get started!
FEATURE OVERVIEW: 
• Clean & simple meditation timer
• Calming soundscapes help you relax
• Interval bells remind you to focus on the present moment
• Detailed, meaningful meditation statistics allow you to observe trends
• Set your daily meditation goal and track your streak to stay motivated
• Daily reminder notifications help you stay on track
• Make meditation part of your daily routine: Smart Reminders can notify you based on Focus modes, workouts, location, wake up & alarms and much more!
• Full meditation history view allowing you to see, edit or log individual sessions and reflect on your journey
• Interactive and StandBy Widgets: start meditations right from your Home Screen or Lock Screen
• Apple Health: store and sync your mindful minutes
• Save your favorite timer settings as routines
• Always keep your meditations, streaks and custom routines in sync via iCloud
• Widgets and Apple Watch complications: your goal at a glance
• Control Center: quickly toggle your favorite meditations
• Dark & tinted app icons & widgets
• Don't worry about breaking your streak: one minute a day is enough (you only need to reach your goal to grow the streak, not to keep it)
• Easily log past meditations without recording a timer session (just went on a mindful walk? Quickly save 30 mindful minutes)
• Siri Shortcuts: start routines, log meditations and query your goal and streaks. Imagine the possibilities! How about an automation to start a meditation, enable a Focus mode and set a HomeKit scene with a single command?
• Privacy-friendly by design: health data is securely stored on your device and, if enabled, in Apple Health and iCloud (fully encrypted). Your data is never sold to anyone!
• Spotlight Integration: quickly start or log meditations and check your goal and streak
FREE & POWER USER FEATURES:
Many of the core features are available for free but some functionality requires Zenitizer+, which is available as a one-time purchase or subscription (you choose which plan fits best into your life - they all unlock the full feature set).
Zenitizer+ allows you to create and manage routines, access the growing catalog of bell and background sounds, manually log meditations and fully customize your meditation experience. By upgrading to Zenitizer+ you can take your meditation experience to the next level and allow an independent app developer to continue improving and maintaining Zenitizer for a long time to come :)
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00030289:ios.name: AppHearing - Assistive hearing
bluejetty:00030289:ios.summary: AppHearing picks up the sound around you with your iPhone's microphone, cleans it up with noise reduction, EQ and dynamic compression, and plays it through your headphones in real time: soft sounds get louder, loud sounds stay comfortable,
bluejetty:00030289:ios.description:
AppHearing picks up the sound around you with your iPhone's microphone, cleans it up with noise reduction, EQ and dynamic compression, and plays it through your headphones in real time: soft sounds get louder, loud sounds stay comfortable, and voices and TV come through more clearly. When you'd rather read than strain to hear, turn on live captions.
HEAR MORE CLEARLY
• Real-time amplification with low latency, shown on screen while you listen
• Three levels of noise reduction, including a deep-learning mode for busy places
• Scenes for Quiet Room, Restaurant, Outdoors and TV — or save your own
• 16-band EQ with −24 dB to +24 dB per band, so you can lift just the pitches you miss
• A soft-sound boost to bring out quiet voices
• Conversation Mode uses the back microphone to focus on the person you're facing
TUNED TO YOUR EARS
• A short hearing check plays tones at six pitches for each ear
• Hearing Compensation then boosts the pitches you hear less well, giving soft sounds more lift and loud sounds less
• Settings can be remembered for each pair of headphones
READ WHAT PEOPLE SAY
• Live captions turn speech into text while you listen
• Recognition runs on your iPhone in the language of your device
NEVER MISS IMPORTANT SOUNDS
• Alerts for smoke alarms, sirens, the doorbell, knocking, a crying baby and ringing phones
• Vibration and a banner in the app, or a notification when it's in the background
EASY FOR EVERYONE
• Simple Mode shows just a big volume control and the scene
• "Can't Hear Anything?" checks the microphone, headphones and volume for you
• Start and stop with Siri, Shortcuts or Control Center, and see status in a Live Activity
• Supports Dynamic Type and VoiceOver
RECORD AND EDIT
• Record while you listen and play conversations, lectures and talks back later
• Adjust playback speed, pitch, reverb and EQ
• Trim, split and join recordings, change the volume and save as a new file
PRIVACY
Sound is processed on your iPhone. Your audio and captions are not uploaded.
AppHearing is not a medical device and does not replace a hearing aid fitted by a doctor or a professional hearing test. Use headphones, and start with a low volume.

bluejetty:00159235:ios.description:
Transform your family’s approach to value creation with Dinner Table, the premier app for kids and teens. Designed to foster financial literacy and spark meaningful conversations, Dinner Table turns household chores into valuable lessons on money management. Revolutionize your family's financial education and empower your kids with the skills they need to manage their finances wisely, all while contributing positively to the household.

Our groundbreaking "Gigs Method" makes Dinner Table a powerful tool for teaching financial literacy. It empowers children to create value both at home and within the community, earn money, manage expenses, and gear up for real-world financial challenges. For parents, Dinner Table offers a seamless solution to teach financial responsibility, saving both time and stress, while preparing your kids for a prosperous future.
Experience the Table Dinner difference and equip your kids with the knowledge to make and manage their own money today.
