bluejetty:00084150:ios.name: The Fishing Club 3D: Game on!
bluejetty:00084150:ios.summary: Welcome to The Fishing Club 3D, the realistic cross-platform 3D fishing game simulator. Since 2013, international fishing clubs have been competing in this realistic fishing game simulator, fishing not only for fame and glory, but also for
bluejetty:00084150:ios.description:
Welcome to The Fishing Club 3D, the realistic cross-platform 3D fishing game simulator. Since 2013, international fishing clubs have been competing in this realistic fishing game simulator, fishing not only for fame and glory, but also for great fishing game rewards.
Find the optimal combination of fishing rod, fishing line, bait and fishing hook to catch your trophy target-fish. Find recipes for bait, collect ingredients as bycatch, and create your own lures to catch huge fish. Complete your crafting collection with dozens of fishing game recipes.
Go on a virtual fishing trip in the 3D fishing game, relax and catch fish all over the world. Discover peaceful fishing spots in Europe, America, Africa, Australia and the sunny Caribbean. Experience the fishing game in stunning 3D graphics.
Many exciting fishing competitions are waiting for you in the 3D fishing game such as the popular flash fishing, weekly fishing tournaments, ranked club fishing, the battle and the fishing spot king, trophy fishing and much more. There is something for every angler in this 3D fishing game.
A friendly fishing community awaits you in the fishing game. Join one of the many fishing clubs in the fishing game or simply start your own fishing club.
Each fishing club has its own chat in the fishing game, where the members of the fishing club can chat undisturbed. Here you can get lots of tips about sport fishing, about the best fishing spots in the fishing game and here you can plan with your fishing friends to participate in one of the many fishing game competitions:
- Club Tournaments
- King-of-the-Spot / Fishing King sport fishing competitions
- Hundreds of hours of fun with quests and trophy hunting
- Complete your collection of hundreds of lifelike 3D fish to watch and catch. 
Fish with family and friends in this fishing game: Go 3D sport fishing around the planet and test your fishing skills. Chat in the fishing game with friends, clubmates and players from all over the world in the built-in chat rooms.
Cast your line on Lake Coho in America and catch fish like the Walleye, Muskie, Crappie, Bluegill, Smallmouth, Largemouth Bass, Salmon, Trout and many more.
Set your sails in the fishing game and start your sport fishing career in the Caribbean: from Florida you'll head to the blue waters of the Caribbean. Do you have what it takes to catch marlin, sharks, tuna, sailfish, mahi-mahi, snapper and many other exciting fish in the fishing game?
Explore the east coast of Australia with your boat in the fishing game and catch great white sharks, swordfish, black marlin and many more around the Great Barrier Reef.
Cast your lures in Europe and catch carp, pike, trout, zander and many other fish.
Venture into the heart of Africa, go fishing and catch Goliath Tigerfish, Kamba Catfish, Tigerfish and much more and find out what happened to a lost explorer in exciting quests.
Compete against other fishing clubs in PvP fishing game competitions and become the king of the fishing spot.
Take part in epic fishing competitions in the fishing game alone or with your fishing club and win fishing game prizes and fame and glory.
Catch over 200 different 3D fish species in this exciting fishing game.
Collect recipes and fishing ingredients to make your own fishing lures and boilies.
Join a fishing club or start your own.
Complete fishing quests and catch legendary fish like the mysterious tiger trout and many others in this fishing game.
Embark on an epic fishing game treasure hunt and catch the infamous shark Gorge Maw.
Earn dozens of fishing trophies and catch legendary trophy fish in this fishing game.
Go fishing and relax. Cast your line and experience the ultimate 3D fishing simulator. 
Install the popular 3D Fishing Game now!

bluejetty:00131091:ios.summary: Hidden Escape: Horror Mystery is a supernatural horror game that transports you into a scary world that will awaken your long-dormant fears. Join Ana, an investigative journalist, as she explores a haunted house and uncovers terrifying tale
bluejetty:00131091:ios.description:
Hidden Escape: Horror Mystery is a supernatural horror game that transports you into a scary world that will awaken your long-dormant fears. Join Ana, an investigative journalist, as she explores a haunted house and uncovers terrifying tales of ghosts bound by a dark presence.
Hidden Escape: Horror Mystery is a horror mystery game where you have to solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and piece together the secrets of the house’s morbid past. Follow Ana’s journey as she explores a decrepit, rotting mansion that has scary spooks and specters at every turn. As she learns to cross the threshold of her fears, she begins to help the ghosts overcome their tragic pasts. But it’s not the ghosts that terrify her. There is something more malignant, more insidious that lurks in the house. Something that threatens the essence of life and death. Something that wants to take everything away from her!
Help Ana decode the deeper mystery of the nature of the haunted house. Part horrifying, part tragic, and part untangling the enigma surrounding the grisly murders that have happened there. Join her and overcome all the scary traps and riddles set up by this hellish entity. Will she be able to solve the murders and escape before she falls prey to its mind-games? 
Help Ana free all the trapped souls in Hidden Escape: Horror Mystery. 
Key Features:
- A chilling point-and-click adventure game!
- A unique supernatural horror storyline!
- Eerily mysterious locations to explore! 
- Solve mind-boggling puzzles and riddles!
- Find strange hidden objects!
- Play addictive mini-games!
- Meet interesting characters!
- Dive deep into the world of hauntings!
- Solve the mystery of the haunted house!
- Get the whole game for free!
- Available in 7 languages (English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian)
About Vincell Studios
Vincell Studios is an indie mobile gaming studio that houses a team of seriously talented artists, designers, animators, and developers. Everyone at heart is a hardcore gamer with a goal to create unique and exciting hidden objects puzzle escape games that draw in players from every milieu and across age groups. Our passion for adventure and mystery escape games speaks through the compelling story lines, fascinating visuals and extraordinary hidden objects puzzles that we labor over and create.
VISIT US: http://vincellstudios.com/ 
Write to us at support@vincellstudios.com in case of any queries. We are happy to help!
Follow us on
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/vincellstudios.games 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/StudiosVincell 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hidden_escape_games 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTF62WRy9GGTyhi5pcDU1Mg

Kamelpay is the leading fintech company based in the UAE. It is a perfect partner for corporations for quick payment solutions that helps businesses to cater to all the payroll needs of low-income employees. The application provides employees with digital payment services and has the following benefits
● Send money remittance
● Secure Processing of transaction
● Mobile Top-ups
● Pay your bills
● Make online transactions with ease. 
● Keep a close eye on your finances through the application dashboard. 
● Get transaction history without any overhead charges
● Digital financial solutions
Core Products Of Kamelpay
Kamelpay core products include a WPS based payroll prepaid card and a corporate expense prepaid card
PayD Card - One-Window Payroll Solution
Kamelpay’s PayD card is perfect for companies to pay their low-income employees in compliance with WPS UAE regulations.
● Timely electronic salary disbursement.
● EMV-Compliant Mastercard prepaid card.
● Secures Salary Transferring Method
● 24x7 access to funds via ATM, POS, and e-commerce purchases.
● Convenient Salary Receiving Method
● Send Remittance In UAE
Kamelpay has a solution for a payroll management system within the UAE! The PayD card of Kamelpay is just the right partner the business and employees are looking for! These cards are easy to get and are also known to speed up the salary payout management in UAE! Many companies are stressed about providing the monthly wages of their employees on the same day! But doing this is not easy!
Centiv Card - Corporate Payment Made Easy
Our Centiv Card enables companies to switch low-value corporate expenses and reduce cash-handling operations. Also, this card works according to the Wage Protection System of the UAE.
● Higher load limits for expense management.
● Ideal solution for incentives, commissions, and rebates.
● Eliminate the need for cash and reimbursements.
● Eases the cash handling
● Tailored reports for periodic reconciliation

Important Notes
• The revamped mydlink app offers more intelligent, customizable, and intuitive smart home automation, as well as improved user experience, enriched features and increased usability. We want to ensure all users get optimal e
bluejetty:00126578:ios.description:
Important Notes
• The revamped mydlink app offers more intelligent, customizable, and intuitive smart home automation, as well as improved user experience, enriched features and increased usability. We want to ensure all users get optimal experience, in order to achieve this, the mydlink app will no longer support iOS versions below 10.3.4. If you are currently using iOS 10.3.4 or below we recommend you upgrade your mobile operating system as soon as possible.

bluejetty:00065909:ios.description:
Critical Strike is a fast-paced modern multiplayer FPS counter terrorist game.
Are you a fan of the good old counter terrorists battles? Enjoying online shooters and multiplayer gun games? There is the best 3D First Person Shooter in real-time.
Take the part in the vanguard at the battlefield of Critical Strike!
Play with your friends, you will love the multiplayer PvP shooting experience on your mobile device! Compete with people around the world and show your skills.
Fight against real players around the world over multiple game modes with 10 seconds of matchmaking and battles under 4 minutes.
===GAME FEATURES===
* AAA quality modern graphics with easy controls!
* 8+ maps to try different tactics!
* 40+ Weapons: pistols, snipers, assault rifles, shotguns, grenades!
* 5+ combat game modes to play with your friends and worldwide players!
* 250+ Skins with Unique Styles: AK47 Flash, AWP Comic Boom, Golden Deagle...
* Perfect optimization even for weak devices!
* Clan: Create your own clan and invite your friends to play together!
* League: Gain trophies as you get victories and move on to the next leagues.
* Voice and text chat with your friends and other players to socialize
* Arms Race Events: regularly updated themes and rewards for each update; Halloween, New Year, Easter..
GAME MODES
- Team Deathmatch : Team vs Team battle (counter terrorist VS terrorist team)
- Free for all : It's kill or be killed. Kill the other players as many times as you can.
- Defuse the Bomb : Terrorist team plant the bomb. Counter team defuse the bomb.
- Arms Race Tournament : All weapons are FREE to use. Competitive game mode to counter your enemies strike
- Control Point : Capture and defend zones. Teamwork is the key to hold strategic points.
- Kill Confirmed : Eliminate enemies and collect their tags to score. Confirm your kills to win.
- Private room : Call your friends to play together in same room.
===MORE FEATURES===
* Great 3D graphics and sound, so perfectly adapted for New Action Games
* Up to 5vs5 multiplayer online PvP battle mode, fair fight!
* Use less mobile data in real-time matches
* TOP 10 Online PvP FPS gun game!
* Many teams for counter (SWAT,GIGN,Spetsnaz,Seal...)
* Many teams for terrorist (Anarchist,Gangster,Balkans...)
This year’s best graphics 3D First Person Shooter experience will make you spend your time playing Critical Strike!
If you are dead don’t forget where you get hit for counter attack get your revenge!
Join the competitive combat in the most skill-based portable FPS!
If you always wanted to play a great multiplayer shooter on your mobile device, your dreams are now true!
You can enjoy the improved graphics and enticing sound effects of this free online FPS game!
Are you ready to strike counter enemies?

First person shooter and multiplayer shooting game made with Unity to optimize online FPS gun experience.
Become #1 in the worldwide CS leaderboard.
Regular game updates and new features are waiting for you!

bluejetty:00120483:ios.name: Play ABC, Alfie Atkins
bluejetty:00120483:ios.summary: Play with letters, sounds and words together with Alfie Atkins. Children love learning new things through play. This app, Play ABC, Alfie Atkins, stimulates children's language learning skills by clearly connecting the function and purpose
bluejetty:00120483:ios.description:
Play with letters, sounds and words together with Alfie Atkins. Children love learning new things through play. This app, Play ABC, Alfie Atkins, stimulates children's language learning skills by clearly connecting the function and purpose of letters in an experimental, playful way.
Alfie has some extraordinary devices in his room: a letter tracer, a word machine and a puppet theatre. With the letter tracer, children will learn the appearance and sound of all letters and train their motor skills and muscle memory by drawing and tracing letters on the screen. Using Alfie's homemade word machine, children will spell new words using phonemes and letter tips. All new words are sent to the puppet theatre, where children use their creativity and imagination to tell fantastic stories. This playloop, with concrete results, has a motivational effect and helps children develop their language skills at their own pace.
Play ABC, Alfie Atkins is developed by language teachers and game designers. It was created and tested in collaboration with teachers and students of schools in Finland and Sweden. The app has been developed based on children's needs and does not feature points, time limits or other elements that could lead to failure or stress. Children will play and learn using the app on their own terms and at their own pace, in preschool, at school or at home.
Play and learn:
 • The sounds, phonemes and names of letters
 • How to trace letters
 • How to spell around 100 different words
 • How to read simple words
 • Upper and lowercase letters
 • Fine motor skills and eye-hand coordination
 • The basics of literacy
 • Creative storytelling
The app is available in 6 different languages, and the full version allows the creation of individual profiles for multiple children.
Alfie Atkins, Willi Wiberg, Alphonse, Albert Åberg, Alfons Åberg – the popular character created in 1972 by Swedish author Gunilla Bergström, goes by many names. He is one of the most well-known Nordic children’s characters, known and loved by generations of children and parents through the best-selling series of books. Kids from 3 to 9 years old will love the game whether or not they already know Alfie.
Please note that family sharing of in-app purchases aren't supported by Apple. So if you want to purchase the full version of the app and share it with family members please purchase the separate premium, full version, of the app available on the Appstore instead.
Gro Play is an xEdu.co alumnus and member of the trade organization Swedish EdTech Industry. Gro Play collaborates with Playful Learning Center, the University of Helsinki, in the development of game-based learning. Please send your suggestions and feedback to info@groplay.com.

bluejetty:00036265:ios.description:
Discover a new way to shop at White House Black Market, WHBM with our all-new app. You can quickly and easily browse our entire collection of women’s clothing and accessories, from on-trend new arrivals to versatile closet staples. No matter what you’re looking for—dresses, blazers, skirts, sweaters, blouses, jeans and more—find your new favorite piece anytime, anywhere. 
We built our White House Black Market, WHBM brand on the foundation of fashion’s most iconic contrast: White + Black. That contradiction inspires everything we do, because we believe that no woman is any one thing. Confidence is your strong suit, elevated fashion is ours.

Push Notifications. Stay in the loop with White House Black Market’s, WHBM promotions and exclusive offers when you enable push notifications, so that you never miss a sale again. 
Save Your Favorites. Curate your dream closet by saving your favorite items in a wishlist for later. We’ll keep everything in one place for when you’re ready to make them yours.

Find A Store Near You. Love it so much that you need it now? Use the app to find the closest White House Black Market, WHBM store locations near you. 
Download the White House Black Market, WHBM app today for the easiest way to access it all, from style inspiration to special offers.

bluejetty:00115352:ios.name: Ivy Wood Block
bluejetty:00115352:ios.summary: Welcome to Ivy Wood Block! The ultimate free-to-play block puzzle journey designed for puzzle enthusiasts worldwide. Merging a cozy, rustic aesthetic with innovative strategic gameplay, Ivy Wood Block offers an immersive and brain-teasing c
bluejetty:00115352:ios.description:
Welcome to Ivy Wood Block! The ultimate free-to-play block puzzle journey designed for puzzle enthusiasts worldwide. Merging a cozy, rustic aesthetic with innovative strategic gameplay, Ivy Wood Block offers an immersive and brain-teasing challenge on a classic 8x8 grid. Whether you’re looking to unwind or push your logical limits, your next great puzzle adventure starts here.
If you love a classic wood block puzzle, calming brain games, and collecting beautiful memories, this is the perfect game for you. 
A Zen-like Puzzle Experience
Step into a world of polished wood textures and minimalist design. Ivy Wood Block provides a focused, meditative environment where every placement feels tactile, and every line cleared comes with a satisfying wooden click that melts your stress away.
Master the Art of Strategy
It’s easy to pick up, but hard to master. Beyond the relaxation lies a deep strategic challenge—plan your moves, build spectacular combos, and experience the mental clarity that comes with a perfectly executed "Multi-Clear." It’s a rewarding brain workout for those who love to push their logical limits.
Seamless Play, Anywhere, Anytime
Looking for the perfect no wifi game? Ivy Wood Block is a top choice for players who want fun without interruptions. Whether you are traveling, commuting, or simply unwinding in a spot with no connection, your puzzle journey never has to stop.
Travel the World & Collect Photos
Every move brings you closer to your next destination! Clear wood blocks to unlock stunning, high-quality landscape photos and travel postcards from around the world. Build your very own travel scrapbook as you solve each puzzle.
Features You’ll Love
● Timeless Wood Aesthetic: A minimalist UI designed to be easy on the eyes and soul.
● Satisfying Combos: Feel the "Multi-Clear" rush as you blast multiple rows at once—pure logic, pure satisfaction.
● No WiFi? No Problem: One of the most dependable no internet games for pure, uninterrupted fun.
● Daily Mindful Training: Keep your brain agile with quick, fresh challenges every single day.
● Free for Everyone: A premium puzzle experience that is completely free to play.
How to play:
● Drag the wood blocks onto the 8x8 grid.
● Fill a row or column to clear the blocks and earn points.
● Complete level goals to unlock beautiful travel photos!
● Keep the board clean and beat your high score.
Whether you are chasing a new high score or seeking a moment of rare tranquility, Ivy Wood Block delivers a sense of satisfaction unlike any other.
Download Ivy Wood Block today and let the peaceful clicking of wooden blocks guide you to your next high score!

bluejetty:00069477:ios.description:
Achieve your weight loss and muscle gain goals with 30 Days Fitness Challenge!
No equipment? No problem! We provide personalized home workout plans and professional guides. Say goodbye to excuses and hello to a healthier you. Get ready to reach your fitness goals with us, your trusted AI coach.
Get your desired shape with ease! We offer a wide variety of workout plans and a vast library of exercises, targeting every area. Customized workouts are also available, whether you want to lose weight or gain muscle, we've got you covered.
See incredible results in just 30 days! Sweat it out now and discover a fitter you!
Work out where you are and when you want. Get in shape faster!
* By analyzing your body data and preference, we will tailor a 30-day program for you to achieve goals faster and more effectively.
* Work out whenever, wherever! Whether you're at home, in the office, or on the go, our app is there for your fitness needs.
* No more dull workouts! Our app has a wide range of workouts, including aerobics, HIIT, and strength training, to keep your routine fun and exciting.
* Explore a variety of zero-equipment home workouts for all fitness levels. Quickly find any workout that fits your need with our app.
* No matter what confused you, ask the AI Trainer for instant answers. Turn your doubts into actionable insights, and achieve your fitness goals without question!
Amazing Features
- Personalized Plan: Weight loss and muscle gain plans tailored to match your goal and fitness level.
- Easy to Follow: Simple instructions and detailed videos will make it easy for you to perform exercises correctly and safely.
- Goal-Focused Training: 300+ specific workouts that focus on problem areas to meet your goals.
- Customized Workouts: Create workouts easily adapted to your preferences and needs.
- Fitness Coach: Burning calories will become easier and safer with our expertly designed workout programs.
- Daily Progress Tracker: Stay motivated and keep track of your daily workouts with our handy progress tracker.
- Apple Health: Sync your steps tracker with Apple Health for tracking daily steps and calories burned.
- AI Trainer: Ask any questions related to workouts, rest, and diet, and get accurate fitness guidance.
Subscription Terms and Details
- Get unlimited access to all features for USD $69.99/year.
- The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Privacy Policy: https://30dayfitness.leaphealth.fitness/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://30dayfitness.leaphealth.fitness/terms.html

bluejetty:00178791:ios.summary: Greifen Sie mit S-Invest auf Ihre Wertpapierbestände und Depots zu. Mit der Portfolio-Darstellung bekommen Sie über alle Depots hinweg eine klar strukturierte Übersicht. Sie können Depots übernehmen oder einrichten – auch jene von Fremdbank
bluejetty:00178791:ios.description:
Greifen Sie mit S-Invest auf Ihre Wertpapierbestände und Depots zu. Mit der Portfolio-Darstellung bekommen Sie über alle Depots hinweg eine klar strukturierte Übersicht. Sie können Depots übernehmen oder einrichten – auch jene von Fremdbanken.
VORTEILE
• greifen Sie auf Wertpapierbestände und Depots zu – egal, wo Sie sich befinden
• handeln Sie jederzeit – dank komfortabler Tools zur Depotverwaltung
• behalten Sie das Tagesgeschehen am Markt im Blick
S-Invest – eine Kooperation von Sparkasse und Deka – ermöglicht Ihnen, alle Wertpapierdepots in nur einer App zu verwalten. Neben Depots von Deka und Sparkassen, bevestor und S Broker binden Sie Depots von Fremdbanken ein, ohne einen Wechsel in Drittsysteme. Die App bietet viele Funktionen: Transaktionen, wie z.B. Kauf/Verkauf, bis hin zur Sparplanpflege – alles ist möglich. Es stehen alle Börsen, Direkt- oder Limithandelsplätze zur Verfügung. National, international und mit allen unterstützten Limitfunktionen. Die DekaBank liefert Ihnen passgenaue Infos rund um die Themen Investment und Märkte.
DEPOTS
Richten Sie beliebig viele Depots von Sparkassen bzw. Wertpapier-Partnern der Sparkassen - DekaBank (deka.de), S Broker, bevestor, fyndus, DepotMax - sowie Depots anderer Banken ein. Betrachten Sie Ihr Portfolio mit allen eingebundenen Depots oder Ihre Wertpapierbestände je Depot. Auch Detailansichten zu Anlageprodukten, Kursverlauf, Einzahlungen, Gesamtwert sowie Umsatzlisten, Portfolioanalyse, Orderbuch, Musterdepots und Depotwecker finden Sie in der App.
HANDEL
Werden Sie aktiv, kaufen und verkaufen Sie Wertpapiere. Suchen Sie nach Anlageprodukten und fordern Sie Kurse an. Angezeigt werden alle Börsen, Direkt- und Limithandelsplätze – national, international und mit allen unterstützten Limitfunktionen. Sie können Sparpläne anlegen und verwalten.
NEWS
Sie suchen Anregungen? Hier bekommen Sie Auskünfte, lernen Trends kennen, finden Tipps zur Optimierung Ihrer Strategie und profitieren von Experten-Einschätzungen zum aktuellen Markt- und Weltgeschehen.
MÄRKTE
Diese Ansicht liefert Ihnen die aktuellen Kurs- und Marktinformationen direkt in die App.
VORTEILE DURCH DIE SPARKASSEN
Haben Sie Konten bei einer Sparkasse, dann übernehmen Sie Ihre Depots direkt aus der App Sparkasse, führen Freigaben mit der App S-pushTAN durch und finden in S-Invest einen direkten Draht zur Sparkasse.
SICHERHEIT
S-Invest kommuniziert über geprüfte Schnittstellen mit den Finanzinstituten und sorgt für einen sicheren Datentransfer nach den deutschen Vorgaben zum Online-Banking. Alle Daten werden verschlüsselt gespeichert. Der Zugriff ist durch ein Passwort geschützt, optional auch durch Touch ID/Face ID. Die Autolock-Funktion sperrt die App nach einer Zeitspanne. Alle Finanzdaten sind bei Verlust maximal gesichert.
VORAUSSETZUNGEN
Sie benötigen ein für das Online-Banking (HBCI mit PIN/TAN bzw. FinTS mit PIN/TAN) freigeschaltetes Konto bei einer deutschen Sparkasse/Bank. Die unterstützten TAN-Verfahren sind chipTAN manuell, chipTAN QR, chipTAN comfort (optisch), pushTAN; smsTAN.
Im Online-Banking-Vertrag mit der Sparkasse ist geregelt, ob Sie Ihre DekaBank-Depots in der Internetfiliale und zusätzlich in S-Invest betrachten und handeln können. Um S-Invest zu nutzen, lassen Sie sich Ihre Depots für den Online-Wertpapierhandel freischalten.
HINWEISE
Support-Anfragen verschicken Sie bitte aus der App. Einzelne Funktionen können Kosten bei Ihrem Institut verursachen, die ggf. an Sie weitergereicht werden.
Den Schutz Ihrer Daten nehmen wir ernst. Er ist geregelt in der Datenschutzrichtlinie. Durch den Download und/oder die Verwendung der App erkennen Sie die Bedingungen des Endbenutzer-Lizenzvertrages der Star Finanz GmbH uneingeschränkt an:
• Datenschutz: https://cdn.starfinanz.de/index.php?id=datenschutzbestimmungen
• Nutzungsbedingungen: https://cdn.starfinanz.de/index.php?id=lizenzbestimmungen
• Barrierefreiheitserklärung: https://cdn.starfinanz.de/barrierefreiheitserklaerung-s-invest

S-Invest kommuniziert über geprüfte Schnittstellen mit den Finanzinstituten und sorgt für einen sicheren Datentransfer nach den deutschen Vorgaben zum Online-Banking. Im Online-Banking-Vertrag mit der Sparkasse ist geregelt, ob Sie Ihre DekaBank-Depots in der Internetfiliale und zusätzlich in S-Invest betrachten und handeln können. Um S-Invest zu nutzen, lassen Sie sich Ihre Depots für den Online-Wertpapierhandel freischalten.

bluejetty:00157332:ios.description:
You didn't fail the diet. Your metabolism stopped listening.
Olive is the AI health companion that finds what's keeping your body stuck and helps you fix it.
Inflame a cell long enough and it stops responding to its own signals for hunger, storage and energy. We call that metabolic resistance. It starts in your cart: in an NIH study, the same people on matched meals ate about 500 more calories a day on ultra-processed food.
96% of Olive members who scan 10 foods find one to rethink, and 3 in 4 find seed oils.
OLIVE IS FOR YOU IF
• You've tried diets, workouts, calorie counting and apps, maybe even GLP-1s, and the scale won't move.
• You crash by mid-afternoon, or live with brain fog, bloating, cravings or poor sleep.
• You want to know what's really in your food, water and skin care.
Nearly 1 in 2 Olive members told us weight gain is holding them back.
YOUR AI HEALTH COMPANION
• Ask Olive anything: what to eat, what to swap, why you feel off. Answers remember your goals and history.
• Daily check-in: log how you feel in a few taps, plus meals and peptide doses. Olive links what you eat to how you feel.

bluejetty:00120647:ios.name: TextEdit - Text Editor
bluejetty:00120647:ios.summary: TextEdit+ is the text editor your iPhone and iPad were missing. Like TextEdit on the Mac, it opens to a clean page and stays out of your way. Unlike it, it also speaks Markdown and LaTeX, marks up PDFs and puts an AI assistant right inside
bluejetty:00120647:ios.description:
TextEdit+ is the text editor your iPhone and iPad were missing. Like TextEdit on the Mac, it opens to a clean page and stays out of your way. Unlike it, it also speaks Markdown and LaTeX, marks up PDFs and puts an AI assistant right inside your document.
Jot down a quick TXT, format a rich-text letter, write a README in Markdown or compile a LaTeX paper. One lightweight app, no clutter.
ONE EDITOR, EVERY TEXT FORMAT
• Create and edit TXT, RTF, RTFD, Markdown and LaTeX files
• Open RTF files from macOS TextEdit, WordPad, Word and Scrivener, and keep working on them on your Mac or PC
• Open PDFs and mark them up with highlights, notes and text
• Work on files right where they live: Files, iCloud Drive or your cloud storage
• Organize your documents in folders and subfolders
A CLEAN PLACE TO WRITE
• Distraction-free editor with Full Screen and Typewriter modes
• Keep several documents open in tabs and switch with a tap
• Extended keyboard row for cursor moves, selection and the characters you use most
• Keyboard shortcuts for hardware keyboards
• Read Aloud with your choice of voice and speed
• Light and dark appearance, plus custom document colors
RICH TEXT WITHOUT THE BLOAT
• Fonts, sizes, colors, highlights, bold, italic, underline and strikethrough
• Alignment, indents, lists, line and paragraph spacing, superscript and subscript
• Insert images, tables and inline equations
• Install your own fonts and use them in any document
MARKDOWN AND LATEX, DONE PROPERLY
• Syntax highlighting for Markdown and TeX
• Live Markdown preview: edit, preview or split view side by side
• Compile LaTeX right on your device and preview the PDF next to your source
• Article, report, book and letter templates, command completion, error diagnostics and a document outline
• Multi-file projects with included files and bibliographies
AI THAT WORKS IN YOUR DOCUMENT
• Turn a prompt into a first draft
• Rewrite, shorten, expand, summarize or translate the selected text
• Fix grammar, spelling and punctuation, or switch the tone between casual, concise, friendly and professional
• Ask the assistant about your own documents and get answers with sources
• Prefer to write without AI? Hide every AI feature with one switch
TOOLS FOR EDITING
• Find and replace across the whole document
• Word, character, sentence, paragraph, line and page counts with reading time
• Readability scores: Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch–Kincaid Grade, SMOG and Automated Readability Index
• Automatic backups, so an edit is never lost
• Scan paper documents with the camera
EXPORT AND SHARE
• Export to PDF, Word (DOCX), RTF, RTFD, Markdown, TXT, TeX and PNG
• Print, email or send your work to any app
• Send text, links and files to TextEdit+ from other apps with the share sheet
• Shortcuts actions to create, open, search and rename documents
Built for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, and localized in more than 70 languages.
Privacy Policy
https://www.noteswriter.com/Kairoos_Privacy_Policy.html
Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00063313:ios.summary:
Build a powerful empire and fight epic battles against millions of players!
As Lord and King, you have been called upon to build a mighty fortress and control the fate of your kingdom in this award-winning medieval adventure MMO strategy ga
bluejetty:00063313:ios.description:
Build a powerful empire and fight epic battles against millions of players!
As Lord and King, you have been called upon to build a mighty fortress and control the fate of your kingdom in this award-winning medieval adventure MMO strategy game!
Use your strategy to outsmart your enemies!
Unlock powerful Generals and use their abilities to your advantage. It is not about who has the biggest army, but who can plan their every move in the most cunning way. Each General has special talents that will give you an edge to defeat opponents, but only when used wisely. Plan your strategy carefully and see if you are wily enough to outsmart your enemies!
Conquer new lands in four exciting kingdoms
Muster an army of valiant knights, equip your merciless troops with deadly weapons, improve their skills, and send them into battle to fight under your banner! Of course, every great empire also needs a strong defense - choose the right strategy to send your enemy’s army fleeing in terror!
Honor, glory, and riches!
Win rewards by achieving honor and glory in battle, and go from rags to riches by managing your kingdom wisely. Build your fortress from the foundations up, so that it becomes the mightiest across the land. Produce resources and trade with other players to expand your empire over multiple kingdoms. More land means more subjects - and more gold for you!
Forge powerful diplomatic alliances
Join forces with your friends and other lords to stand against your enemies and conquer new lands together! Support each other by sending resources or troops, or help each other to rebuild after an attack. United we stand!
This realistic medieval strategy MMO will transport you back to an age when power was everything and only the strongest survived. Prove that you've got what it takes to be the mightiest and most honourable lord in all the land!
* Create your civilization and become a king in this medieval strategy game
* Fight epic wars against countless other players on an interactive world map
* Build a majestic castle to withstand even your strongest opponents
* Raise an army of knights, archers, swordsmen, and more
* Form an unbeatable alliance with your friends and other powerful players
* Produce and trade resources to construct more than 60 different buildings
* Explore Empire: Four Kingdoms and become a true hero and legend!
* Regular updates with new content and challenges
Privacy Policy, Terms Conditions, and Imprint: https://policies.stillfront.com/
This app is completely free to play, requires an internet connection and offers optional in-app purchases.

iRecord is the perfect app for anyone looking to record high-quality voice recordings and transcribe them with advanced AI technology.   
With iRecord, you can:
* Record high-quality audio from phone, meetings, and lectures with ease, even in noisy environments or from a distance.
* Transcribe your recordings into text with high accuracy, thanks to our advanced AI techniques that won the championship of the International Automatic Speech Recognition Challenge in 2021.
* Export your recordings and transcripts into multiple formats, including Word and PDF, for easy sharing and collaboration.
* Share your recordings and transcripts via messaging apps like WhatsApp and Messenger, making it easy to collaborate with colleagues and friends.
 iRecord is packed with features that make it the perfect tool for recording and managing your voice recordings and transcripts.   Some of our standout features include:
* Live transcription: Our app can transcribe audio in real-time, making it easy to take meeting notes or keep track of lectures.
* Automated transcription: You can set up iRecord to automatically transcribe your recordings as soon as they're finished, saving you time and effort.

* Editing tools: Our app includes editing tools that  automatically capitalize, punctuate, and break paragraphs, as well as allow you to adjust and refine your transcripts after they've been transcribed.
* Speaker identification: iRecord can identify and label different speakers in your recordings, making it easy to follow along and understand who's speaking.
* Language support: iRecord can transcribe audio in a wide range of languages, making it a great tool for multilingual users.

bluejetty:00074124:ios.description:
Welcome to ""Wild West Cowboy"" - the ultimate frontier shooting western sniper adventure!
Step into the untamed world of the Wild West and unleash your inner gunslinger in this action-packed cowboy-themed app. Immerse yourself in a vivid wild west environment, inspired by the likes of Red Dead Redemption and Breath of the Wild, complete with dusty deserts, rugged canyons, and bustling frontier towns. It's time to put on your cowboy boots and show off your American marksman and bounty hunter skills! Be the sheriff in this town and prove yourself as a pure sniper of the wild west in one of the best cowboy games in the westworld.
In ""Wild West Cowboy,"" you'll face a variety of challenging enemies that stand in your way. Take aim, steady your hand, and let the bullets fly as you target and eliminate your foes with precision. Whether it's outlaws, bandits, or notorious gunslingers, you'll need nerves of steel to survive the treacherous wild west.
To aid you in your quest for justice, you'll have a trusty revolver by your side. But that's not all! Master the art of shooting bottles to improve your accuracy and showcase your marksmanship, just like an American marksman and many other western games. The true spirit of the Wild West sniper cowboy and the best Wild West games lies in your ability to hit your targets with deadly precision.
As you progress, you can unlock and upgrade various cowboy hats that not only add a touch of style but also provide unique benefits. Choose the perfect hat that complements your playstyle and enhances your performance in the field, just like the iconic hats of Red Dead Redemption western games. Keep an eye out for rare and legendary hats that offer unparalleled advantages and make you a west gunfighter in one of the coolest cowboy games in the westworld.
Your survival in this Wild West sniper game is not just about your shooting skills in one of the best cowboy games.. Take your western sniper and make strategic decisions to stay alive in the face of relentless adversaries. Upgrade your health to increase your resilience and endure the toughest challenges the frontier throws at you, just like surviving in Breath of the Wild and westland survival.
Speed is of the essence in the Wild West, and your aim and reload speed can make all the difference between triumph and defeat. Invest in upgrading these crucial attributes to gain a decisive edge in intense shootouts. Quick reflexes and lightning-fast reloads will set you apart as the fastest gun in this western game, just like the legendary gunslingers of the Wild West.
So, grab your hat, your five / six guns, strap on your holster, and prepare for an unforgettable journey through one of the best Wild West games. ""Wild West Cowboy"" offers an immersive shooting experience, captivating visuals, and thrilling gameplay that will transport you to a time when the law was scarce and courage westfield supreme. Channel your inner American marksman bounty hunter skills and become the legendary west gunfighter of the Wild West like in westland survival!
Are you ready to conquer the frontier in one of the coolest western games? Download ""Wild West Cowboy"" now and let the bullets fly!

bluejetty:00179543:ios.summary:
AUM is the flexible audio mixer, recorder, and connection hub for your iPad, iPhone and iPod touch.
Connect hardware inputs and outputs, Audio Unit extensions, Inter-App Audio apps, Audiobus, soundfile players, built-in signal processing a
bluejetty:00179543:ios.description:
AUM is the flexible audio mixer, recorder, and connection hub for your iPad, iPhone and iPod touch.
Connect hardware inputs and outputs, Audio Unit extensions, Inter-App Audio apps, Audiobus, soundfile players, built-in signal processing and filters, in any configuration you want.
Route anything to anywhere with mix-busses, effect sends, audiobus ports, and external multi-channel audio interfaces.
Play hosted synths and instruments using the built-in keyboard or external MIDI controllers, or sequence them with AU MIDI plugins or from other apps using Virtual MIDI.
Record mixes, individual tracks, or both, straight into the storage space of AudioShare (no copying of files needed), with synchronized start and end for perfect loops.
Play back recordings, soundfiles and loops as channel sources in the mixer for backing tracks, further processing or mixing. Soundfiles can be opened from anywhere, including USB drives on iOS 13 and later.
Route and filter MIDI in any way you like using the MIDI matrix. Combine and filter MIDI endpoints using MIDI buses.
Synchronize everything with the transport clock and play in time with other apps or devices using Ableton Link. Connect external music machines and synchronize them with MIDI Clock.
Includes built-in processing nodes for various stereo processing, Mid/Side balance and conversion, EQs and filters, limiting, clipping and saturation. Or use any 3rd party Audio Unit extension or Inter-App Audio effect.
All controls in the mixer can be controlled via MIDI, including parameters of hosted and built-in plugins.
"A brilliant idea that has been brilliantly executed. Top-notch technical stuff and highly recommended" - MusicAppBlog
"Feature rich, powerful, intuitive, and simple to use" - DubSpot
"Executes live mixing with surprising ease, with a load of extensive features under the hood, quick snappy response on the screen and audio" - AudioNewsRoom
FEATURES
• High quality audio up to 32-bit 192kHz
• Clean and intuitive user interface with crisp vector graphics
• Unlimited number of channels
• Unlimited number of effect slots
• Inserts and sends are configurable pre/post-fader
• Internal busses for mixing, effect sends, signal splitting
• Supports multi-channel audio interfaces for both inputs and outputs
• Supports built-in speaker and mic, including stereo mic on devices that has it.
• Supports Audio Unit extensions, Inter-App Audio and Audiobus 
• Route MIDI output from Audio Unit extensions
• Supports Audio Unit multiple output and input busses (for side-chaining etc)
• Highly accurate transport clock
• Metronome with selectable output and optional pre-roll
• Sends host sync to Audio Unit plugins and IAA apps
• Play in time with Ableton Link, with Start/Stop support
• Slave external hardware via MIDI Clock
• FilePlayer with sync and looping with access to all your soundfiles
• Records straight into AudioShare storage space
• Record synchronized beat-perfect loops
• Built-in nodes for stereo processing, filtering and dynamics
• Latency compensation makes everything align at the outputs
• Optional manual compensation using TimeOffset
• Multiple Inter-App Audio / Audiobus output ports
• Audiobus state saving
• Built-in MIDI keyboard
• Fully MIDI controllable
• MIDI Matrix for routing MIDI anywhere
• MIDI filtering for any MIDI destination
• Combine MIDI sources or destinations using MIDI buses
BUILT-IN SIGNAL PROCESSING
• Stereo balance
• Stereo to mono
• Stereo panning
• Mid/Side balance
• Mid/Side - Stereo convert
• Invert Phase
• Parametric EQ
• Low-shelf filter
• High-shelf filter
• Low-pass resonant filter
• High-pass resonant filter
• LP/HP combo filter
• First order All-pass filter
• Second order All-pass filter
• Gain
• Hard clip
• Saturation
• Lookahead peak limiter
• System-provided Apple Audio Units

bluejetty:00063878:ios.description:
Join over 14 million music lovers discovering piano. Learn the fun and easy way, no lessons needed.
Play songs, practice piano, and create music in one intuitive app.
Choose how you play: follow the rhythm in interactive gameplay to build timing and confidence, or switch to a realistic keyboard to explore chords, melodies, and your own musical ideas.
With Piano, you can jump right in. Play to the rhythm, explore notes and chords, and create music at your own pace.
Designed for iOS (iPhone & iPad), Piano offers a smooth, responsive playing experience with intuitive touch controls, clean visuals, and a simple layout. Perfect for beginners, casual players, and anyone who wants to enjoy piano practice without pressure.
Discover piano through interactive gameplay, creative tools, and realistic instrument sounds.
Play classical piano favorites like Für Elise Clair de Lune and Moonlight Sonata
Learn timeless works like Canon in D Ode to Joy and The Entertainer
Discover expressive piano pieces like Gymnopédie No 1 and Nocturne
Enjoy traditional songs like The Star Spangled Banner Amazing Grace and Yankee Doodle
Choose Your Mode 
- Rhythm Play: Interactive gameplay to build timing, coordination, and confidence.
- Freestyle Keyboard: A realistic instrument experience for practicing chords, melodies, and musical ideas.
Both modes are powerful practice tools, helping you focus on rhythm, control, and musical expression.
What You Can Do
Play to the rhythm
Follow timing cues, play step by step, and learn how songs come together.
Freestyle Keyboard
Use a full piano keyboard with real notes & chords, ideal for practicing, exploration, or composing your own melodies freely.
Responsive Touch Keys
Enjoy smooth, accurate playing with touch-sensitive keys built for a great iOS experience.
Create, Record & Share
Go beyond practicing; turn your ideas into real music. Record your performances, capture your progress, and share your journey with friends and a global community of players.
Multiple Instruments
Play grand piano, electric keys, xylophone, and more. A wide range of authentic sounds.
Progress as You Play
Unlock songs, earn rewards, and move from simple tunes to more advanced arrangements.
Explore Every Genre
Play classical masterpieces, pop hits, jazz, kids' songs, film themes, and more.
Enjoy music from Mozart, Beethoven, Chopin, Tchaikovsky, Vivaldi, Bach, Strauss, and Verdi, alongside modern favorites like Bella Ciao and Twinkle Twinkle.
Search, browse, and jump into any song you want to play.
Piano Pro
Upgrade to unlock the full experience:
• Unlimited songs to play
• Multiple instrument sounds
• Ad-free practice
• Record with perfect timing
Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal.
Manage subscriptions in your App Store settings.
Terms & Privacy: https://impalastudios.com/terms | https://impalastudios.com/privacy 
Feedback & Support
We'd love to hear from you: support@impalastudios.com

Piano is a go-to app for learning, playing, and performing music - trusted and loved worldwide.

Impala Studios creates popular apps designed to make everyday life more fun and enjoyable. From music and games to productivity tools, our apps are built for iPhone and iPad users around the world. With Piano, we bring millions of music lovers together to play, learn, and share songs every day.

Imagine a radio station that always plays what you care about. That's InstaPodz.
Catch up on the latest news while you get ready. Dive into tech trends on your commute. Or just kick back with a good story while you do the dishes. Whatever you're into, just tap and start listening. It's that easy.
Oh, and everything is made for you. Pick the length that fits your schedule (got 5 minutes? perfect. got 30? even better). - Listen in 20+ languages. Create and listen to shows in English, Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, and more. You can even adjust the English level to match where you are.
We're just getting started and we'd love to hear from you. Drop us a note at [support@instapodz.com](mailto:support@instapodz.com). We read everything.

bluejetty:00033639:ios.summary:
Koupon is a free coupon and deals app that finds verified promo codes, discounts, and price drops across Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Best Buy, Macy's and Woot, and tests every code before you see it.
If you're seeking daily deals, promo codes,
bluejetty:00033639:ios.description:
Koupon is a free coupon and deals app that finds verified promo codes, discounts, and price drops across Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Best Buy, Macy's and Woot, and tests every code before you see it.
If you're seeking daily deals, promo codes, or coupons for the brands and stores you already shop, Koupon brings them into one place and checks them so you don't have to. 
HOW WE VERIFY EVERY CODE 
Most coupon apps list codes nobody has tested. Koupon checks each one twice. Our system tests the code automatically, confirming it works, what discount it gives, and which products it applies to. Our editors then review what the system found and catch what automation can't: misleading terms, regional limits, and deals that are technically valid but not worth your time. A code only goes live when both agree.
Verification doesn't stop at publishing. Every live deal is monitored, re-checked on a regular schedule, and flagged or removed when it stops working. Our systems process over 10 million verification checks every day. Each deal shows when it was last verified, so you always know how fresh it is. Spot a code that failed? Tap Report on any deal page and it goes straight into our verification queue. 
DAILY DEALS, DISCOUNTS & PRICE DROPS 
New deals land every day. Seek deals by discount percentage, price drop, or category, and check the discount history and deal quality before you buy. Set alerts for all-time lows, flash sales, and trending products so the best prices reach you first. 
COUPONS FOR YOUR FAVORITE BRANDS 
Browse verified coupons and deals for over 3000 brands, including Apple, Samsung, Nike, Dyson, LEGO, Sony, KitchenAid, and Stanley. Follow the brands you love and never miss a markdown. 
SHOP BY CATEGORY 
Find savings across every category you shop: 
- Electronics: laptops, TVs, headphones, smart home 
- Fashion: clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry 
- Home & Kitchen: appliances, furniture, bedding, cookware 
- Beauty & Health: skincare, makeup, vitamins, personal care 
- Baby, Pet, Toys, Sports & Outdoors, Grocery, Automotive, and more
BLACK FRIDAY, PRIME DAY & SEASONAL SALES 
When the big sales hit, Koupon tracks them live: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Amazon Prime Day, Back to School, and the holiday season. Get the verified codes and lowest prices as they drop, not the day after.
AMAZON, WALMART, EBAY & MORE 
One search covers Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Best Buy, and Woot. Compare deals across stores without opening five apps. 
YOUR CHECKOUT STAYS WITH THE RETAILER 
Apply codes directly at the retailer's checkout. Your purchase and payment happen on the retailer's site, and Koupon never processes your payment. Koupon earns a commission on some purchases, which never changes the price you pay or the deals we show you.
Join 20M+ shoppers worldwide who save with Koupon. Rated 4.9 with over 5 Million Downloads.

listings.name: Koupon: Promo Codes & Deals
listings.description:
Koupon is a free coupon and deals app that finds verified promo codes, discounts, and price drops across Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Best Buy, Macy's and Woot, and tests every code before you see it.

If you're seeking daily deals, promo codes, or coupons for the brands and stores you already shop, Koupon brings them into one place and checks them so you don't have to. 

HOW WE VERIFY EVERY CODE 
Most coupon apps list codes nobody has tested. Koupon checks each one twice. Our system tests the code automatically, confirming it works, what discount it gives, and which products it applies to. Our editors then review what the system found and catch what automation can't: misleading terms, regional limits, and deals that are technically valid but not worth your time. A code only goes live when both agree.

Verification doesn't stop at publishing. Every live deal is monitored, re-checked on a regular schedule, and flagged or removed when it stops working. Our systems process over 10 million verification checks every day. Each deal shows when it was last verified, so you always know how fresh it is. Spot a code that failed? Tap Report on any deal page and it goes straight into our verification queue. 

DAILY DEALS, DISCOUNTS & PRICE DROPS 
New deals land every day. Seek deals by discount percentage, price drop, or category, and check the discount history and deal quality before you buy. Set alerts for all-time lows, flash sales, and trending products so the best prices reach you first. 

COUPONS FOR YOUR FAVORITE BRANDS 
Browse verified coupons and deals for over 3000 brands, including Apple, Samsung, Nike, Dyson, LEGO, Sony, KitchenAid, and Stanley. Follow the brands you love and never miss a markdown. 

SHOP BY CATEGORY 
Find savings across every category you shop: 
- Electronics: laptops, TVs, headphones, smart home 
- Fashion: clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry 
- Home & Kitchen: appliances, furniture, bedding, cookware 
- Beauty & Health: skincare, makeup, vitamins, personal care 
- Baby, Pet, Toys, Sports & Outdoors, Grocery, Automotive, and more

BLACK FRIDAY, PRIME DAY & SEASONAL SALES 
When the big sales hit, Koupon tracks them live: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Amazon Prime Day, Back to School, and the holiday season. Get the verified codes and lowest prices as they drop, not the day after.

AMAZON, WALMART, EBAY & MORE 
One search covers Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Best Buy, and Woot. Compare deals across stores without opening five apps. 

YOUR CHECKOUT STAYS WITH THE RETAILER 
Apply codes directly at the retailer's checkout. Your purchase and payment happen on the retailer's site, and Koupon never processes your payment. Koupon earns a commission on some purchases, which never changes the price you pay or the deals we show you.

Join 20M+ shoppers worldwide who save with Koupon. Rated 4.9 with over 5 Million Downloads.

From App to Anywhere!
With Free2move, access a car whenever you need one – without the costs and commitments of ownership or the hassle of traditional car rentals.
Find, book, and unlock a car right from your phone in seconds.
Drive by the minute, hour, or day for errands, commutes, business trips, airport runs, weekend escapes, and more.
No rental counters. No paperwork. No waiting around.
Insurance, fuel or charging, and parking are included, so all you have to do is drive.
WHY CHOOSE FREE2MOVE?
• Find and unlock a car in seconds with the app
• Drive by the minute, hour, or day – and only pay for what you use
• Book instantly or reserve ahead for complete flexibility
• Insurance, fuel or charging, and parking included
• Perfect for personal trips and business travel
• Access a growing fleet of electric vehicles across Europe
DRIVE BY THE MINUTE
Need a car for a quick trip? Perfect for errands, commuting, shopping, and getting around the city.
DRIVE BY THE HOUR
Ideal for meetings, appointments, visiting friends, or exploring somewhere new.
DRIVE BY THE DAY
Book a car for up to 30 days for road trips, weekends away, and longer adventures.
AIRPORT TRAVEL, MADE EASY
Heading to the airport or landing in a new city? Free2move is available at 17 major airport hubs across Europe, making it easy to keep moving wherever your journey takes you.
CAR-SHARING FOR BUSINESS
Give your team access to vehicles without the hassle of managing a fleet. Create a corporate account, track usage, and stay in control of mobility costs – all from the app.
DRIVING THE FUTURE OF MOBILITY
Over 30% of the global Free2move fleet is already electric, with several cities operating fully electric fleets. Every shared Free2move vehicle helps reduce congestion and can replace up to 17 privately owned cars.
Join the movement. Move freely.

bluejetty:00132050:ios.summary: With hundreds of mindfulness meditation apps to pick from, what makes Meditopia so special? Well, unlike most of the other options, Meditopia offers more than just a short-term solution to falling asleep, finding balance and de-stressing; w
bluejetty:00132050:ios.description:
With hundreds of mindfulness meditation apps to pick from, what makes Meditopia so special? Well, unlike most of the other options, Meditopia offers more than just a short-term solution to falling asleep, finding balance and de-stressing; we offer each member over 1000 deep-dive meditations and breathing exercises that get right to the heart of what we as a people, regardless of age, background, or experience, are dealing with everyday.
These meditations, offered in 12 languages, aim to cover the entire spectrum of human experiences from relationships, expectations, acceptance, and loneliness, to our body-image, sexuality, life purpose, and feelings of inadequacy. Meditopia doesn’t just want to be a band-aid for wounds which we know require permanent healing. Our goal is to create a mental health sanctuary in which you can access the guidance and tools you need to build up mental resilience, calm, balance, a healthy headspace and peace of mind. Everything you need to feel happier, relax, and sleep like a baby.
Download now and try a free meditation! 
What can you get with Meditopia?
Sleep Meditations + Breathing exercises
Your quality of sleep affects almost every aspect of your daily life. So why not help yourself get better sleep? Try any one of our +30 sleep meditations to learn new techniques as well as breathing and visualization exercises that you can continue to practice throughout the rest of your life to promote good sleep. Say bye to that old sound machine and that one-function breathing app.
Bedtime Stories 
Bedtime fairy stories aren’t just for kids! As you tuck yourself into bed, all warm and cozy, let us lull you to sleep with our wide selection of bedtime stories. From fairy tales and adventures to experiences in places all throughout the world, feel yourself getting pulled into these vivid and soothing stories. After all, at the end of a long day, you deserve to gently ease into a dreamworld of sleep and recovery. We also have a wide library of sleep sounds like rain, waves, and relaxing noises like white noise and more.
AI Therapy
Introducing SOUL, our custom AI therapy solution. Designed by psychologists and mental health experts, SOUL is your AI mental health companion. Tailored to address diverse mental health needs, SOUL utilizes its intricate understanding of language nuances to offer personalized support, engaging users in insightful and compassionate dialogue
Apple Watch + Siri Shortcuts
Even if you don't have your iPhone with you, you can access all of our content from Apple Watch!
Our Top Features:
+1000 guided meditations
Nature sounds with a timer
Independent WatchOS app
Apple HealthKit integration to count your worry-free minutes
Dark Mode support
Daily Meditations on a new topic every day
Daily Inspirational Quotes
Personal Note-taking to track your progress
Mindful Meter to see your mindfulness stats at a glance
In-app challenges with friends to feel challenged
Custom reminders to sleep and meditate
Siri shortcuts
User-friendly and user-oriented interface
Meditopia’s meditation library offers over 1000+ guided meditations on topics including: 
Stress
Acceptance
Compassion
Gratitude
Happiness
Anger
Self-Confidence 
Motivation
Focus
Sexuality
Breath
Body Positivity
Change & Courage
Inadequacy
Self-Love
Less Guided Meditations
Body Scan
_________________
Subscription Pricing and Terms: 
The iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The subscription automatically renews with the same price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. 
Subscriptions can be deactivated at the following link: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Terms & Conditions: https://meditopia.com/terms-en.html

bluejetty:00066390:ios.description:
Welcome to Yubo – the ultimate social platform for making new friends all over the world! With millions of users worldwide, we’re all about connecting you with like-minded people in a fun and safe place! 
FEW THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT YUBO
1) SWIPE TO MAKE NEW FRIENDS: Use our swipe feature to find new friends who are online and share the same interests! With just a swipe, you could meet your new bestie!
2) CHAT WITH FRIENDS WORLDWIDE: One of the coolest things about Yubo is that you can chat with people from all over the world! Whether you're feeling silly, want to sing, dance, or chat about your day, Yubo has got you covered!
3) FIND YOUR TRIBE: At Yubo, finding your tribe is key to making lasting connections! Thanks to the Tags, you can find other people into gaming, beauty, sports, music, dance, and so much more! So, whether you’re a gamer, a makeup artist, or just looking for like-minded friends, Yubo has got you covered!
4) IT’S FREE: Yubo is totally free to use! 
5) IT’S SAFE: We take your safety seriously. That's why we've designed many features and tools to ensure you can use Yubo safely. 
So, what are you waiting for? 
And, as always, feel free to contact us on Instagram (@yubo_app) or Twitter (@yubo_app) with any questions or feedback!
Yubo is free to download and use, which will never change for our main features. However, if you want to get the most from Yubo, you can subscribe to one of our optional products, the Yubo Power Pack or Yubo Elite Pack.

* Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
* Your subscription will automatically renew itself unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
* You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings in the iTunes Store.

* If you don’t choose to purchase Yubo Power Pack or Yubo Elite Pack, you can continue using and enjoying Yubo for free.

bluejetty:00129524:ios.description:
No sign-up required. Download Relax & Sleep Well Hypnosis and get instant access to free hypnotherapy and meditation recordings designed to help you sleep deeply, reduce stress and anxiety, and feel calmer and more balanced.
Created by Glenn Harrold, one of the world’s most successful hypnotherapists, this app gives you professional hypnosis and mindfulness tools you can use anytime. With over 140 in-app recordings, you’ll find sessions covering sleep, insomnia, anxiety, relaxation, confidence, spiritual healing, motivation and more.
 All recordings are carefully scripted and professionally produced by Glenn using a Neumann U87 microphone and high-end analogue-to-digital converters. The result is warm, immersive audio that’s easy to listen to and deeply relaxing. Many users report meaningful, long-lasting positive changes from regular listening.
Relax & Sleep Well also includes helpful features such as playlists, storage management to control app size, a breathing feature, and clear descriptions for every session, making it easy to find exactly what you need.
 All support and help enquiries are answered within 24 hours.
Trusted by Millions Worldwide
Relax & Sleep Well has helped over 4 million people meditate and sleep well and has been recognised as #1 Best Insomnia App by Healthline. “Healthline’s editors carefully selected each winner based on quality and usability.”
The app has also reached #1 Grossing Lifestyle App status in over 50 countries worldwide.
 Free Hypnosis & Meditation Sessions
You can start immediately with several free recordings, including:
* Relax & Sleep Well – a full 29-minute hypnotherapy session designed to guide you into deep relaxation and healthy sleep patterns
* A 30-minute lite version of the 639 Hz Solfeggio Sonic Meditation
* Mindfulness for Releasing Anxiety
* Morning Meditation
* Meditation for Inner Wisdom
Two free eBooks are also included:
* The Solfeggio Scale eBook
* Glenn’s Guide to Self-Hypnosis, an in-depth guide showing how self-hypnosis can support positive change in many areas of life
  Professional Hypnotherapy Recordings
A typical Glenn Harrold recording features dreamy background sound effects recorded in specific musical keys and frequencies, helping guide you into deep mental and physical relaxation.
All recordings feature:
* Modern hypnotherapy, mindfulness and healing meditation techniques
* Glenn’s highly acclaimed hypnotic vocal delivery
* Carefully crafted background soundscapes
* Stereo-echoed affirmations that gently pan from ear to ear
 Glenn has over 20 years of hypnotherapy experience, has sold more than 10 million recordings worldwide, and is the author of eight self-help and health books.
Download Now
Download Relax & Sleep Well Hypnosis today and discover why millions of people worldwide use Glenn Harrold’s recordings to sleep better, relax deeply and feel calmer every day.

bluejetty:00030299:ios.description:
Solitaire is a classic card game that has been enjoyed by people of all ages for centuries. It is a great way to relax and unwind or to challenge your mind with a fun and stimulating puzzle.
Solitaire - 4-in-1 Solitaire is the perfect solitaire app for everyone. With four classic modes to choose from, including Klondike, Spider, Pyramid, and Free Cell, there's something for everyone, whether you're a seasoned solitaire player or just starting out.
Klondike Solitaire is the most popular mode of solitaire. It is a game of skill and strategy and a great way to learn the basics of solitaire. The goal of the game is to move all of the cards from the tableau to the foundation piles, in ascending order from Ace to King and in suit.
Spider Solitaire is a more challenging mode of solitaire but is also more rewarding when you win. The goal of the game is to remove all of the cards from the tableau by stacking them in descending order and in suit.
Pyramid Solitaire is a fast-paced mode of solitaire that is sure to get your heart racing. The goal of the game is to remove all of the cards from the pyramid by pairing them up with cards of the same value.
Free Cell Solitaire is a unique mode of solitaire that requires strategy and planning to win. The goal of the game is to move all of the cards from the tableau to the foundation piles, in ascending order from Ace to King and in suit.
No matter which mode you choose, you're sure to have a great time playing Solitaire: 4-in-1-Solitaire. The game features tranquil music and serene visuals that will help you relax and enjoy the experience. The gameplay is smooth and intuitive, and the challenges will keep you engaged for hours on end. 
Here are some of the features of Solitaire: 4 in 1 Solitaire:
 • Four classic solitaire modes: Klondike, Spider, Pyramid, and Free Cell 
 • Tranquil music and serene visuals 
 • Smooth and intuitive game play
 • Undo and redo options 
 • Spin and earn rewards 
 • Different themes of cards to choose from
How to play solitaire:
 • The goal of solitaire is to move all of the cards from the tableau (the seven stacks of cards on the table) to the foundation piles (the four stacks in the top corners).
 • To move a card, you must place it on a card of the opposite colour and one lower rank. For example, you can place a red 5 on a black 6.
 • You can also move sequences of cards as long as the cards are in descending order and of alternating colours. For example, you can move a red 5, a black 4, and a red 3.
 • If you cannot make any more moves, you can draw a new card from the stockpile.  
Tips for playing solitaire:
 • Pay attention to the cards that are face up on the table. This will help you plan your moves and avoid getting stuck.
 • Try to move cards to the foundation piles as soon as possible. This will free up space on the tableau and make it easier to make moves.
 • Don't be afraid to use the undo button. If you make a mistake, you can always undo it and try again.
 • Keep practicing! The more you play solitaire, the better you will become at it.
   Solitaire: 4-in-1 Solitaire is the perfect way to relax and unwind or to challenge your mind with a fun and stimulating puzzle. Download today and start playing!   Please feel free to share any specific thoughts or concerns you have about the game performance. The more detailed your feedback is, the better we will be able to address the issues. We appreciate your feedback. We are committed to providing the best possible experience for our players, and we will use your feedback to improve our game.   Thank you for playing Solitaire, and do check out other games by Yarsa Labs

bluejetty:00122648:ios.description:
We are licensed by the SEC, enabling you to grow and manage your money securely. With direct access to the largest pool of mutual funds in Nigeria, you can save and invest at competitive rates, and build wealth at your own pace, in ways that won’t take the “style” from your lifestyle.
With the Cowrywise app, you can:
SAVE FOR SHORT AND LONG-TERM GOALS
- Start automated savings with as little as ₦1,000. Save every day, week, or month with our Flexible Periodic Savings Plan
- Save for your periodic needs - rent, school fees, gadgets, dream car or apartment, etc
- Earn double-digit interest - much better than you’ll find at your bank
- Save as a group to reach your goals faster with Circles
- Prepare for unforeseen emergencies by creating a personalized Emergency Fund
OWN A PIECE OF NAIJA’S TOP PERFORMING COMPANIES
- Naija, how market? The doors to the Nigerian Stocks Exchange are now open to you! Buy stocks of over 140 companies listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange, right on the app.
- Get access to real-time data, business insights and historical performances of each company
- Get a visual snapshot of how the Nigerian Stock Market is performing through our State of the Market interactive heatmap. 
- Get actionable tips with our in-app stock mini course to help you on your Stock Investing journey.
INVEST AND GROW WEALTH AT YOUR PACE
- Invest in any of our mutual funds matching your financial goals and risk appetite. Mutual funds contain low-risk assets like Treasury Bills, bonds, or stocks
- Diversify your portfolio by investing in different mutual funds from top investment firms in Nigeria.
YOUR MONEY IS IN SAFE HANDS
- We are licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
- Your savings are invested in low-risk financial instruments and are held by a custodian, Zenith Nominees, a subsidiary of Zenith Bank Plc. This means your money is professionally managed and secured.
To protect your account, we have implemented security infrastructure such as PIN, two-factor authentication, and Security Questions. We comply with the National Data Protection Commission (NDPC) regulations to safeguard your data. Your BVN and bio-data are safe with us.
GET SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT!
- We offer support through the app, phone, email, Facebook, Instagram, and X (formerly Twitter). If you need assistance with your account, we’re always here to help!
HOW IT WORKS IN 5 SIMPLE STEPS:
- Download the app
- Create your account
- Tap “Save” or “Invest”
- Follow the prompts to fund any of your plans
- Congratulations! You are now one step closer to a wealthier version of yourself.
Start planning for short-term goals, and long-term goals, and take control of your financial future.

bluejetty:00036017:ios.name: Git client - Working Copy
bluejetty:00036017:ios.summary:
Access Git repositories on the go. Clone, edit, commit and push while allowing other apps access to repositories.
Git is a important part of our work-life and iOS can take part in this. The ability to commit even when offline has added uti
bluejetty:00036017:ios.description:
Access Git repositories on the go. Clone, edit, commit and push while allowing other apps access to repositories.
Git is a important part of our work-life and iOS can take part in this. The ability to commit even when offline has added utility on a device that moves in and out of network coverage. Cloning repositories gets you a local copy on your iOS device with commits for all branches. You can browse the content from within the app and make changes. Other applications supporting the Files app, WebDAV or x-callback-url has access to these files. Changes made can be committed and the commits can in turn be pushed back to the remote.
The idea of doing significant programming on iOS might seem far fetched when you are used to a large screen, a physical keyboard and a full IDE. But just as it turned out that not every email is serious prose, then not everything that goes on in Git is significant programming. Sometimes you just want to update a TODO file or make adjustments to your Jekyll site. Sometimes you just need to add a file the designer sent after hours. 
If you ever make reminders about small things to do with the code-base, then you should give Working Copy a try. You will spend less time moving stuff around and you will get much better commit messages when you write them for fixes that are still fresh in your mind. You won't be leaving your computer behind any time soon, but sometimes it is faster to just fix things with the device in your hand.
When you do need to perform real work on iOS, Working Copy is a powerful tool. Editor has syntax highlighting for more than 50 programming languages and a built-in color picker. Preview images, Markdown and HTML files with a Javascript console pointing to errors in your code. Create new branches and merge or rebase them back, with a brilliant merge-tool for handling conflicts. If you need to automate your work there are Working Copy actions in the Shortcuts app for most operations.
Even if you never edit a line of code on iOS, Working Copy is a great companion for reviewing and discussing code. Repositories are cross indexed and with powerful fuzzy search you can quickly jump from a symbol to the declaration or reverse from the declaration to all usages. A graph of your commits lets you zoom out for a overview of the commit tree or zoom in for specifics about each commit, with speed and beauty you won’t find in desktop Git applications. Review the changes your files have gone through with a diff viewer that is great for text and images. There is even hex-dump mode for that obscure occasion.
Working Copy is a free download but you need to unlock pro features such as the ability to push commits and manage more than 5 repositories. There is no venture capital, large company or ads funding development and your support through in-app purchase directly sustains development. Try out pro features with a 10 day free trial.
When you pay to unlock you get permanent access to all pro features at the time of purchase as well as any added the next year. When 12 months have passed you keep all existing pro features but any new ones introduced are locked until you renew your unlock.

Goldion AI, #1 Trending Calorie Tracker (formerly Goldi AI)
Goldion AI is the revolutionary AI calorie tracker designed for real people with real lives—whether you’re focused on weight loss, muscle gain, balanced nutrition, or just building awareness about what you eat. Featured by top creators on TikTok, Goldion AI is already trusted by over 100,000 users and has tracked more than 1 million meals. Why do so many people switch from outdated manual logs? Because Goldion AI makes food tracking easy, motivating, and fun.
Effortless AI Food Logging – Snap, Track, and Win
Forget about searching endless food databases or typing in every ingredient. With Goldion AI’s powerful AI food tracker, you just snap a photo of your meal and instantly get a complete breakdown: calories, macros, micronutrients, sugar, and sodium—all in seconds. Our AI calorie tracker has recognized over a million foods, from simple snacks to complex home-cooked meals. No barcode? No problem.
Instant Feedback and Personalized Coaching
Tired of apps that only count calories but don’t help you make better choices? Goldion AI’s AI food diary gives you immediate feedback on each meal. Our AI-powered coach analyzes your nutrition summary, highlights what’s great, and calls out opportunities for improvement—whether you’re aiming for a high-protein lunch, balanced macros, or lower sugar and sodium intake. Goldion AI adapts to your unique goals, supporting everything from intuitive eating to more structured plans like OMAD (one meal a day), keto diet, or even carnivore approaches. Track your progress visually and see your healthy habits build over time.
Beyond Calories – Track What Matters
Goldion AI isn’t just an AI calorie tracker; it’s your complete nutrition command center. Get a granular view of your food and nutrients:
• Sugar Tracker: Spot hidden sugars, reduce cravings, and make healthier swaps.
• Sodium Tracker: Monitor your salt intake, support heart health, and keep bloating away.
• Micronutrient Awareness: See your daily intake of vitamins and minerals, not just calories and macros.
• Macro Breakdown: Protein, carbs, fat—all clearly displayed to support any fitness or weight loss goal.
Your progress isn’t just a number. With Goldion AI, you can see your daily and weekly streaks, celebrate wins, and share your results on TikTok or Instagram with just one tap. Our unique dashboard lets you watch your weight, nutrition balance, and habits change over time. Real users report greater consistency, less stress, and easier weight management compared to other trackers.
Why Goldion AI?
• #1 Trending Food Tracker: As seen on TikTok and trusted by top creators
• Fastest AI Meal Logging: Scan, log, and get results in seconds
• Personalized AI Coach: Feedback, tips, and encouragement every day
• Complete Tracking: Not just calories—full macros & micronutrients
• Track your progress: Update & see your weight loss & nutrition stats over time
• Advanced Analysis: Meal swaps, upgrades, health risks, and more
• 1M+ foods recognized—no barcode needed
Who’s Goldion AI for?
Anyone looking to simplify nutrition tracking, whether your goal is weight loss, muscle gain, or simply building better eating habits. Goldion AI adapts to your journey, supporting you whether you want to track every calorie or just increase your awareness.
Join 100,000+ happy users who have switched to Goldion for effortless tracking and real results. Try Goldion, the next generation of AI calorie tracker, free today.
Support & Contact
Got ideas or questions? Reach out to us at hello@gopromi.app. We’re here to help!

Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
