bluejetty:00094082:ios.description:
FarmersMatch — The Dating App for Country Folks
FarmersMatch is made for farmers, ranchers, and anyone who grew up in the country, or loves the country lifestyle. Whether you're looking for love or friendship, FarmersMatch connects you with people who share your values, roots, and way of life.
Forget swiping. FarmersMatch helps you build real connections through detailed profiles that let you learn more about your matches from the start. It’s dating designed for meaningful relationships, not quick decisions.
We know it’s not always easy for rural folks to meet someone new. That’s why FarmersMatch is your go-to app for meeting people who get you.
Key Features
* Discover: Use filters to find people who match your lifestyle and preferences.
* Like & Match: Like someone, if they like you back, it's a match.
* Chat: Send messages, photos, and stay connected with matches and friends.
* Feed: See updates from matches and friends. Share posts and join local communities.
* Notifications: Get alerts when someone likes you, visits your profile, or sends a message.
Why FarmersMatch is Perfect for Farmers
Long hours in the field don’t leave much time to meet new people. FarmersMatch works around your schedule, connect and chat while you're out working the land.
Country Love, Real Connections
Country life is unique, and most people in the city don’t understand it. FarmersMatch is built for country singles who want to date someone who shares their lifestyle — farmers, cowboys and cowgirls, ranchers, outdoors lovers, and more.
Find More Than Dates, Find Your People
In small towns, everyone already knows everyone. FarmersMatch helps you meet new people with similar interests, no matter how rural your area is. It’s a place to spark friendships, love, and community.
Support
Emai: support@farmersmatch.com
Terms: https://www.farmersmatch.com/terms/
Privacy: https://www.farmersmatch.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00068011:ios.description:

Record your dreams in vivid detail and build a personal encyclopedia of your dream life. Keep track of the characters, creatures, places, objects, and emotions that appear throughout your dreams, and explore them in ways that go far beyond a traditional dream journal.

• Powerful search, tags, and categories 
• Dream Signs collection for lucid dreaming practice 
• Morning reminders to record your dreams 
• Appearance customization and themes 
• Face ID, Touch ID, and passcode protection 
• Reality Check reminders for lucid dreaming 
• Data export 
• Random Dream Signs widget

bluejetty:00037706:ios.description:
文墨天机®(专业版)是集飞星、三合、四化、四柱于一身的星座易学研究者的必备辅助工具
紫微斗数，是中国传统预测学重要的支派之一，位列“五大神数”之首，通过人出生的年月日时来预测人一生的吉凶祸福。历史上，紫微斗数在民间的流传并不十分广泛，一方面是因为古代的紫微斗数预测术是皇家御用；另一方面，排盘的复杂性也极大地限制了其在民间的传播。当代计算机技术的快速发展，使原本复杂的紫微斗数排盘变的容易，在过去的二十多年间，各种排盘软件层出不穷。然而，网络上的排盘软件或多或少存在一些问题，例如：1.安星不准；2.排盘时间范围小；3.排盘方法局限于单一流派而无法广泛兼容；4.软件长时间不更新造成遗留错误无法修正、新系统版本兼容性问题层出不穷……
“文墨天机®”正是为解决上述问题而精心设计研发的一套专业易学排盘软件，服务于易学爱好者和资深易学研究者。它具备以下特点：
1. 内置高精度天文历，可排盘的时间范围大，弥补了同类排盘软件可排盘时间范围小、不便于研究古人命盘和后人命盘的缺点。
2. 支持多种系统平台，提供了一致的界面风格和操作体验，是目前业界兼容终端广泛并且实用易用的一套专业易学排盘程序。
3. 提供精心设计的排盘界面，风格简约而不简单，精心设计并优化盘面布局和配色风格，满足各层次易学研究者的使用需求。
4. 提供丰富的流派设置选项，满足不同流派易学研究者依据自身所学进行灵活设定的需求。
5. 提供方便快捷的大限、小限、流年、流月、流日和流时切换功能，大幅简化交互复杂度。
6. 提供持续的软件更新服务，广泛倾听用户的意见和建议，持续更新并改进产品已逾十年。

- Enjoy frequent content updates with fresh new projects, SUVs, off-road customs, and live challenges to take on!
It's time to get matching, tuning, and transforming these wrecks into gleaming new masterpieces!

bluejetty:00089495:ios.description:
Get mental health and wellbeing support that is as personal as your experience with Koa Care 360 by Koa Health, a benefit available through your provider. Access clinically-validated mental health resources confidentially and on-demand to build emotional resilience, deal with mental health challenges like sleep issues and anxious thoughts as they arise, and enhance your overall wellbeing. Delivered through a unified platform designed by the leading experts at Koa Health, Koa Care 360 helps you track your progress over time and provides you with personalized recommendations matched to your unique needs and preferences. 
With Koa Care 360 by Koa Health you can:
Access clinically-validated mental wellbeing resources through the Koa Care 360 mobile app, anytime, anywhere
Complete regular mental wellbeing check-ins and get a personal plan that changes with your needs and preferences 
Select a focus area and develop skills in multi-step programs
Track your mental wellbeing and progress over time inside the app
Get in-the-moment support to help you manage sleep problems, anxious thoughts, low self-esteem and more
How to get started with Koa Care 360:
Download the Koa Care 360 by Koa Health app 
Sign with your registered email or follow the process defined by your provider 
Complete your first mental wellbeing check-in and get your customized personal plan
Start using the resources recommended for your unique needs and preferences
Who’s behind Koa Care 360 by Koa Health?
Based in Spain, the US, and the UK the Koa Health team is clinician-founded and clinician-led, with leading experts in psychology, behavioral health, and neuroscience dedicated to making mental health more accessible and attainable for everyone. Our content is regularly updated and we welcome your feedback.
Who can use Koa Care 360?
Koa Care 360 by Koa Health is a mental health care benefit offered to individuals and their dependents (+18) through their employer, health plan or provider. If you’re not sure whether your organization or health plan offers access, please contact your HR team or customer support team. 
Is Koa Care 360 by Koa Health Secure? 
Your privacy is our priority. Koa Health ensures your data is kept safe and confidential. For more about how we protect your information and your rights, visit our privacy policy at Koa Care 360 by Koa Health Privacy Policy.
Read our Terms and Conditions here:
https://www.koa.care/legal/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00115200:ios.name: Wrestle AI
bluejetty:00115200:ios.summary: Master your takedowns, build unbreakable defense, and sharpen match IQ with Wrestle AI—the wrestling training app that never gets tired. Built by wrestlers for wrestlers, it blends AI video analysis, personalized drills, and mat-specific co
bluejetty:00115200:ios.description:
Master your takedowns, build unbreakable defense, and sharpen match IQ with Wrestle AI—the wrestling training app that never gets tired. Built by wrestlers for wrestlers, it blends AI video analysis, personalized drills, and mat-specific conditioning so you improve faster all season.
HOW IT WORKS
Upload practice or match clips for clear, step-by-step pointers—stance, setups, finishes, chain options, and fixes.
Set goals (neutral, top, bottom), weight class, and schedule. Wrestle AI builds a plan that fits your season
Train with focused sessions and time-boxed challenges. Track attempts, finishes, riding time, escapes, and pins.
CORE FEATURES
• AI VIDEO BREAKDOWNS: Instant cues on shots, re-shots, hand fighting, ties, go-behinds, finishes, rides, mat returns, turns, and escapes.
• PERSONALIZED DRILL PLANS: Daily sessions tailored to your style and level—neutral/top/bottom, folkstyle/freestyle.
• TECHNIQUE LIBRARY: No-fluff walkthroughs for takedowns, finishes, rides, escapes, scrambles, counters, and chain wrestling.
• “IMPOSSIBLE MODE” CHALLENGES: Short, intense work to sharpen speed, grip, and mat conditioning when time is tight.
• STATS & MATCH TRACKER: Log attempts, finishes, riding time, escapes, near-falls, and pins. Spot trends and close gaps.
• TIMERS & TOOLS: Shot clock, interval timer, stance-in-motion flow, and live scoring helpers for practice.
• STRENGTH & CONDITIONING: Mat-specific power, explosiveness, core, and cardio circuits for late-match gas.
• PROGRESS YOU CAN FEEL: Streaks, targets, and milestones to keep you locked in.
PROGRAMS & DRILLS
• Neutral: entries, angles, snap-downs, singles/doubles, high-crotch, ankle picks, ducks, re-attacks, front-head offense/defense.
• Top: breakdowns, rides, wrist control, bars, legs, tilts, cradles, turns, and pin finishes.
• Bottom: first move, hand control, stand-ups, sit-outs, hip-heists, switches, granby, scramble defense.
• Situational: edge-of-mat tactics, short-time scores, overtime strategy, bonus-point opportunities.
WHO IT’S FOR
Youth, high school, college, and club athletes—plus coaches who want sharper, more focused practices. Wrestle AI adapts to folkstyle in-season or freestyle off-season work, helping beginners build fundamentals and advanced wrestlers find the small edges that win close matches.
WHY WRESTLE AI
• Train with purpose: every session targets a clear skill or position.
• Improve faster: tight feedback loops beat random workouts.
• Stay consistent: daily plans, micro-goals, and challenges keep you moving.
• Win more positions: better positions become better scores—period.
RESULTS
Watch volume, intensity, and technical reps add up. Measure attempts, finishes, escapes, bonus points, and riding time, then close gaps with focused drills. Show up at tournaments confident—you’ve already solved the positions that used to cost you matches.
FOR COACHES
Run targeted blocks (neutral/top/bottom), finish with “Impossible Mode” for intensity, and use timers and live-scoring helpers to keep sessions crisp. Film a few reps, run an AI breakdown, and assign position-specific homework.
PRIVACY & CONTROL
You decide what to upload and what to keep. Delete clips anytime.
SUBSCRIPTION
Wrestle AI offers in-app purchases. Plans unlock premium video analysis, personalized programming, advanced stats, and extended libraries. Pricing varies by region. Subscriptions renew automatically; manage any time in App Store account settings.
Step on the mat with a plan. Leave it better than you walked on.
Download Wrestle AI and start winning more positions today.

bluejetty:00176102:android.description:
Mom's Kitchen Crush - Whip up delicious dishes win real rewards! and become a culinary master!
Get ready to experience Kitchen Fever with Mom's Kitchen Crush - the ultimate online cooking game! This cooking game is perfect for food enthusiasts who love free cooking games, food games, pizza games, restaurant games, chef games, and recipe games. This game filled with cooking challenges will have you hooked as you cook up a storm in Mom's kitchen.
Mom's Kitchen Crush offers everything a food lover could want, from classic American recipes like burgers and fries to mouth-watering German sausages and pretzels. Travel the world in this exciting food game and learn new recipes and snacks as you go!
In this restaurant game, you'll face a variety of targets that will keep you on your toes. Avoid burning your food, refrain from using the dustbin, collect specific likes, and achieve your target in a set amount of time.
To achieve your targets in this game, you'll need to be quick and use your culinary skills to the fullest. Choose the right ingredients, cook them to perfection, and serve up to your customers.
As you progress through the levels of this game, you'll unlock new recipes. Mom's kitchen Crush is one of the best restaurant games out there!
Mom's Kitchen Crush also has a range of exciting features that will keep you engaged for hours. Spin the wheel to win unique rewards, earn extra money with combos. It's a food game like no other.
Mom's Kitchen Crush offers a range of features:
• Enjoy a smooth and hassle-free gameplay experience in this online cooking simulator.
• Immerse yourself in the game with engaging sound effects and music.
• Watch as your food comes to life through stunning animations and customer reactions.
• Upgrade your food machines and recipes to improve your abilities.
• Try your luck with the spin wheel to unlock unique rewards.
• Boost your earnings with combos and tips from happy customers.
• Complete daily tasks to earn rewards.
• Use boosters like Double Coin, Burn Proof, Insta cook, and More Time to increase your chances of success.
In this game, discover unique recipes and fun facts while becoming a top chef
• Choose from a variety of breakfast, lunch, and dinner options in different food trucks .
• Select the best ingredients and cook your dishes to perfection; be careful not to overcook them!
• Serve your customers delicious recipes and become a renowned chef .
• Explore new locations worldwide and learn new recipes along the way .
• Aim for combos and coins to boost your earnings quickly .
• Start your day with mouth-watering donuts and juice, perfect for breakfast in this time management game .
• Treat yourself and your customers to flavorful Mexican tacos, sandwiches, cheesesteak hotdogs, and fries .
Download Mom's Kitchen Crush today and indulge in one of the best family cooking games!
For any questions, please consult our FAQ list at https://unite-1.gitbook.io/unite-docs. Additionally, feel free to contact us via X at https://x.com/uniteio, or send us an email at momskitchensupport@unite.io.

bluejetty:00071251:ios.name: Radarbot: GPS Speed Cameras
bluejetty:00071251:ios.summary: Radarbot is the only app that offers real-time alerts and offline detection for speed cameras. Get comprehensive speed camera alerts, real-time traffic updates, and specific speed limit notifications for cars, motorcycles, trucks, and comme
bluejetty:00071251:ios.description:
Radarbot is the only app that offers real-time alerts and offline detection for speed cameras. Get comprehensive speed camera alerts, real-time traffic updates, and specific speed limit notifications for cars, motorcycles, trucks, and commercial vehicles. Focus on what matters and enjoy your trip.
With Radarbot, drive more peacefully. Safer. Better.
SPEED CAMERA ALERTS
Enjoy driving without worrying about your driver’s license or safety. Avoid traffic fines with clear warnings before reaching:
- Fixed speed cameras
- Speed trap hotspots.
- Tunnel speed cameras.
- Average speed cameras (the app shows your average speed).
- Red light cameras.
- School zones cameras.
Plus, get alerts for:
- Dangerous driving areas.
- Seat belt or cell phone use cameras.
- Potholes and speed bumps on the road.
* FEATURES:
- Works in any country.
- Compatible with other apps (Use Radarbot along with other GPS navigators or your favorite music app). You will continue to receive alerts in the background or while the screen is turned off.
- Voice and sound alerts for speed cameras and speed limits.
- Vibration mode for motorcyclists.
- Completely personalized warning distances and settings.
- Automatic Bluetooth connection and startup.
- Compatible with Apple Watch.
REAL-TIME ALERTS
Real-time alerts will warn you of unexpected circumstances. Join a community of over 100 million drivers to share and receive alerts about traffic jams, road hazards, accidents, mobile speed cameras, police, helicopters, drones and much more.
UPDATED RADARS
Radarbot has the most powerful and updated speed and red light camera database in the world with real-time alerts from millions of users and experts.
RADARBOT WORLDWIDE
Try our FREE version with no time limits. For the full experience, upgrade to "Radarbot GOLD" or "Radarbot GOLD RoadPro" for integrated GPS navigation and no ads.
GPS NAVIGATION AND SPEED LIMITS
The GOLD version provides everything you need on the road: GPS navigation, speed camera alerts, and speed limits. Reach your destination safely, even without an internet connection. Travel and receive speed cameras alerts all over the world, without worrying about mobile network coverage.
Where would you like to go?
* FEATURES:
- Offline navigation and 3D maps.
- Option to choose a route with fewer radars.
- Road speed limits.
- Alert for school areas and their radars.
- Radarbot copilot. Put your seat belt on!
ARE YOU A PROFESSIONAL DRIVER?
"Radarbot GOLD RoadPro" includes everything a professional driver could need:
- Routes with special restrictions for trucks and commercial vehicles.
- Speed limits and specific radars for trucks.
- Distance alerts adapted to heavy vehicles.
If you have any doubts or questions, we would be more than happy to assist you at radarbot@iteration-mobile.com or from the customer support option within the app.
Download Radarbot now and become a member of the "Enjoy driving!" movement.
* The continuous use of GPS in the background can drastically reduce the battery life.
Please refer to our Terms of Use (EULA) available on our website: https://radarbot.com/termsofuse/

bluejetty:00024859:ios.name: Train Your Brain: Memory Games
bluejetty:00024859:ios.summary:
Stimulate your memory and have fun with memory senior games. A complete collection of games that will help you develop your memory skills while having fun.
Within this app you will find different games to test your capacity of retention and
bluejetty:00024859:ios.description:
Stimulate your memory and have fun with memory senior games. A complete collection of games that will help you develop your memory skills while having fun.
Within this app you will find different games to test your capacity of retention and memory in the short and long term.
Each game has different levels so you can practice gradually. In addition, you can see the score obtained in each level and visualize your progress. Ideal to stimulate the memory of older people.
TYPES OF GAMES
- Find card pairs
- Repeat sequences
- Avoid obstacles and trace the right path
- Remember figures and numbers
- Memorize patterns
- Associate objects
- Memorize elements of different images
- Distractive games to stimulate working memory
APP FEATURES
- Daily memory training
- Available in 5 languages
- Simple and intuitive interface
- Different levels for all ages
- Constant updates with new games
COGNITIVE STIMULATION
Senior memory games belongs to a collection of games designed to stimulate different cognitive areas in adults: Memory, Attention, Processing speed, Visuospatial Function and Coordination.
The design of these games has been carried out in collaboration with experts in neuroscience and psychiatry, with the aim of creating playful content and, in addition, serve as a complement to the treatments carried out in health centers.

bluejetty:00089604:ios.description:
What is Halan App?
The application provides smart solutions for financial services: that make it easier for BNPL, Lending, Payments, and online shopping.
Halan is an Egyptian Fintech application providing funding solutions for small businesses and consumer financing away from the banking system. We also allow you to purchase on an installment basis without the hassle of opening a bank account through our Buy Now Pay Later solution. Also, you can easily pay for your purchases in cash using the application. Halan also lets you pay any bill payment and receive/send money at the touch of a button through our simple and hassle-free application.
Halan BNPL:
Buy Now Pay Later service including:
Mobile phones, furniture, home appliances, electronics, education, medical, and trips with small installments easily and safely on Halan App or through our +5000 vendors.
The best BNPL service without any banking procedures, down payment, or extra administrative fees with installments over 30 months.
How to apply for BNPL services from Halan?
Buy all your needs and pay later, over different repayment periods, apply for the easiest BNPL from Halan.
Download the application, select Halan offers, select the product, and add it to the cart, or you can buy directly from our +5000 vendors.  
How to benefit from BNPL service with Halan vendors?
Go to our vendors, mention that you need to benefit from Halan’s BNPL, choose your repayment period, you will get an OTP, show it to the vendor, and confirm the request. And enjoy buying all your needs from all our vendors of home appliances, electronics, mobile phones, and furniture.
Main requirements:
Age from 21-60
Valid National ID
Halan shopping:
E-Commerce: You can easily buy (Home Appliances – Electronics – Mobiles and accessories) and pay in cash, credit cards, or using Halan’s BNPL service easily on the application for a smooth shopping experience.
Halan Gomla: With a few clicks get all your needs of groceries, personal care, and hygiene products in bulk at wholesale prices, delivered to your doorstep within 24 hours only with Halan Gomla on Halan App.
How to order from Halan Gomla?
Download Halan app, select Halan Gomla, select your products add them to the cart, select the payment method, and your order will be at your doorstep within 24 hours also it will be free delivery for orders exceeding 400 L.E.
Stay tuned for Halan Gomla’s hot deals.
Halan Lending:
Halan with “Tasaheel lending company”, provides quick and hassle-free lending for all industries. You can apply for micro-lending from 3000 LE to 200.000 LE
Apply now for lending service from Halan App and receive it from Tasaheel.
How to get your business funded through Halan app?
Get your business the needed funds with the easiest steps, safest ways, and without restricted bank procedures.
Download Halan app, select “Apply now”, scan your national ID, answer the questions, and our representative will contact you, and once your application is approved, you will receive your loan from “Tasaheel”.
Minimum requirements:
Age from 21-60
Valid National ID
How to pay bills on Halan app?
Pay all your bills from your home with hassle-free steps:
Download Halan App, select “payments service”, identify the type of the bill and entity of issuance, and enter the subscription code along with your mobile number. Review all the transaction details and the payment will be deducted from your Halan wallet balance after confirmation.

Passionate readers use this magazine to f
bluejetty:00126246:ios.description:
Beckett Football is a monthly magazine that features values on trading, including new releases. There are also articles on current trends, the latest releases and reviews of just-released products. 
Passionate readers use this magazine to find the worth of their cards, hot player and Rookie Cards to watch. Beckett Football is deal for longtime and novice collectors.
Each issue has:
• The Football Card Price Guide with more than 100 pages filled with values for past current releases.
• The Hot List, a monthly guide with pricing and images for the top 20 football cards on the market
• Articles with information on the latest trends and news in the hobby
• Reviews of the latest football releases 
• Previews of upcoming products
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com
--------------------
You can find our privacy policy here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx
You can find our terms and conditions here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/terms.aspx

bluejetty:00068656:ios.name: Premier Wallet
bluejetty:00068656:ios.summary: Premier Wallet is the first fully featured digital wallet in the country powered by Premier Bank. Premier Wallet helps you to shop, dine, pay bills and manage your digital cash on the go. From now onwards, you no longer have to worry about
bluejetty:00068656:ios.description:
Premier Wallet is the first fully featured digital wallet in the country powered by Premier Bank. Premier Wallet helps you to shop, dine, pay bills and manage your digital cash on the go. From now onwards, you no longer have to worry about carrying cash nor struggle while exchanging money. Premier Wallet is an all-in-mobile smart wallet app that offers you real-time, online payment for your everyday shopping, online Bill Payment and money management.
Premier Wallet is the perfect replacement for physical money! It offers its users a convenient way to make money transactions online with ease and using only their smartphones.
You can pay for all your purchases using the mobile cash app. You can also pay bills online, transfer money online, and manage your Finances, Accounts and Cards on one platform. Using the payment app saves you time and eliminates the risk associated with losing physical money.
Furthermore, Premier Wallet offers you an easy, fast and secure way to manage payments in a fully featured digital wallet that is accessible via a simple and secure app adding ease and convenience to your day to day payments and financial transactions. Send, Receive, Request, Purchase and manage your spending directly from your phone and in one app. It is secure and anything cash can do, Premier Wallet does it better.
Premier Wallet provides a seamless registration process to all our customer and also non-customers. In order to get started, all you need is the following:
- Valid mobile number
- A selfie
- Valid ID
- Smart phone of your choice
Once you have these things set and ready you can begin your registration process by following the steps mentioned below.
Download the customer app and select new or Existing Premier Bank Customer
If Selected New, Select Gold or Standard account per your daily limit requirement.
Take Selfie
Scan the front and back of your ID
Enter and confirm your phone number.
Generate your secret password
Now it’s time your Premier Wallet to go beyond your physical wallet – Link your Wallet to your Premier Bank Account, add money using your Account, Card, ATM or any of our authorized agents. You can also ask your friend to send money using Premier Wallet. Isn’t it easy and astonishing!
Discover all the amazing things you can do through Premier Wallet!
Premier Wallet account
It’s a free wallet with zero maintenance charges.
No minimum balance required
Load cash in your wallet as per your requirement
Pay at the merchant’s outlet
Shop and pay at merchants’ outlets (restaurants, retail, electronics, groceries etc.) using QR code, or Merchant ID.
Check out our offer page for exciting deals and apply for discount promos while shopping and dining.
Shop online
Shop at merchants’ e-commerce website/mobile apps using Premier Wallet checkout and have it delivered to you at home without a hassle.
Utility payments
Pay your electricity, Tv and School Fees.
Send or receive money
Request or pay money from wallet to wallet by scanning the QR code or selecting contact name
Transfer money locally from wallet to Wallet and from Wallet to Bank Account and even to non-registered wallets.
Withdraw wallet cash at Premier Bank ATM with ease
International Remittance
Refer a friend to get rewarded.
Refer to as many friends as you want and earn for every successful invitation
Track and manage your spending on the go to save more.
We are always happy to hear from our customers!
For more details, feedback or ideas, you can reach us on any of the following platforms:
Web – www.Premierwallet.so
Email – help@Premierwallet.so
Facebook – www.facebook.com/Premier Wallet
Twitter – www.twitter.com/Premier Wallet
Instagram – www.instagram.com/Premier Wallet
Privacy policy – www.Premierwallet.so/privacy

bluejetty:00088095:ios.name: TouchMix-8/16 Control
bluejetty:00088095:ios.summary: TouchMix-8/16 Control is an app for iPad, iPad mini, iPhone and iPod touch that provides wireless control of QSC TouchMix-8 and TouchMix-16 digital sound reinforcement mixers. Visit http://www.qsc.com for more information. The app is not i
bluejetty:00088095:ios.description:
TouchMix-8/16 Control is an app for iPad, iPad mini, iPhone and iPod touch that provides wireless control of QSC TouchMix-8 and TouchMix-16 digital sound reinforcement mixers. Visit http://www.qsc.com for more information. The app is not intended to perform any audio mixing or processing tasks on its own.
When run on the iPad and iPad mini, the TouchMix Control app closely follows the operational paradigm of the mixers. The iPad and the mixer GUI operate independently so it is possible for the iPad to act as an additional user interface that can display and control a set of functions completely different from those being controlled by the mixer’s screen and hardware. An alternate operation mode – Follow Mixer – is also available. With Follow Mixer engaged, the iPad follows the fader selection on the mixer. Touch a fader on the mixer and the iPad will display that channel’s Overview, EQ, Compressor, Sends or Gate screen. Touch a parameter on the iPad and the mixer’s rotary control will adjust it – or just drag on the iPad screen. When used without an actual TouchMix, the app acts as a demonstration of the mixer GUI and functionality but does not control audio in any way.
On the iPhone, the TouchMix Control app functions as a personal stage monitor mix control with the option to also remotely operate the mixer’s record and playback features as well as programmable user buttons. To prevent inadvertent adjustment of controls, the mixer operator may allow or restrict access to selected functions on a per-device basis.
Features
- Input channel processing (4-band PEQ, variable high & Low-cut filters, gates, compressor)
- Output channel processing (1/3 octave GEQ, 6-band PEQ, variable high & Low-cut filters, anti-feedback filters and wizard, delay)
- Real Time Analyzer (RTA)
- Select Simple or Advanced mode
- Displays channel and output level meters
- Channel and output levels
- Effects and aux (monitor) send levels
- Select input presets from extensive library
- Select and control 4 simultaneous effects
- Input and output mutes and cues
- Configure and control DCA and Mute groups
- Multi-track recorder arm, playback and transport
- Includes TouchMix Info system, built-in reference guide.
- And more
Requirements
- iPad, iPad mini, iPhone, iPod touch running iOS 16.5 or later.
- QSC TouchMix-8 or TouchMix-16 with version 3.0 or higher firmware installed.
- QSC TouchMix-8 or TouchMix-16 with supplied Wi-Fi adaptor installed or connected to a network via USB-to-Ethernet adaptor.
- Note that controlling a mixer with multiple iOS devices running different versions of the app is not recommended.
- QSC, LLC Website TouchMix Support Application License Agreement.

“Sudoku” is more than just a game; it’s a tool to sharpen your mind, improve focus, and relax with engaging puzzles. Whether you play to unwind, train your brain, or compete for the best times, this app is designed to make Sudoku accessible and enjoyable for everyone.

Download “Sudoku” Today!

bluejetty:00051673:android.description:
Yugipedia is an UNOFFICIAL deck builder app for the YGO card game. This app is NOT affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed, or approved by Studio Dice, Shueisha, TV Tokyo, or Konami.
GENESYS SUPPORT
Genesys support is here! Master the new format with point tracking, dedicated filters and card pool, classic deck tester field, seamless format switching, and more!
Build and test YGO decks using a current database of cards that is updated daily. Share decks straight to your friend's app or share deck lists anywhere.
UPDATED DAILY
Yugipedia’s card database is updated every day, giving you the most recent cards. Most cards will be on Yugipedia within 24 hours of their details being revealed. 
Most importantly, the app automatically gets the latest card list every time it starts, so you don’t have to wait a few days/weeks for an app update in order to get the newest YGO cards!
SMART SEARCH
The search has been optimized for finding cards: it will offer card suggestions and find what you're looking for even if you aren't sure how to spell it or have typos.
LIGHTNING-FAST DECK BUILDING
The deck building process has been streamlined to allow you to find and add the cards you want quickly and efficiently. Add cards to your deck with a single tap, and change the amount or remove the card with another tap.
TEST YOUR DECKS
You can test your decks on the fully-featured Test Field. It has all the field slots as well as tokens, counters, coin, dice, and handy shortcuts for Pot of Avarice, Desires, Duality, and Extravagance.
The drag-and-drop interface is easy to use, so you can practice your combos and learn new strategies the same way you would test-draw with your real-life deck.
SHARE YOUR DECKS
You can share your decks as clickable links that will open Yugipedia and import the deck. You can also share a text deck list for easy viewing.
FEATURES
• Automatic card list updates
• Over 13,800 cards, with more added daily as they are released
• Full support for the Genesys Format
• Includes almost all official TCG cards and OCG cards
• Add cards to your deck with a single tap
• TEST YOUR DECKS with the solo Test feature (not a duel system)
• Smart search has suggestions and typo tolerance
• Automatically-updating banlists for TCG, OCG, GOAT, Edison, and Master Duel
• Small, optimized card images to save storage space
• Share deck links that can be imported straight into your friend's app!
• Don’t have to update the app to get an updated card list!
• Simple interface, everything is only a few clicks away
If I’m missing any cards, send me an email so I can add them to the app.
Feedback is welcome and very much appreciated. I read every message I get from a user.
Email: support@logick.app
Twitter: @LogickLLC
Facebook: Logick LLC
Website: logick.app
Please send bug reports if the app has any problems, so I can fix it right away!
DISCLAIMER: This app is NOT a dueling system and will never allow you to duel. This app is merely a tool to assist you with constructing decks. I am not endorsed by or affiliated with Studio Dice, Shueisha, TV Tokyo, or Konami, and the purpose of this app is to complement the game of YGO, not to usurp it or replace it. This app is only useful if you have actual YGO cards to play with, so show your support for Konami by buying real YGO cards and playing the real game. This app can help you organize your cards into decks, but this app will NEVER allow you to duel. It isn't my place to offer dueling; I merely want to offer a helpful service to duelists.

bluejetty:00026707:ios.description:
CHISPA
Look.Match.Chat.
Chispa is the app for Latino single men and Latina single women with a simple mission: To create an exclusive community where all Latinos can find meaningful connections with people who share similar likes and interests.
 • Chispa is easy and fun to use:
 • Simply scroll through a personalized list of profiles.
 • If you're interested, slide the profile to the right to give the person a ‘Like’, or click the 'Heart' icon.
 • If the feeling's mutual, then you're a match and can start chatting in our app right away.
 • Not interested? Slide the profile to the left to see the next person, or click the ‘X’ icon.
Right when you join, all members can:
 • Become part of an exclusive community for single Latino men and Latina women
 • Customize who and what they’re looking for
 • Receive a personalized group of profiles to look through every day
 • Chat with other members if they’ve liked you back
Go Premium and you can also:
 • Send 5 Super Chispas per week to stand out from the crowd and let people know that you're really interested 
 • Rewind on people to give them a second chance
 • Boost your profile each month to be one of the top profiles in your area for 30 minutes
 • Send unlimited amount of likes to other members
 • Have an uninterrupted experience with no ads!
Become Elite and you can:
 • Get all of the Premium benefits PLUS 
 • Remove the mystery and See Who's Liked You for instant matches!
So what now? Join the community, spread the word, find a match, and have fun!
And don't forget! Check us out every day! We're growing fast and there's someone new to match with every day!

bluejetty:00014267:ios.name: HBDI®
bluejetty:00014267:ios.summary:
The HBDI® App: Better Thinking, in Hand.
Designed for anyone who has completed an HBDI® Thinking Styles assessment, the HBDI® app provides comprehensive, interactive access to your personal HBDI® results, along with new ways of exploring a
bluejetty:00014267:ios.description:
The HBDI® App: Better Thinking, in Hand.
Designed for anyone who has completed an HBDI® Thinking Styles assessment, the HBDI® app provides comprehensive, interactive access to your personal HBDI® results, along with new ways of exploring and understanding the powerful insights provided by the HBDI®.
In addition to your HBDI® Profile results, this first version includes great features to help you apply Whole Brain® Thinking and share your thinking with those closest to you.
► Features:
‣ Understand your profile: Interactive HBDI® profile outputs, including new visual tools to help you explore your Thinking Clusters, How You See Yourself, Thinking at Work and Thinking Under Pressure, as well as personalized tips for better communication, problem solving and decision making
‣ Apply the insights: Practical tools to apply Whole Brain® Thinking, starting with creating “Guesstimated” profiles for your family, friends, colleagues and customers by identifying clues about their thinking preferences, which generate a profile and tips to improve your interactions with them
‣ Share your thinking: Post a badge of your HBDI® Profile to Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, or share it with a friend via email
Planned features for upcoming versions of the HBDI® App include powerful comparison, training, application and sharing tools to help you put your Whole Brain® to work!
The HBDI® (Herrmann Brain Dominance Instrument®) is a cognitive styles assessment that defines and describes someone’s thinking preferences across the Whole Brain® Model. Originally developed at General Electric, the HBDI® was created to help people understand their thinking in order to solve problems in a business environment. It has since been completed by more than two million people around the globe and has become the assessment instrument of choice at many of the world’s most successful organizations, including 97% of Fortune 100 companies, leading universities, governments and non-profit institutions.
Please note that the HBDI® is a professional tool and the HBDI® App should be used in accordance with best practices. All profiles should be debriefed by a Herrmann International Certified Practitioner or an approved alternative to avoid misinterpretation and misuse. The HBDI® App is not intended to replace a debrief with a Certified Practitioner, but rather as an alternative way of accessing the HBDI® profile information during the debrief, and to help reinforce and apply the insights to everyday situations after the debrief.

If you're a new parent or have family far away and your looking for a safe, simple way to share your treasured moments, Moment Garden is perfect for you!
Privately share pictures and videos of your child's special moments with family and friends. Uploading new memories is fast and easy. 
Weekly digest emails keep grandparents in the loop without making them download the app.
With a single click, you can even turn your Moment Garden into a Moment Book, a beautifully printed photo book delivered to your doorstep. 
Baby books make great presents for Grandparents and it's so easy you can create one in minutes.
Since 2010, we've helped hundreds of thousands of people tell their child's story and connect with their families.
Memory Garden is packed full of Features:
* RELIVE MEMORIES - Our reminder emails are the perfect way to relive those special family moments 
* ORGANIZED - Photos and videos are automatically saved making it simple to scroll back through precious memories 
* EASY SHARING - share your memories easily with family and friends even if they don't have the app via emails or our custom website.

The Calgary Herald app connects you to the news you need to know. Create your custom feed so you don't miss the latest from your favourite writers.

· Stay connected to news from your community and beyond.

bluejetty:00063262:ios.name: Dirt Bike Sketchy Racing Game
bluejetty:00063262:ios.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate dirt bike racing adventure where hand crafted artistry meets heart pounding motocross action.
The race around the world has started, and the only thing between you and victory is raw skill, fearless stunts, and t
bluejetty:00063262:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate dirt bike racing adventure where hand crafted artistry meets heart pounding motocross action.
The race around the world has started, and the only thing between you and victory is raw skill, fearless stunts, and the power of your supercharged dirt bike. From the rooftops of San Francisco to the snow capped mountains of northern Italy, from desert cliffs to sky high platforms above crystal clear lakes every track has been designed with breathtaking detail in a hand drawn colored pencil sketch style that makes every screenshot feel like a page from a racing comic book.
Hand Crafted Racing Art
Unlike anything you have played before, this is not just racing it is art in motion. Every bike, ramp, background, and environment has been illustrated by hand, bringing a unique sketchbook aesthetic that blends realism with creativity. Whether you are flying off ramps or navigating tight turns, every frame feels alive, textured, and designed with care.
Race Around the World
Choose your route and challenge the best riders across stunning global destinations
San Francisco USA – soar over bridges, skyscrapers, and urban ramps
Italian Alps – ride through icy slopes, mountain tunnels, and sharp cliffs
Tokyo Streets – drift through neon lit highways at lightning speed
Amazon Rainforest – weave through wild terrains, mud tracks, and rushing rivers
Mystery Sky Platforms – defy gravity in impossible tracks suspended in the clouds
Each location offers unique dirt bike challenges, from breakneck speed sections to precision stunt zones.
Master Extreme Tracks
Your dirt bike is not just for speed it is built for stunts, flips, wheelies, and tricks. Every track features massive ramps, collapsing bridges, looped platforms, and moving obstacles that push your skills to the limit. Timing, balance, and guts will determine if you crash or conquer.
Compete Against the Best
The world is not racing alone. You will face rivals and AI opponents that fight for every inch of the track. Each race is a long route across multiple terrains, and one wrong move could send you tumbling down while your competition roars past. Do you have what it takes to outpace them and claim victory
Features You Will Love
Hand drawn sketch graphics a racing game that looks like an illustration come to life
Global racing locations from cities to mountains deserts forests and beyond
Dynamic stunts and physics realistic dirt bike movement with insane trick potential
Long race routes each level is an adventure across multiple terrains
Challenging opponents AI riders who test your skill at every corner
NOS boost system when speed alone is not enough unleash turbo power
Progression and rewards unlock new levels earn achievements and climb leaderboards
Why This Game
This is not just another motocross racer. It is the fusion of motorsport excitement and visual artistry. The handcrafted visuals make every moment screenshot worthy, while the global challenge ensures endless replay value. Whether you are a casual gamer who loves unique art styles or a hardcore dirt bike rider chasing the thrill of competition this game delivers.
So crank up the gas, tighten your grip, and get ready for a dirt bike journey across the most stunning illustrated tracks ever designed.
The world is waiting. Will you be the champion

bluejetty:00180076:ios.description:
Do you love fun ball games with realistic physics & tons of obstacles? Join Action Balls, the addicting ball race where you should roll the ball through unexpected barriers to finish. Master the ball control and collect the maximum game points to complete all levels like a boss!
CONTROL A BALL
Tap on the screen to roll the ball quickly or balance it carefully traveling through a level. Improve your attention & reaction to finish all the challenging levels on the first try.
OVERCOME OBSTACLES
The more levels you complete, the harder roads you should travel. Ramps, pendulums, trampolines, hammers, and tons of other barriers you should overcome on your way to finish. Don’t let anything knock your rolling ball out of the road!
DON’T WASTE YOUR LIVES
Remember, the ball game doesn't save your progress on the level automatically unless you have spare lives. Play carefully, or you’ll start a level again.
USE BALL BOOSTERS
Want to finish the ball race faster? Collect different bonuses along the road to become bigger & stronger! Take every advantage from the boosters to finish all the ball game levels!
Why you’ll love this ball game:
- Realistic physics
- Beautiful 3D graphics
- ASMR game experience
- Rolling ball adventure
- Dozens of cool ball skins
- Simple controls
Are you ready for the challenging ball race? Prove your skills and make your ball roll through all the obstacles safe and sound! Play Action Balls and have lots of fun in one of the most addicting rolling ball games now!

bluejetty:00099571:ios.name: Sorry! World Online Board Game
bluejetty:00099571:ios.summary: Sorry! World, the official board game by Hasbro, is here to bring back classic fun on mobile. One of the most loved board games, it now arrives as an exciting online game designed for family play, friendly rivalry, and games to compete with
bluejetty:00099571:ios.description:
Sorry! World, the official board game by Hasbro, is here to bring back classic fun on mobile. One of the most loved board games, it now arrives as an exciting online game designed for family play, friendly rivalry, and games to compete with friends. Whether you’re looking for casual fun or intense competition, this reimagined classic delivers fast-paced action and smart strategy.
Experience the thrill of classic board games online with brand-new twists, bold moves, and quick gameplay. Play as a two player game or invite more players to swap, slide, and chase your way to victory while building grand cities and earning tons of gold.
Sorry! World is an easy and free-to-play online game that can be enjoyed anywhere, anytime. Connect with players worldwide, challenge rivals, and enjoy games to compete with friends in a setting that blends nostalgia with modern gameplay.
Don’t forget the ultimate Sorry! card. This power card lets you turn the tables with a game-changing slam, making it the perfect moment of revenge in your favorite board game experience. Whether you’re playing casually or competitively, this card keeps every match unpredictable.
Embark on a non-stop adventure of playful rivalry in this free online game, designed for family fun and social play. Play a two player game with someone close or connect with new players worldwide to enjoy endless games to compete with friends.
You can also log in using your Facebook account and carry your progress seamlessly across multiple devices.
HOW TO PLAY
Race your pawns to victory by drawing cards, swapping spots, and sending opponents back to start. This isn’t just another card experience — it’s one of those board games where strategy matters. Whether you’re in a two player game or a full lobby, sharp thinking leads to victory.
FEATURES
-Sorry! World is a FREE-TO-PLAY game available across iPads, tablets, and phones
-Enjoy classic board games reimagined for mobile play
-Play as a two player game or with friends online
-Perfect for social fun and games to compete with friends
-Unlock daily rewards and surprises as you level up
-Shield, build, and attack beautiful cities in this modern classic
SWAP, SLIDE & CHASE
Chase your opponents away, swap positions to get closer to home, and slide your way to victory. Every match feels fresh, whether you’re playing quick rounds or longer games to compete with friends.
TAKE REVENGE WITH THE PERFECT ATTACK
Revenge has never been sweeter than with the Sorry! card. Even if luck isn’t on your side, you can strike back by attacking cities, earning gold, and changing the course of a two player game or group match.
PLAY THE CLASSIC – ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Whether you’re a board game veteran or a newcomer, Sorry! World is just a tap away. It’s a modern online game that captures everything people love about classic board games, now built for mobile.
STUNNING GRAPHICS, ENDLESS THRILLS
Enjoy smooth animations, polished visuals, and fast-paced gameplay. Every match feels engaging, whether you’re in a casual session or a competitive two player game.
If you’ve grown up playing classic board games like Yahtzee, Scrabble, and Monopoly, you’ll love Sorry! World. It’s a social-first online game built for modern play and unforgettable games to complete with friends.

* Fish cunning scaly things under the watery surface.
* Cook delicious recipes for permanent stat and ability upgrades.
* Unravel the mysteries of the strange island.

bluejetty:00135568:ios.description:
Novelist, are you ready to start writing your next amazing novel? Fortelling provides the tools you need to plot & write your book.
Plotting Tools 
Our advanced plotting tools allow you to organize your book and guide you in writing the best version of your story.
World-building Tools 
Create characters, languages, species & items. Keep everything consistent while writing and plotting.
Detailed Plotting 
Create sublocations and document your unique universe. Remove the overwhelm while plotting your book.
Create Drafts for your Novel 
Keeping your story safe is one of Fortelling's top priorities. You can create multiple draft versions of your book chapters.
Create an Overview 
Link all your story elements together to create one giant board with related items. Describe their relations and keep your plotting elements organized. 
Write your Novel 
Make the dream of holding your story as a real book a reality. You can even write your novel within Fortelling. Use our writing statistics and version history to stay in control.
Collaborate 
Working together on a story has never been easier. Through our real-time collaboration feature, you can keep the flow going and plot something amazing together.
Weekly Writing Challenges 
Every Friday, we launch a fresh writing prompt to challenge your imagination.
Protect your Book and Story. 
You retain full ownership of your novel. Create your book securely; data will never be shared with 3rd parties.

bluejetty:00083217:ios.description:
Racing Kingdom is storming onto your mobile device with a surge of adrenaline! Experience the thrill of classic drag races with next-gen graphics and ultra-realistic car sounds. Build your supercar, go head-to-head with racers worldwide in real time, and climb your way to the top of the racing world.
ADRENALINE-PACKED RACING
Feel the rush of classic drag races with state-of-the-art graphics and lifelike car sounds. Every launch, every gear shift, every finish line turns your drive into a heart-pounding adventure.
MULTIPLAYER: RACE THE WORLD IN REAL TIME
Line up against real players from around the globe in live multiplayer battles. Prove your reflexes, master the perfect start, and show everyone who owns the strip.
COMPETITIVE LEAGUE: CLIMB THE RANKS
Enter the Competitive League and battle your way up the ranks. Experience promotions and demotions, secure brand deals to boost your earnings and performance, and fight for your spot among the best drag racers in the world.
STORY MODE: WRITE YOUR RACING LEGEND
Dive into an immersive Story Mode and live the journey of a rising racer. Take on rivals, complete challenges, and progress through a career built for true racing legends.
EVENTS: NEVER STOP COMPETING
Jump into limited-time Events packed with fresh challenges and exclusive rewards. Compete for the top of the leaderboards and earn prizes you can't get anywhere else.
LICENSED CARS: DRIVE THE REAL DEAL
Get behind the wheel of officially licensed, real-world machines from the world's most iconic brands: Audi, Chevrolet, Ford, BMW, Volkswagen, Jaguar, Renault, Citroen, DS and Lotus. Plus many more, all recreated in stunning detail.
CUSTOMIZATION: DEFINE YOUR STYLE
Unleash your creativity with comprehensive customization options. Transform your car with unique colors, rims, license plates, and spoilers. Make every race a showcase of your personal style.
COMPANIONS ON THE ROAD
Invite adorable pets to join your racing adventures. Gain loyal companions that add fun interactions both on the race track and in your garage.
Don't forget to follow us on social media and join our community channels:
Discord: https://discord.gg/racingkingdom
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/racingkingdomdrag
Twitter: https://x.com/RacingKingdomEN
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/racing.kingdom
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@racingkingdom
Support: support@supergears.games

bluejetty:00119444:ios.description:
PalmAgent ONE is a city/county-specific closing cost app that comes preloaded with calculations and closing costs for real estate professionals. Generate quick and professional seller net sheets and buyer estimates for your clients in just seconds. PalmAgent is jam-packed with features that are sure to wow your clients!
ONE Premium subscription: Take the industry's #1 Closing Cost app to the next level with ONE Premium! Here's how it works:
Getting started is simple. Download the ONE app now and sign up for a free 30-day trial. We offer both monthly and annual subscription plans.
ONE Premium costs $0.99 per month (monthly plan) or $9.99 per year (annual plan).
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at the confirmation of purchase. You can cancel at any time during your 30-day free trial by going to your Apple Account subscription settings, and you will not be charged if you cancel before the trial ends. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. To learn more, please review our Terms of Use: http://palmagent.com/terms/
With ONE Premium you have:
• Users can opt in for a free 30-day trial but are required to enter their payment information first. They will be charged for the monthly or annual subscription, depending on the option they choose, after the free 30-day trial is complete, unless they cancel before the next billing date.
• After the 30-day free trial, payment will be charged to your Apple Account according to the subscription plan you selected.
• ONE Premium subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be displayed.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Apple Account subscription settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable.
If you're not ready for unlimited access, you can still run buyer and seller estimates with the ONE free plan.
For more information, please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://palmagent.com/privacy/
https://palmagent.com/terms/
Questions? Suggestions? You can speak to a real person at PalmAgent. Our customer support team is just an email away—simply write to support@palmagent.com.

bluejetty:00070284:ios.description:
Bible verses with images is an online application with beautifully created Bible verses which can share across several social meda. The Bible is what makes Christians who we are. Without the Bible which is the word of God, then we wonder how things will be. Jesus Christ is our Master, Friend and Teacher. God sent Him to come and restore us to God the Father.
Daily Bible verses on images have verses chosen from the Holy Bible. Most of the verses are from the King james Bible verses. All verses are from King James Bible therefore you can call this King James Bible Verses for happy sharing with your friends and loved ones.
Bible verse (King James) online can only be used when you have internet. Use these bible verses for your devotion, or for posters. You can also share the images on WhatsApp or Facebook. As we all know a picture speaks a 1000 words so let us all join in to share these bible verses on image.
Bible verse (King James) that can be used for devotion or for prayers is always an amazing thing. When you don’t want to make your own typography, then get this King James Bible today.
If you love to share bible verses then this app is for you. Join the mission to spread the word of God through bible images. Enjoy the selection of 365 daily Bible verses to inspire you today.
Each day you will get a Bible Verse which will encourage you. Isn't the Bible the best book to ever have daily on your phone. God’s word gives us hope. It is what propels us forward. It teaches us how to move forward when we find ourselves in the storm. Be encouraged by these lovely verses and let your light shine to those around you. Are we not the light and salts of the word. That is who we are called to be. We cannot be nothing less than what God says we are.
Unless otherwise indicated, all scripture quotations on this page are taken from the Holy Bible, King James Version.
These are motivational bible verses to inspire you everyday. Everyday is a new day and don't stay stuck in the things of yesterday. The morning has come with God's goodness. Let His love cover you. Let it bring you out of bondage. Walk with boldness because you have the truth of God's words.
The love of God changes everything. Whatever you do, remember the goodness of God is what leads people to repentance.

apple-macos:1594054077.name: Input Recorder
apple-macos:1594054077.description:
If you have trouble performing repetitive keyboard and mouse actions, Input Recorder can help. Input Recorder allows you to record keyboard and mouse actions and play them back at a later time. You can even use custom keyboard shortcuts to record and play back actions for you. You can also choose whether to repeat action playback, or to just perform it once.
Features:
• Record keyboard and mouse inputs.
• Play back input actions either once or repeat unlimited times (up to 10 times for the free version).
• Save and name your recordings for playback at a later time (save up to 3 recordings for the free version).
• Adjust a recording's playback speed up to 10x (up to 3x for the free version).
• Record and play by choosing your own keyboard shortcuts.
• Changes appearance when macOS switches to Dark Mode.
